125	---
126	
127	# 2. Tampermonkey 適不適合？
128	
129	**很適合，而且這算是 userscript 的典型 use case。**
130	
131	因為基本上只有兩件事情：
132	
133	```text
134	YouTube DOM enhancement
135	        +
136	Gemini DOM automation
137	```
138	
139	例如一個 userscript 同時：
140	
141	```javascript
142	// @match https://www.youtube.com/*
143	// @match https://gemini.google.com/*
144	```
145	
146	在 YouTube：
147	
148	```text
149	每個 thumbnail
150	┌──────────────────────────┐
151	│        Video image       │
152	│                          │
153	│                ✨ Gemini │
154	└──────────────────────────┘
155	```
156	
157	click：
158	
159	```text
160	GM_setValue("pendingPrompt",
161	  `總結 ${youtubeUrl}`
162	)
163	
164	window.open("https://gemini.google.com/app")
165	```
166	
167	然後 Gemini domain 那半邊：
168	
169	```text
170	GM_getValue("pendingPrompt")
171	        ↓
172	MutationObserver
173	        ↓
174	找到 composer
175	        ↓
176	填入 prompt
177	        ↓
178	觸發 input event
179	        ↓
180	click Send
181	```
182	
183	這會把你現在：
184	
185	```text
186	Copy URL
187	→ Gemini
188	→ 等 reload
189	→ 打「總結」
190	→ paste
191	→ Enter
192	```
193	
194	變成：
195	
196	```text
197	✨ Gemini
198	```
199	
200	### Tampermonkey 最大的問題
201	
202	不是 YouTube。
203	
204	**是 Gemini DOM。**
205	
206	因為 Gemini 沒有官方：
207	
208	```text
209	https://gemini.google.com/app?prompt=總結+https://youtu.be/...
210	```
211	
212	這種 deep link。
213	
214	現成 extension 作者也特別指出這件事，所以任何「沿用 Gemini Web subscription/session」的方案，最後基本都會變成 **DOM automation**。([Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/youtube-summary-with-gemi/alinedeonokgemjfeljbgcmcmhdefggg?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
215	
216	因此：
217	
218	```text
219	YouTube DOM          Gemini DOM
220	   ↓                    ↓
221	相對容易              比較 fragile
222	```
223	
224	Google 一改 composer implementation，就可能要更新 selector。
225	
226	### 不過 Tampermonkey 有一個巨大優點
227	
228	**你很好改。**
229	
230	例如你的需求很容易開始膨脹成：
231	
232	```text
233	✨ Summary
234	🔬 Deep analysis
235	💻 Coding takeaways
236	📚 Study notes
237	📝 Transcript
238	🤔 Critique
239	```
240	
241	甚至 thumbnail hover：
242	
243	```text
244	┌──────────────────────────┐
245	│                          │
246	│  Gemini ▼                │
247	│  ├─ 快速總結             │
248	│  ├─ 詳細筆記             │
249	│  ├─ 技術 takeaway        │
250	│  └─ 值不值得看           │
251	└──────────────────────────┘
252	```
253	
254	這種我反而會開始傾向**自己維護 userscript**。
255	
256	而且居然已經有人做到非常進階的 Tampermonkey 版本：
257	
258	**Rovetify: YouTube Summary with Gemini**
259	
260	它直接在 YouTube 做 Gemini summary、Q&A、雙語字幕、transcript export。([Greasy Fork](https://greasyfork.org/zh-CN/scripts/570598-rovetify-youtube-summary-with-gemini/code?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
261	
262	不過它走的是 **Gemini API Key**，不是你現在的 Gemini Web session。從 source 可以看到它用 `GM_xmlhttpRequest` 直接 call `generativelanguage.googleapis.com`，並把 YouTube URL 作為 `fileData.fileUri` 傳給 Gemini。([Greasy Fork](https://greasyfork.org/zh-CN/scripts/570598-rovetify-youtube-summary-with-gemini/code))
263	
264	所以它可以作為很好的**參考 implementation**，但不是完全同一個 architecture。
265	
266	---
267	
268	# 3. 其實現在還有一條更漂亮的新路：Gemini API 直接吃 YouTube URL
269	
270	這點很重要。
271	
272	現在 Google Gemini API 官方文件已經直接支援：
273	
274	```javascript
275	{
276	  type: "video",
277	  uri: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..."
278	}
279	```
280	
281	不是：
282	
283	```text
284	yt-dlp
285	→ transcript
286	→ Gemini
287	```
288	
289	而是真正：
290	
291	```text
292	YouTube URL
293	    ↓
294	Gemini video understanding
295	    ↓
296	audio + visual
297	    ↓
298	summary / timestamps / Q&A
299	```
300	
301	官方甚至給的 example 就是：
302	
303	```text
304	YouTube URL + "Please summarize the video"
305	```
306	
307	([Google AI for Developers](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video-understanding?hl=en))
308	
309	目前這項 YouTube URL input 還是 Preview；官方列出的限制包括：
310	
311	- public video only
312	- unlisted/private 不行
313	- free tier 每天最多 8 小時 YouTube video
314	- paid tier沒有基於影片長度的這個限制
315	- Gemini 2.5+ 一次最多 10 支影片
316	- 可以直接問 timestamp
317	- Gemini 同時處理 audio 和 visual stream ([Google AI for Developers](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video-understanding?hl=en))
318	
319	這代表如果你未來要把它變成一個真正的工具，我會建議：
320	
321	```text
322	             YouTube
323	                │
324	        ┌───────┴────────┐
325	        │                │
326	     summary          analysis
327	        │                │
328	        └───────┬────────┘
329	                ↓
330	         Gemini API
331	                ↓
332	      Side panel / popup
333	```
334	
335	**完全不用開 Gemini tab。**
336	
337	這會比 DOM automation 穩定很多。
338	
339	代價就是從：
340	
341	> 我的 Gemini subscription
342	
343	變成：
344	
345	> 我的 Gemini API usage / API key
346	
347	兩個 billing/account model 不一樣。
348

350	
351	# 4. 另一個值得你試的東西：`steipete/summarize`
352	
353	這個反而很符合你的使用習慣。
354	
355	現在有一個頗成熟的 open-source：
356	
357	**`steipete/summarize`**
358	
359	GitHub 已經約 **6.6k stars**，有：
360	
361	- Chrome Side Panel
362	- CLI
363	- YouTube
364	- podcast
365	- webpage
366	- PDF
367	- audio/video
368	- transcript
369	- video slides
370	- timestamp
371	- JSON output
372	- Gemini / Claude / OpenAI / Ollama
373	- 甚至支援 Gemini CLI / Claude Code / Codex / Pi 作為 backend
374	
375	([GitHub](https://github.com/steipete/summarize?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
376	
377	直接：
378	
379	```bash
380	brew install summarize
381	```
382	
383	然後：
384	
385	```bash
386	summarize 'https://youtu.be/xxx'
387	```
388	
389	甚至：
390	
391	```bash
392	summarize 'https://youtu.be/xxx' \
393	  --length long
394	```
395	
396	或者：
397	
398	```bash
399	summarize 'https://youtu.be/xxx' --slides
400	```
401	
402	它的 YouTube pipeline 是：
403	
404	```text
405	official transcript
406	       ↓ unavailable
407	YouTube caption extraction
408	       ↓ unavailable
409	yt-dlp audio
410	       ↓
411	Whisper
412	```
413	
414	然後再交給你指定的 model。([GitHub](https://github.com/steipete/summarize/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
415	
416	這跟 Gemini Web 有一個本質上的 trade-off：
417	
418	```text
419	Gemini Web
420	YouTube ─────────────→ Gemini multimodal understanding
421	                        ↑
422	               Google 原生 integration
423	
424	
425	summarize
426	YouTube → transcript / slides → arbitrary LLM
427	                              ↑
428	                   Claude / Gemini / GPT /
429	                   Codex / Pi / local model
430	```
431	
432	如果你只是**「看影片前快速決定值不值得看」**，Gemini Web 很舒服。
433	
434	如果你開始想：
435	
436	- summary 存 Markdown
437	- 丟 coding agent
438	- 搜尋過去 summary
439	- 批次處理 playlist
440	- agent 自動 research
441	- CLI pipe
442	- JSON
443	- 抽 transcript
444	- 抽 slides
445	
446	那 `summarize` 會比 Gemini Web workflow 好非常多。

453

455	
456	```text
457	YouTube tab
458	   ↓
459	Ask Gemini

461	current tab automatically shared
462	```
463	
464	Chrome 官方目前支援：
465

467	- 最多 share 10 個 tabs

487	# 我會給你的實際 roadmap
488	
489	我覺得你暫時**不用先寫 Tampermonkey**。
490	
491	先裝：
492	
493	**`YouTube → Gemini Summary`**
494	
495	因為它已經提供你最需要的：
496	
497	```text
498	Homepage / Search / Channel / Shorts
499	             │
500	             ↓
501	        [✨ Gemini]
502	             │
503	             ↓
504	     Gemini Web session
505	             │
506	             ↓
507	       auto summarize
508	```
509	
510	如果你用了幾天開始覺得：
511	
512	> 我想要 hover menu、多個 prompt preset、keyboard shortcut、特定 channel 用不同 prompt、右鍵 link 就 summary……
513	
514	那時候把它 fork 或改寫成 Tampermonkey **非常合理**。
515	
516	如果需求再往：
517	
518	> archive / agent / CLI / batch / knowledge base
519	
520	發展，我就會直接改成：
521	
522	```text
523	YouTube
524	   │
525	   ├─ Browser button
526	   ├─ Raycast
527	   ├─ CLI
528	   └─ Agent skill
529	          │
530	          ↓
531	    common summarize backend
532	          │
533	      ┌───┴────┐
534	      ↓        ↓
535	Gemini API   transcript pipeline
536	```
537	
538	而不是再繼續 automate `gemini.google.com`。
539	
540	**所以以你現在這個明確 use case，我的排序是：**
541	
542	> **現成 Chrome extension → 自製 Tampermonkey → Gemini API 自製工具 → `summarize` 作為更通用 infrastructure。**
543	
544	Tampermonkey 本身不是不適合；反而相當適合。只是**恰好已經有人把你想寫的那 50–100 行腳本做成 extension 了**，先用現成的比較划算。

549	
550	summarize CLI & Gemini in Chrome 有沒有可以自訂system prompt的方法？
551	因爲它們大多預設是英文 我希望總結時用繁體中文快速閱讀 （但是我又喜歡把系統語言設置成英文）
552	
553	---
554	
555	_**Assistant (gpt-5-6-thinking, 2026-08-31 06:07:31Z)**_
556	
557	可以，而且兩者的可客製程度其實差很多：**`summarize` CLI 很適合固定成「永遠用繁中總結」；Gemini in Chrome 目前比較像每次對話/自訂 instruction 層面的控制，不像 CLI 那麼乾淨。** 我查一下目前最新可用的設定方式與具體參數。
558	
559	有，而且你這個需求現在其實兩邊都能做得很好。重點是：**不用把 Chrome / OS / Gemini UI 改成中文**，可以單獨控制 model output language。
560	
561	### `summarize` CLI：支援最好
562	
563	`summarize` 原生有 `--language`，而且可以寫進全域 config。它的 precedence 是 CLI `--language` > `~/.summarize/config.json` > 預設 `auto`。([GitHub](https://github.com/steipete/summarize/blob/main/docs/config.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
564	
565	所以最簡單直接：
566	
567	```bash
568	summarize 'https://youtu.be/xxx' --language zh-TW
569	```
570	
571	長期則建議：
572	
573	```json
574	// ~/.summarize/config.json
575	{
576	  "output": {
577	    "language": "zh-TW",
578	    "length": "medium"
579	  }
580	}
581	```
582	
583	官方文件說 language 接受類似 BCP-47 的 tag，例如 `en-US`、`pt-BR`，因此 `zh-TW` 正好符合這個設計。([GitHub](https://github.com/steipete/summarize/blob/main/docs/config.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
584	
585	這樣：
586	
587	```bash
588	summarize 'https://youtu.be/xxx'
589	```
590	
591	就會固定要求繁中輸出，不管：
592	
593	- YouTube 是英文
594	- macOS 是英文
595	- shell locale 是英文
596	- Chrome 是英文
597	
598	都不影響。
599	
600	而且**如果你只是想改語言，不要改 `prompt`**。因為 `--prompt` / config 裡的 `prompt` 是直接**取代 summarize 原本內建的 summary instructions**，不是單純 append。([GitHub](https://github.com/steipete/summarize/blob/main/docs/llm.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
601	
602	如果想順便高度客製，例如你要的是「快速掃過影片」，才加：
603	
604	```json
605	{
606	  "output": {
607	    "language": "zh-TW",
608	    "length": "medium"
609	  },
610	  "prompt": "以快速閱讀為目的總結內容。先給 TL;DR，再列出主要觀點、重要細節與結論。使用繁體中文（台灣用語），專有名詞、技術名詞與產品名稱保留原文英文。避免冗長前言。"
611	}
612	```
613	
614	另外它還有：
615	
616	```bash
617	summarize URL --prompt '...'
618	summarize URL --prompt-file ~/.config/summarize/prompts/video.md
619	```
620	
621	所以做多個 preset 也很容易。([GitHub](https://github.com/steipete/summarize/blob/main/src/run/help.ts?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
622	
623	例如你甚至可以做 shell aliases：
624	
625	```bash
626	alias sum='summarize --language zh-TW'
627	alias sumq='summarize --language zh-TW --length short'
628	alias sumlong='summarize --language zh-TW --length long'
629	```
630

632	
633	## Gemini in Chrome：現在其實更適合你的場景
634	
635	我剛查到一個之前沒提到、但**非常適合你的功能：Chrome Gemini「Skills」**。
636	
637	現在 Gemini in Chrome 可以把一段 prompt 儲存成 Skill，然後直接對**目前 active tab** 執行。Google 官方的描述就是：
638	
639	> Skill 會讀取目前分頁內容，再套用你保存的 instructions。([Google Help](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/16988996?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=zh-Hant))
640	
641	所以你可以建立：
642	
643	```text
644	名稱：
645	繁中總結
646	
647	Prompt：
648	請總結目前頁面的內容。
649	
650	使用繁體中文（台灣用語）回答，不因來源內容或瀏覽器介面使用英文而切換成英文。
651	
652	格式：
653	- 先提供簡短 TL;DR
654	- 條列 5–10 個主要重點
655	- 保留重要技術名詞、產品名稱、人名的英文原文
656	- 如果是 YouTube 影片，盡可能指出重要時間點
657	- 最後簡短說明這支影片是否值得完整觀看，以及原因
658	```
659	
660	之後在 YouTube：
661	
662	```text
663	YouTube video
664	     ↓
665	Ctrl+G
666	     ↓
667	/繁中總結
668	     ↓
669	Enter
670	```
671	
672	甚至不用 copy URL。
673	
674	Google 現在允許自行新增任意數量的 custom Skills：
675	
676	`Gemini panel → 輸入 "/" → Add skill → Name + Prompt`
677	
678	也可以直接到：
679	
680	```text
681	chrome://skills/yourSkills
682	```
683	
684	管理。([Google Help](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/16988996?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=zh-Hant))
685	
686	有趣的是，目前 Skills 還要求 **Chrome 語言設成 English (United States)**，所以你喜歡 UI 維持英文反而完全契合。官方目前列出的需求包含 Chrome 147+、個人 Google Account，以及 English (US) Chrome language。([Google Help](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/16988996?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=zh-Hant))
687	
688	---
689	
690	## Gemini 還有另一層：Global Custom Instructions
691	
692	除了 Skill，Gemini 本身現在也已經有真正的 **Instructions for Gemini**。
693	
694	位置是：
695	
696	```text
697	gemini.google.com
698	→ Settings & help
699	→ Personal Intelligence
700	→ Instructions for Gemini
701	```
702	
703	你可以設定：
704	
705	```text
706	Unless I explicitly request another language,
707	respond in Traditional Chinese using Taiwan terminology.
708	
709	Keep technical terms, product names, APIs,
710	commands, and proper nouns in their original English when useful.
711	```
712	
713	這會套用到**每個 Gemini chat**，而且 Google 官方明確列出支援：
714	
715	- Gemini Web
716	- Gemini Mobile
717	- **Gemini in Chrome**
718	- Gemini smartwatch
719	
720	([Google Help](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16598625?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en))
721	
722	所以你的 English UI 不需要動。
723	
724	不過這有一個 trade-off：
725	
726	```text
727	Global Instructions
728	     ↓

```text
- **Handoff consumption order**
  1. Read `pendingGeminiPrompt` from `chrome.storage.session`.
  2. Return if absent.
  3. Remove and return if its timestamp is older than 10 minutes.
  4. Wait for a visible composer for up to 20 seconds.
  5. If none appears:
     - On `/app...`, remove the stash and display the fallback toast.
     - Otherwise retain it for a later retry.
  6. Once a composer is found, remove the stash immediately to prevent duplicate sends.
  7. Fill the composer, then wait for an enabled send button.
  8. Click the send control, or show the fallback toast if unavailable.
  9. Any exception during filling or sending shows the fallback toast.

- **TTL**
  - Maximum age: 10 minutes.
  - Expired entries are deleted before processing.

- **Composer selector order**
  1. `rich-textarea .ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]`
  2. `.ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]`
  3. `div[contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"]`
  4. `div[contenteditable="true"]`
  5. `textarea`

  The first visible match wins. Visibility requires a rendered size or client rectangle.

- **Insertion and events**
  - The editor is focused first.
  - For `textarea`, the script assigns `.value` and dispatches a bubbling `input` event.
  - For contenteditable elements, it selects all content and uses `document.execCommand` to insert text.
  - If that produces no non-whitespace text, it assigns `textContent` and dispatches a bubbling `InputEvent` describing text insertion.
  - There is no later content-verification step beyond that nonempty-text fallback check.

- **Send selector order**
  1. `button.send-button`
  2. A button whose `aria-label` contains send, case-insensitively
  3. A button whose `mattooltip` contains send, case-insensitively
  4. `button[data-test-id="send-button"]`

  The first visible, enabled match wins. Disabled elements and elements with `aria-disabled="true"` are skipped.

- **Waits and timing**
  - Composer polling: up to 20 seconds.
  - Send-control polling: up to 8 seconds.
  - Both poll every 200 milliseconds.
  - No explicit confirmation that sending succeeded is performed.

- **Click behavior**
  - Calls the element’s `.click()`.
  - Then dispatches, in order: pointer-down, mouse-down, mouse-up, pointer-up.

- **Fallback UI**
  - A fixed bottom-right toast appears only once, identified by `ytgs-toast`.
  - It includes a read-only textarea containing the prompt, instructions to paste it manually, and Copy and Dismiss buttons.
  - Dismiss removes the toast.
  - Copy first uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText` during the button gesture.
  - If that fails, it focuses and selects the textarea, then uses `document.execCommand('copy')`.
  - Successful copying changes the button label to `Copied ✓`.
```
</details></tool-use>

### URL normalization

All valid cases normalize to `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ`:

- Standard watch URL with extra query parameters; extras are removed.
- Watch URL without `www`.
- `youtu.be` short URL with a tracking parameter.
- `/shorts/`, `/live/`, and `/embed/` URLs.
- Watch URLs on `m.youtube.com` and `music.youtube.com`.

These invalid inputs return `null`:

- A non-video YouTube page.
- A watch URL lacking `v`.
- A video ID that is too short.
- A non-YouTube hostname.
- Non-URL text.

### Title handling

- Removes a trailing YouTube suffix.
- Removes a leading unread-count prefix along with that suffix.
- Preserves an already-clean title.

### Prompt behavior

- Starts with the supplied instructions and includes the title and canonical URL.
- Places the title immediately before the URL.
- Uses `DEFAULT_PROMPT` when instructions are empty.
- Still includes the URL when the title is empty, leaving a blank line before it.
- `DEFAULT_PROMPT` equals `Summarize the video:`.
```

```text
## Renderer selectors

```text
ytd-rich-item-renderer
ytd-video-renderer
ytd-grid-video-renderer
ytm-shorts-lockup-view-model-v2
yt-lockup-view-model
ytd-compact-video-renderer
ytd-playlist-panel-video-renderer
```

## Video URL extraction

- Searches descendants with `a[href]`.
- Accepts the first anchor whose URL pathname starts with `/watch` or `/shorts`.
- Searches the card, then `shadowRoot`, then `renderRoot`.
- Resolves the URL with `new URL(href, window.location.origin).href`.
- Card payload includes `url`, extracted title, and channel.

## UI insertion targets

- Card buttons use `gemini-summary-btn`, are appended directly to the card, and mark the card with `data-gemini-summary-injected=true`.
- Watch buttons use `gemini-summary-watch-btn` and are prepended to the selected action container.
- Fallback watch container: `ytd-watch-metadata #actions-inner`.
- The fallback container is inserted before `#menu`, or prepended when `#menu` is absent.
- Duplicate watch buttons are removed and the first is relocated into the current container.

## Watch action-row variants

```text
ytd-watch-metadata #actions-inner ytd-menu-renderer #top-level-buttons-computed
ytd-watch-metadata ytd-menu-renderer #top-level-buttons-computed
ytd-watch-metadata #top-level-buttons-computed
```

Additional fallback lookup:

```text
ytd-watch-metadata ytd-menu-renderer
```

Its `shadowRoot` or `renderRoot` is searched for `#top-level-buttons-computed`.

## Styles and visibility hooks

No CSS declarations are included. JavaScript applies these classes:

```text
gemini-summary-card
gemini-summary-btn
gemini-summary-btn--visible
gemini-summary-watch-btn
gemini-summary-watch-btn--disabled
gemini-summary-btn--disabled
gemini-summary-watch-container
gemini-hover-only
```

Card hover adds or removes `gemini-summary-btn--visible`; the root `gemini-hover-only` class reflects the setting.

## SPA observation

- `MutationObserver` watches `document.documentElement` with `childList: true` and `subtree: true`.
- Scans are throttled to 200 ms.
- Scans also run on `yt-navigate-finish` and `yt-page-data-updated`.
- Each scan handles both video cards and watch-page actions.

## Idempotency markers

- `data-gemini-summary-injected=true` prevents repeated card injection.
- `data-gemini-summary-hover-bound=true` prevents duplicate hover listeners.
- Existing buttons are detected before creating new ones.
- Cards nested under an already injected ancestor are skipped.

## Click propagation

Both button types:

- Call `preventDefault()`.
- Call `stopPropagation()`.
- Call `stopImmediatePropagation()` when available.
- Send `OPEN_GEMINI` through `chrome.runtime.sendMessage` with the extracted payload.

## Status UX

When the extension context becomes invalid:

- All summary buttons are disabled.
- Buttons receive `aria-disabled=true`.
- Buttons receive the title `Reload the page to re-enable the extension.`
- A warning is logged; further runtime use is blocked until reload.

Runtime-send failures are logged, while invalidation errors trigger the same disabled state.
```

### Editor selectors

```css
.ql-editor.textarea.new-input-ui[contenteditable="true"]
.ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]
div[contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"]
div[contenteditable="true"][aria-label*="prompt" i]
div[contenteditable="true"][aria-label*="message" i]
textarea[aria-label*="prompt" i]
textarea[placeholder*="prompt" i]
```

The first matching selector is used.

### Send-button selectors

```css
button.send-button.submit
button[aria-label*="send" i]
button[type="submit"]
```

The first matching button is used.

### Waiting and insertion

- The editor is checked immediately, then up to 14 more times at 400 ms intervals.
- If unavailable after those checks, delivery stops and the pending prompt remains stored.
- Textareas and inputs receive `.value`, followed by bubbling `input` and `change` events.
- Contenteditable elements are cleared and populated with one `<p>` per line. Empty lines receive a `<br>`.
- The resulting content is dispatched through bubbling `input` and `change` events.

### Submission and timing

- Sending waits for the configured delay, clamped between 0 and 2,000 ms; the default is 150 ms.
- The button must exist and not have `aria-disabled="true"` or a truthy `.disabled`.
- If unavailable, it is retried twice, with 300 ms between attempts.
- A successful `.click()` clears the pending prompt.
- With auto-send disabled, the prompt is filled but not submitted.

### Verification and errors

- Pending data is required; an expected ID must match when supplied.
- There is no post-click response or content verification; a successful button click is treated as submission.
- Missing editors, unavailable send buttons, storage failures, write failures, click failures, and delivery exceptions are logged.
- Pending data is retained when the editor or send button cannot be used.
```
</details></tool-use>

<summary>Tool use: **WebFetch**</summary>
 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary/main/src/background/service_worker.js`

```text
### Pending handoff

Stored in `chrome.storage.local` under `pendingPrompt` as:

```js
{
  id: requestId,        // UUID v4 string
  url: payload?.url || "",
  title: payload?.title || "",
  channel: payload?.channel || "",
  createdAt: Date.now() // millisecond timestamp
}
```

Semantics:

- A new UUID is generated for every request.
- The pending object is written before opening or reusing Gemini.
- Storage failures are logged but do not abort the handoff.
- The pending object is not removed by this code.
- `currentRequestId` remains in memory and prevents stale deliveries.

### Gemini tab behavior

The `openInNewTab` setting controls behavior:

- Default: new tab, because only an explicit `false` disables it.
- New-tab mode creates an active tab at `https://gemini.google.com/app`.
- Reuse mode searches for tabs matching `https://gemini.google.com/*`.
- It selects the first matching tab with an ID, activates it, and navigates it to the Gemini app URL.
- If no matching tab exists, reuse mode creates a new active Gemini tab.

### Delivery and message flow

1. An `OPEN_GEMINI` runtime message supplies a payload.
2. The background listener creates and stores the pending object.
3. After tab creation or selection:
   - If the tab is already complete, delivery starts immediately.
   - Otherwise, an `onUpdated` listener waits for `status === complete`.
4. Delivery sends:

```js
{
  type: "DELIVER_PROMPT",
  payload: { id: requestId }
}
```

5. Delivery is limited to the current request ID.
6. Waiting expires after 15 seconds; expiration only logs a warning and clears the listener.
7. The background listener responds asynchronously with `{ ok: true }` after the open flow resolves, including cases where tab opening internally failed and was handled.

Requests can originate from the context-menu handler for valid YouTube watch or Shorts links, or from the configured keyboard command on the active YouTube tab.
```
</details></tool-use>

## Recommendation

Build one new dual-domain userscript, `youtube-gemini-summary`, rather than a Chrome extension.

This is a good userscript MVP because the complete workflow needs only:

1. Inject buttons into YouTube.
2. Store one short-lived request in script-scoped GM storage.
3. Open a fresh `https://gemini.google.com/app` tab.
4. Let the same userscript consume the request on Gemini, fill the composer, and submit once.

A custom extension would need a manifest, YouTube and Gemini content scripts, a service worker, `chrome.runtime` messaging, and `chrome.storage` for the same outcome. The userscript manager is already the extension layer that supplies those capabilities.

No clarification blocks implementation. Recommended first-release scope:

- Standard YouTube browsing cards.
- Standard `/watch?v=...` pages.
- Shorts cards when they expose a valid `/shorts/<id>` link.
- Automatic submission of exactly `總結 <canonical YouTube URL>`.
- Always open a new Gemini tab; never reuse an existing conversation.
- Defer the dedicated button inside an opened Shorts player until that separate UI is validated.

## Files and scaffolding

From `/Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary`, run:

```bash
npm run new -- youtube-gemini-summary \
  "YouTube Gemini Summary" \
  "https://www.youtube.com/*" \
  "在 YouTube 影片卡片與觀看頁一鍵開啟 Gemini，送出繁中摘要提示"
```

This creates:

- `/Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js`
- `/Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/README.md`

The scaffolder accepts one initial match. Add Gemini manually and use this final metadata shape:

```js
// @version      0.1.0
// @match        https://www.youtube.com/*
// @match        https://gemini.google.com/app*
// @run-at       document-idle
// @grant        GM_addStyle
// @grant        GM_setValue
// @grant        GM_getValue
// @grant        GM_deleteValue
// @grant        GM_openInTab
// @grant        GM_setClipboard
```

Keep the scaffold-generated `@icon`, `@updateURL`, and `@downloadURL`.

Do not add:

- `@connect`
- `@require`
- `unsafeWindow`
- Manager-specific metadata
- `GM_registerMenuCommand`
- API credentials

The script only needs shared DOM access and portable GM APIs. It should not call Gemini APIs or any third-party endpoint.

Use the scaffold’s `0.1.0` as the first unreleased version. Once installed or published, every script edit must increment `@version`; if the scaffold is committed separately, the implementation release should become `0.1.1`.

## Implementation plan

### 1. Establish dual-domain dispatch

Follow the hostname-dispatch precedent in `page-title-tag.user.js`, but use exact hostname equality:

- `www.youtube.com` calls `initYouTube()`.
- `gemini.google.com` calls `consumePendingOnGemini()`.
- Any other hostname returns immediately.

Do not run YouTube observers on Gemini or vice versa.

The Gemini branch should inspect pending state only once at document initialization. It should not install a GM storage listener or continuously poll pending state; this prevents already-open Gemini tabs from claiming a request intended for the newly opened tab.

### 2. Implement pure URL normalization

Keep these as small dependency-free functions in the userscript:

- `extractYouTubeVideoId(rawUrl)`
- `canonicalizeYouTubeUrl(rawUrl)`

Accept:

- `youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`
- `www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`
- `m.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`
- `music.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`
- `youtu.be/<id>`
- `/shorts/<id>`
- `/live/<id>`
- `/embed/<id>`
- `/v/<id>`
- Relative YouTube links found inside cards

Require an exact 11-character ID matching letters, numbers, underscore, or hyphen.

Always return:

```text
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>
```

This deliberately removes playlists, timestamps, share tracking, `index`, and other incidental parameters. Invalid, playlist-only, channel, or non-YouTube URLs return `null`.

The MVP prompt does not need the title or channel:

```text
總結 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>
```

This avoids extra DOM extraction and exactly matches the requested workflow.

### 3. Add YouTube browsing-card controls

Use this candidate renderer list, borrowed conceptually from the broader extension:

```text
ytd-rich-item-renderer
ytd-video-renderer
ytd-grid-video-renderer
ytm-shorts-lockup-view-model-v2
yt-lockup-view-model
ytd-compact-video-renderer
ytd-playlist-panel-video-renderer
```

This covers likely home, search, channel, subscriptions, related-video, playlist-panel, and Shorts-card surfaces.

For each renderer:

1. Search its descendant `a[href]` elements.
2. Pass each link through `canonicalizeYouTubeUrl`.
3. Use the first valid single-video URL.
4. Search an open `shadowRoot` as a fallback if required.
5. Do not depend on non-standard `renderRoot` unless live testing proves it necessary.
6. Skip the card when no valid video URL exists.
7. Add one namespaced button only when the actual button is absent.

Do not rely solely on a permanent `data-*` processed marker. YouTube may recycle card nodes. On every scheduled scan:

- Re-evaluate the card’s current URL.
- Remove or disable a stale injected button if the card no longer represents a video.
- Recreate the button if YouTube removed it.
- Recompute the URL again at click time rather than retaining only the original closure value.

The button should:

- Use `type="button"`.
- Have a namespaced class such as `youtube-gemini-summary-card-button`.
- Use `textContent`, not page-derived `innerHTML`.
- Have an accessible label such as `用 Gemini 總結這支影片`.
- Call `preventDefault`, `stopPropagation`, and, where available, `stopImmediatePropagation`.
- Temporarily display `開啟中…` and disable itself while initiating the handoff.

For the provisional layout, append the button to the renderer and make the renderer `position: relative`, with a small always-visible chip near the bottom-right. Validate this against duration badges, overflow menus, and compact cards before finalizing the corner. Do not add hover-only configuration in the MVP.

### 4. Add the standard watch-page control

Only treat a page as an opened MVP video when:

- `location.pathname === "/watch"`
- The current URL canonicalizes successfully

Candidate action-row targets, in order:

```text
ytd-watch-metadata #actions-inner ytd-menu-renderer #top-level-buttons-computed
ytd-watch-metadata ytd-menu-renderer #top-level-buttons-computed
ytd-watch-metadata #top-level-buttons-computed
```

If none exists but `ytd-watch-metadata` does:

1. Create one namespaced inline container.
2. Insert it before `#menu`, or prepend it to the metadata area.
3. Place the same action button in that container.

Maintain exactly one watch button:

- Reuse or relocate the existing button when YouTube rebuilds the action row.
- Remove duplicates.
- Compute `location.href` at click time so SPA navigation cannot submit the previous video.
- Style it as a compact YouTube-like action chip, without cloning private YouTube components.

An opened `/shorts/<id>` page is not part of v0.1.0’s guaranteed action-row support. Its URL normalizer and browsing cards are included, but its player-side UI is separate work.

### 5. Make YouTube observation idempotent and bounded

Run an initial `scanYouTube()` and schedule later scans from:

- A `MutationObserver` on `document.documentElement`, observing `childList` and `subtree`.
- `yt-navigate-finish`.
- `yt-page-data-updated`.
- A small URL-change watcher as insurance.

Use a 200 ms throttle/scheduler rather than immediately rescanning on every mutation. A timer that allows at most one pending scan is preferable to a reset-on-every-mutation debounce, which could starve on continuously changing pages.

Copy only the small helpers needed into the userscript:

- A throttled scan scheduler.
- URL-change detection.
- A wait-for-first-visible helper for Gemini.

Do not add `shared/dom.js` as an `@require`; repository guidance favors copying two or three tiny helpers for a single script.

### 6. Define the one-shot pending handoff

Use a namespaced key such as:

```text
youtubeGeminiSummary.pending.v1
```

Recommended schema:

```js
{
  schemaVersion: 1,
  requestId: "...",
  videoUrl: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...",
  prompt: "總結 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...",
  targetPath: "/app",
  createdAt: 0,
  expiresAt: 0
}
```

Set `expiresAt` to `createdAt + 120_000`.

On YouTube click:

1. Recompute and validate the canonical URL.
2. Construct the exact prompt.
3. Generate a request ID for validation and diagnostics.
4. Write the pending object synchronously with `GM_setValue`.
5. Open `https://gemini.google.com/app` using:

   ```js
   GM_openInTab("https://gemini.google.com/app", { active: true });
   ```

6. Never search for or reuse an existing Gemini tab.

If `GM_openInTab` throws:

- Delete the pending record only if its request ID is still the same.
- Copy the prompt with `GM_setClipboard`.
- Show a visible source-page error explaining that the prompt is ready to paste.

The storage is script-scoped, not domain-scoped, so the same script can read it on Gemini without extension messaging.

A single pending key intentionally supports one in-flight request. Guard rapid repeat clicks in the source tab, but defer a queue or parallel request correlation. Document that rapidly clicking multiple cards may leave only the latest request.

### 7. Consume safely on Gemini

At Gemini initialization:

1. Read the pending value.
2. Return immediately when absent.
3. Validate:
   - Plain object
   - `schemaVersion === 1`
   - Plausible request ID and timestamps
   - `videoUrl` canonicalizes to itself
   - `prompt === "總結 " + videoUrl`
   - `targetPath === "/app"`
4. Delete malformed or expired records.
5. Normalize trailing slashes and require the current path to be the fresh `/app` route.
6. If Gemini opened an existing conversation route instead, do not auto-submit there. Consume the request and show the manual fallback.
7. For a valid fresh route, call `GM_deleteValue` before beginning any asynchronous DOM wait.

Deleting before waiting follows the repository’s existing one-shot pattern and ensures reloads or failures cannot submit the same prompt twice. The prompt remains in local memory for fallback UI.

For an expired but otherwise recoverable request, copy the prompt and show an “expired; paste manually” message rather than silently discarding it.

### 8. Implement a bounded Gemini state machine

Use explicit states:

```text
claimed
  -> waiting-for-editor
  -> filling
  -> verifying-text
  -> waiting-for-send
  -> submitting
  -> confirming
  -> success | manual-fallback
```

Recommended timeouts:

- Composer: 20 seconds
- Enabled send button: 8 seconds
- Post-click confirmation: 5 seconds

Candidate editor selectors, ordered from specific to semantic:

```text
rich-textarea .ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]
.ql-editor.textarea.new-input-ui[contenteditable="true"]
.ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]
div[contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"]
div[contenteditable="true"][aria-label*="prompt" i]
textarea[aria-label*="prompt" i]
textarea[placeholder*="prompt" i]
```

Only accept visible, enabled elements. Avoid a bare document-wide `div[contenteditable="true"]` fallback because it can target unrelated editors.

Fill behavior:

- Focus the editor.
- For `textarea` or `input`, use the native prototype value setter and dispatch bubbling `input` and `change` events.
- For contenteditable/Quill, select existing contents and try `document.execCommand("insertText")`.
- If the editor does not contain the exact prompt, fall back to `textContent` plus the necessary bubbling input events.
- Read the editor back and require the normalized visible value to equal the prompt before submitting.

Candidate send selectors:

```text
button.send-button.submit
button.send-button
button[data-test-id="send-button"]
button[aria-label*="send" i]
button[mattooltip*="send" i]
```

A generic `button[type="submit"]` should only be considered inside the editor’s closest form or confirmed composer container, never across the entire document.

Wait until the chosen control is visible and neither `disabled` nor `aria-disabled="true"`. Invoke `.click()` exactly once. Do not emit an extra sequence of pointer and mouse events, because that can create duplicate submissions.

Confirm submission by observing at least one of:

- The composer becomes empty.
- The route changes from `/app` to a conversation path.
- A visible user turn containing the exact prompt appears.

If confirmation times out, do not click again. Report “可能未送出”, copy the prompt, and leave manual control to the user.

### 9. Provide visible status and fallback UX

Use one small namespaced fixed status component, consistent with existing repository UI patterns.

On Gemini:

- Show `正在準備摘要…` while waiting.
- Show `已送出摘要請求` briefly after confirmed submission.
- Keep failures visible until dismissed.

Failure UI should contain:

- A concise reason.
- A read-only/selectable textarea containing the exact prompt.
- A `再次複製` button using `GM_setClipboard`.
- A `關閉` button.
- Instructions to paste or manually press Send, depending on how far the state machine progressed.

Always copy the prompt automatically on an automation failure. Distinguish:

- Editor missing: paste the copied prompt manually.
- Fill rejected: paste manually.
- Send button unavailable: prompt is already in the composer; press Send manually.
- Submission unconfirmed: check whether it sent before pasting to avoid duplication.
- Not a fresh conversation: click New chat, then paste.

Do not use `GM_notification`; visible page UI avoids another grant. Build dynamic content with `createElement` and `textContent`.

### 10. Write the script README

Populate `/Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/README.md` with:

- One-sentence purpose.

### 11. Extend the beginner documentation

Add a section named `Userscript + manager vs. 自製 Chrome extension` to:

`/Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary/docs/01-what-is-userscript.md`

Place it after the existing `userscript vs. userscript manager` explanation.

The central answer should be:

> Chrome extension 不是單純「更正式的 userscript」。兩者都能修改網頁，但技術形狀不同。Tampermonkey／Violentmonkey 本身才是 extension；`.user.js` 是交給 manager 執行的腳本。自製 extension 則是一個獨立的瀏覽器應用程式。

Include a concise comparison covering:

- Project shape:
  - Userscript: one `.user.js` plus metadata.
  - Extension: `manifest.json`, content scripts, service worker, popup/options/side-panel code.
- Execution contexts:
  - Manager sandbox and page DOM.
  - Extension content, extension-page, and service-worker contexts with explicit messaging.
- Browser APIs:
  - Portable `GM_*` subset versus richer `chrome.*` APIs.
- Persistence and configuration:
  - Userscript code is retained by the manager.
  - `GM_setValue` is script-scoped, shared across that script’s matched domains, and survives reload/restart.
  - Extension settings live in `chrome.storage.local` or `chrome.storage.sync`.
  - `chrome.storage.session` is session-lifetime state.
  - Service-worker memory is not persistent and must not be treated as storage.
  - Both remain scoped to a browser profile unless sync is configured.
- Distribution:
  - Raw `.user.js`, `@updateURL`, manager sync.
  - Web Store or unpacked extension packages.
- Permissions and trust:
  - Manager plus each installed script are both trust boundaries.
  - Extension manifest and publisher/package are the trust boundary.
- Portability:
  - One script can target Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey.
  - Chrome-extension APIs and Store packaging are more browser-specific.
- Upgrade threshold:
  - Use an extension for toolbar state, context menus, background browser events, side panels, native messaging, polished options, multiple cooperating content scripts, or Store distribution.
  - Stay with a userscript for a small DOM enhancement and one-shot cross-site handoff such as this MVP.

Link rather than repeat detail from existing docs 03, 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, and 12.

No new documentation article or navigation entry is needed. The existing index already promises Console/userscript/extension positioning.

## Testing strategy

### Pure URL cases

Keep URL functions pure, but do not add a test framework or duplicate helper module for this MVP. The repository has no unit-test script, and extracting a tiny helper solely for testing would work against the single-file convention.

Exercise a table of valid and invalid cases in DevTools or a temporary evaluation during development:

Valid:

- Standard watch URL with timestamp and playlist parameters.
- Watch URL without `www`.
- `youtu.be` with tracking.
- `/shorts/`, `/live/`, `/embed/`, `/v/`.
- Mobile and Music YouTube watch URLs.

Invalid:

- YouTube homepage, channel, or playlist URL.
- `/watch` without `v`.
- IDs shorter or longer than 11 characters.
- Non-YouTube hosts.
- A hostname merely ending in `youtube.com` maliciously.

All valid cases should produce the same canonical watch URL.

If this parser grows later, use Node’s built-in `node:test` rather than introducing a third-party framework, but only after arranging a single source of truth for the helper.

### Static and repository checks

Run:

```bash
node --check /Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js
npm run check
npm run index
npm run verify
npm run format:check
git diff --check
```

Preserve the pre-existing `.specstory` modifications; they are unrelated to implementation.

### Preview harness

Use preview for separate UI smoke tests:

```bash
npm run preview -- youtube-gemini-summary "https://www.youtube.com/"
npm run preview -- youtube-gemini-summary "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"
```

Inspect the screenshots for card/watch controls and duplicate injection.

Do not claim end-to-end coverage from the preview harness:

- It does not implement `GM_openInTab`.
- Its GM storage is per run and not shared between tabs/domains.
- It bypasses real `@match`, grants, sandbox, and manager timing.
- A Gemini preview without pre-seeded pending state can only prove a safe no-op.

There is no reason to expand the harness as part of this MVP.

### Mandatory real-manager matrix

Test both Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey:

1. YouTube home grid.
2. Search results.
3. Channel or subscriptions grid.
4. Related/compact videos.
5. Playlist panel.
6. Shorts browsing cards.
7. Initial standard watch-page load.
8. SPA navigation between two watch videos.
9. Infinite scroll and filters, checking for duplicate controls.
10. Confirm a click does not also open the YouTube card.
11. Confirm exactly one active new Gemini `/app` tab opens.
12. Confirm the canonical URL and exact prompt.
13. Confirm only one submission occurs.
14. Confirm clipboard/manual fallback for missing editor and missing Send control.
15. Confirm malformed and expired pending state never auto-submits.
16. Confirm the script does nothing in an existing Gemini conversation route.

## Live behavior that must be validated before finalizing

The external selectors are useful starting points, not contracts. Validate these against current signed-in sites:

### YouTube

- Every renderer name still exists on its intended surface.
- Video anchors are reachable from normal DOM or open shadow roots.
- `yt-lockup-view-model` does not cause playlist or nested-card duplicates.
- The bottom-right chip does not cover duration badges, three-dot menus, Watch Later, subtitles, or compact-card controls.
- The three watch action-row selectors work in normal, theater, narrow, logged-out, and Premium layouts.
- The fallback metadata container does not distort YouTube’s action row.
- `yt-navigate-finish` and `yt-page-data-updated` still fire.
- Recycled renderer nodes receive the current URL rather than a stale one.
- Shorts card links still expose an 11-character ID.

### Gemini

- Opening plain `/app` reliably means a new conversation and does not restore a draft or old thread.
- The ordered editor selectors cover the currently deployed composer variant.
- Programmatic insertion updates Gemini’s framework state, not just visible DOM.
- The exact prompt remains after the input event cycle.
- The Send selectors identify only the composer’s submit control.
- The button becomes enabled after insertion in both English and any relevant localized UI.
- One `.click()` submits exactly once.
- Composer clearing, route change, or user-turn appearance is a reliable success signal.
- Login or consent redirects return to `/app` within the TTL.
- Clipboard fallback works after asynchronous waits in both managers.

## Explicitly deferred

- Dedicated opened-Shorts player button
- `m.youtube.com` and Music YouTube UI injection
- Configurable prompts, title/channel interpolation, presets, or language settings
- Auto-submit toggle or adjustable delay
- Hover-only card setting
- Existing Gemini-tab reuse
- Parallel request queue
- Context menus, keyboard shortcuts, or toolbar badges
- Gemini API/API-key mode
- Transcript extraction, timestamps, or summary rendering inside YouTube
- Browser-extension service worker, options page, popup, or Web Store packaging
- Undocumented prompt query parameters or prefill deep links

1	# 01 · 什麼是 userscript
2	
3	一句話：**把你原本會貼到 Chrome DevTools Console 執行的 JavaScript，包裝成會自動比對網址、
4	持久保存、有權限管理的瀏覽器腳本。**
5	
6	它比 Console script 多了幾個關鍵能力，所以實際上更接近「超輕量 browser extension」。
7	
8	## 三層定位
9	
10	```text
11	DevTools Console
12	    ↓
13	「臨時 hack 一下」
14	
15	Userscript
16	    ↓
17	「我要長期 hack 這個網站，但不值得造一個 extension」
18	
19	Browser Extension
20	    ↓
21	「我要做成完整產品／深度 browser integration」
22	```
23	
24	## 能力對照
25	
26	|                     | DevTools Console | Userscript          | Browser Extension |
27	| ------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------- | ----------------- |
28	| 執行 JS             | ✅               | ✅                  | ✅                |
29	| 操作 DOM            | ✅               | ✅                  | ✅                |
30	| 關掉頁面後還存在    | ❌               | ✅                  | ✅                |
31	| 每次開網站自動執行  | ❌               | ✅                  | ✅                |
32	| 指定哪些 URL 執行   | 手動             | ✅ `@match`         | ✅                |
33	| 跨頁持久化資料      | 麻煩             | ✅ `GM_setValue`    | ✅                |
34	| 跨域 HTTP request   | 受 CORS 限制     | ✅ `GM_xmlhttpRequest` | ✅             |
35	| 插入 menu / UI      | 手動             | ✅                  | ✅                |
36	| 安裝／分享          | 貼 code          | 一個 `.user.js`     | extension package |
37	| 開發成本            | 最低             | 很低                | 較高              |
38	
39	概念上就是：
40	
41	```text
42	Console snippet
43	    ↓ 加上
44	URL matching
45	自動執行
46	persistent storage
47	extra browser APIs
48	權限管理
49	更新機制
50	    ↓
51	Userscript
52	```
53	
54	## 最小可用範例
55	
56	每次打開 ChatGPT 都把分頁標題前面加 `[GPT]`：
57	
58	```js
59	// ==UserScript==
60	// @name         ChatGPT Title Modifier
61	// @namespace    local
62	// @version      1.0.0
63	// @match        https://chatgpt.com/*
64	// @grant        none
65	// ==/UserScript==
66	
67	(function () {
68	  'use strict';
69	  document.title = `[GPT] ${document.title}`;
70	})();
71	```
72	
73	真正的關鍵是 metadata 裡的：
74	
75	```js
76	// @match https://chatgpt.com/*
77	```
78	
79	意思是「只要網址符合，就自動執行」。你不再需要開 DevTools → 切 Console → 貼 code → Enter，
80	reload 網頁就跑。
81	
82	> ⚠️ 這個版本在 ChatGPT 上其實**會失效**，因為它是 SPA，切換對話時網站會自己蓋掉標題。
83	> 正確做法見 [05 SPA 與執行時機](./05-spa-and-timing.md) 和
84	> [`page-title-tag`](../userscripts/page-title-tag/) 這支腳本。
85	
86	## 常見用途
87	
88	```text
89	網站 UI patch
90	├─ 隱藏元素
91	├─ 調整版面
92	├─ 加按鈕
93	├─ 鍵盤快捷鍵
94	└─ 自訂 CSS / dark mode
95	
96	資料處理
97	├─ 抓當前頁面內容
98	├─ 批次複製
99	├─ 匯出 Markdown / JSON / CSV
100	└─ 偵測變化
101	
102	自動化
103	├─ 自動點擊
104	├─ 自動填表
105	├─ 翻頁
106	└─ 重複操作
107	
108	整合
109	├─ 呼叫 API
110	├─ 送到本機 server
111	├─ 送 webhook
112	└─ 串接其他服務
113	```
114	
115	## userscript vs. userscript manager
116	
117	`userscript` 是這個概念本身；Tampermonkey 之類的是**執行它的軟體**：
118	
119	```text
120	        userscript
121	            ↑
122	┌───────────────────────┐
123	│ Tampermonkey          │
124	│ Violentmonkey         │
125	│ Greasemonkey          │
126	└───────────────────────┘
127	```
128	
129	怎麼選見 [09 Manager 比較](./09-managers-comparison.md)。
130	
131	## 下一步
132	
133	[02 · 第一支腳本](./02-getting-started.md)
134
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	# 04 · GM API
2	
3	GM API 是 userscript **比一般網頁 JS 多出來的能力**。用哪個就要在 metadata 加對應的
4	`// @grant`，否則該函式是 `undefined`。
5	
6	## 持久化儲存
7	
8	```js
9	// @grant GM_setValue
10	// @grant GM_getValue
11	// @grant GM_deleteValue
12	// @grant GM_listValues
13	```
14	
15	```js
16	GM_setValue('lastExport', Date.now());
17	const last = GM_getValue('lastExport', 0);   // 第二個參數是預設值
18	GM_deleteValue('lastExport');
19	GM_listValues();                             // ['lastExport', ...]
20	```
21	
22	特性：
23	
24	- 值會做 JSON 序列化，可以直接存物件、陣列、boolean
25	- 綁在「腳本」上，不是網域 —— 同一支腳本在不同網站看到的是同一份資料
26	- reload、關分頁、重開瀏覽器都還在
27	- 和 `localStorage` 不同：網站清 `localStorage` 動不到它，網站也讀不到它
28	
29	適合存：設定、上次執行時間、UI 狀態、已處理過的 ID 清單。
30	
31	### 監看變化
32	
33	```js
34	// @grant GM_addValueChangeListener
35	GM_addValueChangeListener('theme', (key, oldValue, newValue, remote) => {
36	  if (remote) applyTheme(newValue);  // remote = 另一個分頁改的
37	});
38	```
39	
40	多分頁之間同步設定很好用。
41	
42	## 剪貼簿
43	
44	```js
45	// @grant GM_setClipboard
46	GM_setClipboard(markdown, 'text');
47	GM_setClipboard('<b>hi</b>', 'html');
48	```
49	
50	比 `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` 好用的地方：**不需要使用者手勢**，
51	在 `setTimeout` 或 observer callback 裡也能寫入。
52	
53	典型用途——把整段對話轉成 Markdown 丟給 coding agent：
54	
55	```text
56	ChatGPT
57	──────────────────────
58	conversation...
59	
60	                  [Copy MD]
61	```
62	
63	## 跨域請求
64	
65	```js
66	// @grant   GM_xmlhttpRequest
67	// @connect api.example.com
68	```
69	
70	```js
71	GM_xmlhttpRequest({
72	  method: 'GET',
73	  url: 'https://api.example.com/data',
74	  headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
75	  onload(res) {
76	    const data = JSON.parse(res.responseText);
77	    console.log(data);
78	  },
79	  onerror(err) {
80	    console.error(err);
81	  },
82	});
83	```
84	
85	這是 GM API 最有價值的一個：**繞過 CORS**。一般網頁的 `fetch()` 打別的網域會被擋，
86	`GM_xmlhttpRequest` 由 extension 發出，不受同源政策限制。
87	
88	⚠️ 目標網域一定要列在 `@connect`。
89	
90	Promise 版本包裝：
91	
92	```js
93	function gmFetch(options) {
94	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
95	    GM_xmlhttpRequest({ ...options, onload: resolve, onerror: reject, ontimeout: reject });
96	  });
97	}
98	
99	const res = await gmFetch({ method: 'GET', url: 'https://api.example.com/data' });
100	```
101	
102	## 選單指令
103	
104	```js
105	// @grant GM_registerMenuCommand
106	GM_registerMenuCommand('Export conversation', exportConversation);
107	```
108	
109	⚠️ 第三個參數的 options 兩邊不完全一樣（`accessKey` 是 Tampermonkey 限定）。
110	想跨 manager 就只用前兩個參數。
111	
112	不用動網站 UI 就能提供功能：
113	
114	```text
115	Tampermonkey
116	 ├─ Export conversation
117	 ├─ Copy as Markdown
118	 └─ Debug selectors
119	```
120	
121	想移除的話，**自己指定一個 id**，不要依賴回傳值：
122	
123	```js
124	// @grant GM_unregisterMenuCommand
125	GM_registerMenuCommand('Stop', stop, { id: 'stop' });
126	GM_unregisterMenuCommand('stop');
127	```
128	
129	Tampermonkey 的 `GM_registerMenuCommand` 會回傳一個 id，Violentmonkey 則是用
130	caption 或你自己給的 id 來反註冊。明確指定 id 是唯一兩邊都可靠的寫法。
131	
132	## 注入 CSS
133	
134	```js
135	// @grant GM_addStyle
136	GM_addStyle(`
137	  .ad-banner { display: none !important; }
138	  #my-panel { position: fixed; z-index: 2147483647; }
139	`);
140	```
141	
142	搭配 `@run-at document-start` 可以避免元素先閃一下才被隱藏。
143	
144	沒有 `GM_addStyle` 的環境（例如 `@grant none`）可以自己來：
145	
146	```js
147	const style = document.createElement('style');
148	style.textContent = '...';
149	document.head.appendChild(style);
150	```
151	
152	## 通知與分頁
153	
154	```js
155	// @grant GM_notification
156	GM_notification({ title: 'Done', text: '匯出完成', timeout: 3000 });
157	
158	// @grant GM_openInTab
159	GM_openInTab('https://example.com', { active: false, insert: true });
160	
161	// @grant GM_download
162	GM_download({ url: blobUrl, name: 'conversation.md' });
163	```
164	
165	## 腳本自身資訊
166	
167	`GM_info` 不需要 `@grant`：
168	
169	```js
170	console.log(GM_info.script.version);   // '1.0.0'
171	console.log(GM_info.scriptHandler);    // 'Tampermonkey' / 'Violentmonkey'
172	```
173	
174	寫「版本更新後跳一次提示」很好用。
175	
176	## `GM_*` vs `GM.*`
177	
178	較新的規範提供 Promise 版本：
179	
180	```js
181	// @grant GM.setValue
182	const value = await GM.getValue('key', 0);
183	```
184	
185	- `GM_setValue`（底線）：同步，相容性最好
186	- `GM.setValue`（點）：回傳 Promise
187	
188	本 repo 統一用底線版，理由是相容性最廣、也不用處理 async 傳染。
189	
190	## 相容性提醒
191	
192	Tampermonkey 和 Violentmonkey 的 GM API 大致相同，但不是 100%。
193	會跨 manager 分享的腳本，用之前先確認一下。
194	
195	## 下一步
196	
197	[05 · SPA 與執行時機](./05-spa-and-timing.md)
198
```
</details></tool-use>

1	#!/usr/bin/env node
2	// Validate every userscript's metadata block: required keys, semver-ish
3	// @version, canonical @updateURL/@downloadURL, and @grant vs. actual GM_* usage.
4	import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
5	import { join } from 'node:path';
6	import {
7	  listUserscripts,
8	  first,
9	  rawUrlFor,
10	  stripCommentsAndStrings,
11	  RAW_BASE,
12	  REPO_ROOT,
13	} from './lib/meta.mjs';
14	
15	// @run-at is required because the default differs between managers:
16	// Tampermonkey defaults to document-idle, Violentmonkey to document-end.
17	const REQUIRED = ['name', 'namespace', 'version', 'description', 'author', 'grant', 'run-at'];
18	const KNOWN_GM = /\bGM[._]([A-Za-z]\w*)/g;
19	
20	// GM APIs documented as supported by BOTH Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey.
21	// Anything outside this set ties the script to one manager.
22	const PORTABLE_GM = new Set([
23	  'GM_info',
24	  'GM_cookie',
25	  'GM_getValue',
26	  'GM_getValues',
27	  'GM_setValue',
28	  'GM_setValues',
29	  'GM_deleteValue',
30	  'GM_deleteValues',
31	  'GM_listValues',
32	  'GM_addValueChangeListener',
33	  'GM_removeValueChangeListener',
34	  'GM_getResourceText',
35	  'GM_getResourceURL',
36	  'GM_addElement',
37	  'GM_addStyle',
38	  'GM_openInTab',
39	  'GM_registerMenuCommand',
40	  'GM_unregisterMenuCommand',
41	  'GM_notification',
42	  'GM_setClipboard',
43	  'GM_xmlhttpRequest',
44	  'GM_download',
45	]);
46	
47	// Metadata keys that only one manager understands.
48	const MANAGER_SPECIFIC_KEYS = {
49	  sandbox: 'Tampermonkey',
50	  'inject-into': 'Violentmonkey',
51	  'exclude-match': 'Violentmonkey',
52	  antifeature: 'Tampermonkey / script hosts',
53	};
54	
55	const errors = [];
56	const warnings = [];
57	
58	const scripts = listUserscripts();
59	if (scripts.length === 0) {
60	  console.log('No userscripts found under userscripts/ — nothing to check.');
61	  process.exit(0);
62	}
63	
64	for (const s of scripts) {
65	  const at = (msg) => `${s.relPath}: ${msg}`;
66	
67	  if (s.missing) {
68	    errors.push(
69	      at(`expected userscripts/${s.slug}/${s.slug}.user.js (filename must match folder)`)
70	    );
71	    continue;
72	  }
73	  if (!s.meta) {
74	    errors.push(at('missing a // ==UserScript== ... // ==/UserScript== metadata block'));
75	    continue;
76	  }
77	  if (!s.hasReadme) warnings.push(at('no README.md next to the script'));
78	
79	  for (const key of REQUIRED) {
80	    if (!first(s.meta, key)) errors.push(at(`missing @${key}`));
81	  }
82	
83	  if (!s.meta.match && !s.meta.include) {
84	    errors.push(at('needs at least one @match (preferred) or @include'));
85	  }
86	
87	  const version = first(s.meta, 'version');
88	  if (version && !/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(version)) {
89	    warnings.push(
90	      at(`@version "${version}" is not X.Y.Z — Tampermonkey compares versions to decide updates`)
91	    );
92	  }
93	
94	  // Violentmonkey only reads @downloadURL; Tampermonkey uses both. Write both.
95	  const expected = rawUrlFor(s.slug);
96	  for (const key of ['updateURL', 'downloadURL']) {
97	    const actual = first(s.meta, key);
98	    if (!actual) {
99	      errors.push(at(`missing @${key} (auto-update will not work) — expected ${expected}`));
100	    } else if (actual !== expected) {
101	      errors.push(at(`@${key} is "${actual}" but should be "${expected}"`));
102	    }
103	  }
104	
105	  // GM API usage must be declared in @grant (unless @grant none is intentional).
106	  const grants = new Set(s.meta.grant ?? []);
107	  const body = stripCommentsAndStrings(s.source.slice(s.source.indexOf('==/UserScript==')));
108	  const used = new Set();
109	  for (const [full] of body.matchAll(KNOWN_GM)) {
110	    if (full === 'GM.info' || full === 'GM_info') continue;
111	    used.add(full.replace('GM.', 'GM_'));
112	  }
113	  for (const api of used) {
114	    const dotted = api.replace('GM_', 'GM.');
115	    if (!grants.has(api) && !grants.has(dotted)) {
116	      errors.push(at(`uses ${api} but does not declare "// @grant ${api}"`));
117	    }
118	  }
119	  if (grants.has('none') && used.size > 0) {
120	    errors.push(at(`declares "@grant none" but uses ${[...used].join(', ')}`));
121	  }
122	
123	  // A @require pointing at this repo must resolve to a file that actually
124	  // exists — a typo here installs fine and then dies at runtime, and the
125	  // manager caches the 404 body as if it were code.
126	  for (const requireUrl of s.meta.require ?? []) {
127	    if (!requireUrl.startsWith(`${RAW_BASE}/`)) {
128	      warnings.push(at(`@require ${requireUrl} is outside this repo — extra runtime dependency`));
129	      continue;
130	    }
131	    const relPath = requireUrl.slice(RAW_BASE.length + 1);
132	    if (!existsSync(join(REPO_ROOT, relPath))) {
133	      errors.push(at(`@require points at ${relPath}, which does not exist in this repo`));
134	    }
135	  }
136	
137	  // A remote @icon is a runtime dependency: favicon services return 404 for
138	  // domains they lack an icon for, which managers surface as a fetch error on
139	  // the script card. scripts/lib/icon.mjs generates a data: URI instead.
140	  const icon = first(s.meta, 'icon');
141	  if (icon && !icon.startsWith('data:')) {
142	    warnings.push(at(`@icon is a remote URL — prefer a data: URI (see scripts/lib/icon.mjs)`));
143	  }
144	
145	  // Cross-manager portability (see docs/09-managers-comparison.md).
146	  for (const api of used) {
147	    if (!PORTABLE_GM.has(api)) {
148	      warnings.push(at(`${api} is not supported by both Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey`));
149	    }
150	  }
151	  for (const [key, manager] of Object.entries(MANAGER_SPECIFIC_KEYS)) {
152	    if (s.meta[key])
153	      warnings.push(at(`@${key} is ${manager}-only — the script will not be portable`));
154	  }
155	}
156	
157	for (const w of warnings) console.warn(`warn  ${w}`);
158	for (const e of errors) console.error(`ERROR ${e}`);
159	
160	console.log(
161	  `\nChecked ${scripts.length} userscript(s): ${errors.length} error(s), ${warnings.length} warning(s).`
162	);
163	process.exit(errors.length > 0 ? 1 : 0);
164
```

```text
1	# shared/
2	
3	給多支腳本共用的工具函式，用 `@require` 引入：
4	
5	```js
6	// @require https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/shared/dom.js
7	```
8	
9	`@require` 進來的檔案會直接在腳本 scope 執行，所以裡面用的是**全域函式宣告**，
10	不是 ES module。
11	
12	## 目前有什麼
13	
14	[`dom.js`](./dom.js)
15	
16	| 函式                    | 用途                                      |
17	| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
18	| `waitForElement()`      | 等 selector 出現，有逾時保護              |
19	| `onUrlChange()`         | SPA 換頁偵測                              |
20	| `debounce()`            | 包住 MutationObserver callback            |
21	| `markOnce()`            | 用 dataset 標記處理過的節點，避免重複執行  |
22	| `addFloatingButton()`   | 右下角浮動按鈕                            |
23	| `downloadText()`        | 不需 `@grant` 的檔案下載                  |
24	
25	[`chat-export.js`](./chat-export.js) —— 三支對話匯出腳本共用的轉換層（不碰 DOM、不碰 GM）
26	
27	| 函式                  | 用途                                             |
28	| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
29	| `renderTranscript()`  | 正規化的 doc → SpecStory 風格 Markdown（含 Agent Handoff 變體） |
30	| `mergeSections()`     | 連續同 role 的訊息合併成一段                     |
31	| `fence()` / `jsonFence()` | backtick-run 感知的 code fence               |
32	| `formatUtc()` / `localIso()` | 時間格式（epoch 秒 / ISO 都吃）           |
33	| `sourcesBlock()`      | citation 去重後的來源清單                        |
34	| `filenameFor()` / `downloadText()` | 檔名與下載                          |
35	
36	[`export-ui.js`](./export-ui.js) —— 同三支腳本共用的浮動 UI
37	
38	| 函式                  | 用途                                             |
39	| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
40	| `createExportPanel()` | 右下角可拖曳的按鈕 + 面板（動作、開關、狀態列、貼 URL 輸入框） |
41	
42	`export-ui.js` **刻意不呼叫任何 GM API**：位置記憶走呼叫端注入的 `storage`。
43	因為 `scripts/check-meta.mjs` 只掃腳本本體來交叉比對 `@grant`，
44	GM 呼叫留在腳本裡，`npm run check` 才驗得到少宣告的 grant。
45	
46	## ⚠️ 先考慮直接複製
47	
48	`@require` 有兩個實際代價：
49	
50	1. **更新不同步**：`dom.js` 改了之後，各腳本的 `@version` 不會變，
51	   使用者不會收到更新通知；manager 對 `@require` 的快取也不保證馬上失效。
52	2. **多一個網路相依**：raw.githubusercontent.com 掛了，腳本就跑不起來。
53	
54	所以：**兩三個小函式，直接複製進腳本裡通常更省事。**
55	`shared/` 適合的是「好幾支腳本都要、而且邏輯夠複雜到不想複製」的東西。
56	
57	判斷標準大致是：同一段 code 出現在三支以上的腳本，才值得搬進來。
58	
59	`chat-export.js` / `export-ui.js` 就是這樣進來的：chatgpt / claude / copilot 三支 exporter
60	的 render 與浮動 UI 完全一樣（約 350 行），複製三份才是比較貴的那個選項。
61	`dom.js` 目前反而沒有腳本 `@require`，維持「範例 + 可複製」的定位。
62	
63	順帶一提，`npm run preview` **會解析 `@require`**：指向本 repo 的會直接讀工作區的檔案
64	（所以測得到還沒 commit 的 `shared/`），其他 URL 才走網路。
65	`npm run check` 也會擋「指向本 repo 但檔案不存在」的 `@require`。
66	
67	背景見 [`docs/07-dev-workflow.md`](../docs/07-dev-workflow.md#共用程式碼)。
68
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	# 09 · Manager 比較
2	
3	`userscript` 是概念本身，manager 是執行它的軟體：
4	
5	```text
6	        userscript
7	            ↑
8	┌───────────────────────┐
9	│ Tampermonkey (TM)     │
10	│ Violentmonkey (VM)    │
11	│ Greasemonkey          │
12	│ Userscripts (Safari)  │
13	└───────────────────────┘
14	```
15	
16	## 結論先講
17	
18	**本 repo 的腳本兩邊都能跑**，開發時建議：
19	
20	```text
21	主力開發        Violentmonkey   （OSS、external editor workflow 成熟）
22	相容性驗證      Tampermonkey    （順便涵蓋 Safari / iOS）
23	腳本本身        只用兩邊都有的 API，不綁任何一家
24	```
25	
26	## 對照（2026）
27	
28	|                        | **Tampermonkey**                              | **Violentmonkey**                       |
29	| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
30	| 授權                   | 2.9 之後轉為 proprietary，GitHub 只有舊版 source | **完全 open source（MIT）**             |
31	| 定位                   | polished、相容性優先、功能多                    | 輕量、developer-friendly                |
32	| Chrome / Edge / Brave / Vivaldi / Arc | ✅ MV3                       | ✅ MV3                                  |
33	| Firefox                | ✅                                             | ✅                                       |
34	| **Safari / iOS**       | **✅ 官方支援**                                | ❌ 沒有正式版                            |
35	| 內建編輯器             | 較完整（含 ESLint）                            | 刻意保持簡單，鼓勵用外部編輯器           |
36	| 外部編輯器 / 本機檔案追蹤 | ✅（較新版本加入）                            | ✅ 成熟，可設定「偵測到變更就 reload 分頁」|
37	| GM API                 | 最完整                                         | 完整（含 `GM_download`、`GM_cookie`、`GM.*` async 版）|
38	| Cloud Sync             | Drive / Dropbox / WebDAV / Browser Sync / S3   | Drive / Dropbox / OneDrive / WebDAV     |
39	| TS / bundler 官方支援  | 自己建                                         | **官方 generator（ESNext / TypeScript）**|
40	| 官方 helper libraries  | 無                                             | `@violentmonkey/dom`、`/ui`、`/shortcut`|
41	| 企業 provisioning      | ✅ OS policy                                   | 較少                                     |
42	| MCP integration        | ✅（5.5+，需額外的 Editors extension）          | 無                                       |
43	
44	## 怎麼選
45	
46	```text
47	                    你的使用方式
48	                          │
49	          ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
50	          ▼                               ▼
51	  自己寫、Git 管理、IDE            主要是裝別人寫的腳本
52	          │                               │
53	          ▼                               ▼
54	   Violentmonkey                    Tampermonkey
55	```
56	
57	再加幾條決定性因素：
58	
59	| 如果你…                          | 選              |
60	| -------------------------------- | --------------- |
61	| 想在 iPhone / iPad Safari 也用   | **Tampermonkey**（VM 沒有 Safari 版）|
62	| 在意 OSS / 可稽核                | **Violentmonkey** |
63	| 用 TypeScript + 外部 IDE 開發    | **Violentmonkey** |
64	| 需要企業 policy 部署、或想試 MCP | **Tampermonkey** |
65	| 只是想最快裝起來用               | 都行，Tampermonkey 教學最多 |
66	
67	**為什麼 OSS 在這裡比一般 extension 更值得在意**：userscript manager 本來就有
68	「讀寫任意頁面 + 執行腳本 + 跨域請求 + 剪貼簿 + 儲存」的完整權限。
69	兩個產品功能差不多時，可稽核的那個是比較自然的選擇。
70	
71	不過也不必二選一——**兩個都裝**，一個當主力、一個當相容性測試目標，
72	成本很低。
73	
74	## Chromium 系瀏覽器（Arc、Brave、Vivaldi、Edge…）
75	
76	兩者都是標準的 MV3 WebExtension，所有 Chromium 衍生瀏覽器都能從
77	Chrome Web Store 安裝，包含 **Arc**。
78	
79	⚠️ 但 Chrome 138 之後，MV3 的 User Scripts API 需要使用者主動開啟開發者模式。
80	所以**所有** Chromium 系瀏覽器（Arc 也一樣）都要：
81	
82	```text
83	開啟 <browser>://extensions
84	  → 右上角開啟 Developer mode
85	```
86	
87	沒開的話症狀是「腳本裝了，但完全沒有任何反應」。這是目前最常見的第一個坑。
88	
89	Arc 另外要注意它的 Chromium base 更新步調可能落後主線；遇到 extension 行為怪異時，
90	先拿一般 Chrome 對照一次再判斷是不是腳本的問題。
91	
92	## 寫腳本時的相容性守則
93	
94	本 repo 的所有腳本都照這幾條寫：
95	
96	1. **明寫每一個 `// @grant`**，不要靠 manager 自動推斷
97	2. **明寫 `@run-at`** —— 預設值兩邊不同（TM 是 `document-idle`，VM 是 `document-end`）
98	3. **`@updateURL` 和 `@downloadURL` 兩個都寫** —— VM 只看後者
99	4. **用底線版 GM API**（`GM_setValue`）而非 `GM.setValue`，避免 async 傳染
100	5. **避開 manager 限定的 key**：`@sandbox`（TM）、`@inject-into`（VM）、`@antifeature`
101	6. **避開 manager 限定的參數**：`GM_registerMenuCommand` 的 `accessKey`（TM 限定）；
102	   要反註冊就自己指定 `{ id: '...' }`
103	7. **少碰 `unsafeWindow` 與 sandbox 細節** —— 這是兩邊差異最大的地方
104	8. **不要用 manager 專屬的 helper**（例如 `VM.observe`、`VM.shortcut`）；
105	   它們很好用，但會把腳本綁在 Violentmonkey 上
106	
107	`npm run check` 會自動擋掉第 1、2、3、5 條，其餘靠 review。
108	
109	## 也可以考慮的其他 manager
110	
111	- **Greasemonkey**（Firefox）：這一切的老祖宗，但 GM API 較舊，新專案沒理由選它。
112	- **Userscripts**（Safari，開源）：Safari 上 Tampermonkey 之外的選擇，GM API 支援較有限。
113	
114	## 下一步
115

117

```text
## Card injection

- `CARD_SELECTORS` scans these renderer roots:
  - `ytd-rich-item-renderer`
  - `ytd-video-renderer`
  - `ytd-grid-video-renderer`
  - `ytm-shorts-lockup-view-model-v2`
  - `yt-lockup-view-model`
  - `ytd-compact-video-renderer`
  - `ytd-playlist-panel-video-renderer`  
  *(near lines 3–19)*

- `scanCards()` queries all matching renderers, processes them in reverse document order, and appends a button directly to the renderer with `card.appendChild(button)`. There is no thumbnail-specific selector or insertion point. *(near lines 530–579)*

- Video links are found through descendant `a[href]` elements. A candidate is accepted only when its URL path begins with `/watch` or `/shorts`. *(near `isVideoPath()` and `findVideoAnchorInRoot()`, roughly lines 330–370)*

- Anchor lookup checks the card’s light DOM first, then the card’s own `shadowRoot`, then its own `renderRoot` via `findVideoAnchor()`. It does not recursively traverse shadow roots belonging to descendants. *(near lines 370–385)*

## Watch-page injection

- A watch page is recognized by a `/watch` pathname or the presence of `ytd-watch-metadata`. *(near `isWatchPage()`, roughly lines 395–400)*

- Action placement tries, in order:
  - `ytd-watch-metadata #actions-inner ytd-menu-renderer #top-level-buttons-computed`
  - `ytd-watch-metadata ytd-menu-renderer #top-level-buttons-computed`
  - `ytd-watch-metadata #top-level-buttons-computed`

- If those fail, it checks `ytd-watch-metadata ytd-menu-renderer`, searches its `shadowRoot` or `renderRoot` for `#top-level-buttons-computed`, and finally creates a container inside `ytd-watch-metadata #actions-inner`. *(near `getWatchActionsContainer()`, roughly lines 455–510)*

- The watch button is inserted with `actions.prepend(button)`. `reconcileWatchButtons()` globally keeps the first matching watch button, removes later duplicates, and moves the retained one into the current action container. *(near lines 510–540)*

## Deduplication and recycled nodes

- Card-level deduplication uses the `geminiSummaryInjected` dataset flag.
- A card already containing a matching button is marked instead of receiving another.
- `hasInjectedAncestor()` prevents nested renderer matches from being independently injected when an ancestor is already marked.
- Existing buttons get hover handlers reattached during later scans.
- A recycled renderer retaining the dataset flag but losing its button is skipped permanently until page reload; this is a significant recycled-node weakness.
- The watch-page reconciliation is document-wide and assumes the first matching button is authoritative.

## SPA scanning and throttling

- A `MutationObserver` watches the whole document subtree using `"childList: true, subtree: true"`.
- Scans are trailing-throttled at `200` ms through `scheduleScan`.
- YouTube SPA events `yt-navigate-finish` and `yt-page-data-updated` also schedule scans.
- An initial scan is scheduled immediately after setup. *(near the observer/event setup, roughly lines 600–650)*

## Click and hover behavior

- Button clicks call `preventDefault()`, `stopPropagation()`, and, when available, `stopImmediatePropagation()` before sending the extension runtime message.
- Click handling is wrapped in nested `try/catch` blocks; invalidated extension contexts disable all injected buttons.
- Card hover uses delegated-style `mouseover`/`mouseout` listeners on each card. The button is shown on entry and hidden on exit unless `relatedTarget` remains inside the card. *(near `attachCardHoverHandlers()`, roughly lines 570–610)*

## Fragile assumptions

- All placement depends on YouTube’s private, frequently changing custom-element and ID structure.
- Only shallow shadow-DOM lookup is implemented.
- URL recognition accepts only paths beginning with `/watch` or `/shorts`; other valid YouTube forms are ignored.
- Cards without a currently discoverable video anchor are never injected.
- The watch fallback assumes `#actions-inner` exists and that prepending a custom container will remain compatible with YouTube’s action layout.
- Full-document mutation observation can trigger frequent scans, with correctness depending on the 200 ms throttle.
```

The path is present and correct: repository root `lib.js` on `main`.

### Exports
- `DEFAULT_PROMPT`
- `canonicalizeYouTubeUrl`
- `stripTitle`
- `buildPrompt`

### `canonicalizeYouTubeUrl` behavior

1. Parses the input with JavaScript `new URL()`. Parse failures return `null`.
2. Removes one leading `www.` from the hostname.
3. Accepted normalized hosts:
   - `youtu.be` — also `www.youtu.be`
   - `youtube.com` — also `www.youtube.com`
   - `m.youtube.com` — also `www.m.youtube.com`
   - `music.youtube.com` — also `www.music.youtube.com`
4. Accepted path forms:
   - `youtu.be/<id>`: takes the first path segment after the slash.
   - YouTube `/watch`: takes the first `v` query parameter.
   - YouTube `/shorts/<id>`, `/live/<id>`, `/embed/<id>`, or `/v/<id>`.
5. The ID must be exactly 11 characters, using only ASCII letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.
6. Successful results always become:
   `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`

### Edge cases

- Trailing path segments after a `youtu.be` ID or supported non-watch path are effectively ignored because only the first segment is captured.
- Query strings and fragments do not affect path-based extraction.
- `/watch` requires a valid `v` parameter.
- Channels, feeds, unsupported paths, other hosts, missing IDs, and invalid-length or invalid-character IDs return `null`.
- The visible code does not explicitly restrict the input protocol; hostname and path are what determine acceptance.
- Ports are not checked because validation uses `hostname`, not the full host including port.

```text
## Execution flow

- Reads `pendingGeminiPrompt` from `chrome.storage.session`.
- If absent, exits.
- Treats the item as expired only when `Date.now() - pending.ts > 600000`—a strict 10-minute TTL—and removes it.
- Does not validate the prompt object or timestamp type. Future timestamps are accepted.
- Waits up to 20 seconds, polling every 200 ms, for the first visible editor.
- Once an editor is found, removes the pending item **before** filling or submitting it.
- Therefore, any later failure loses the stored prompt and relies on the fallback toast.

## Editor detection and filling

Selectors are tried in this order:

```text
rich-textarea .ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]
.ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]
div[contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"]
div[contenteditable="true"]
textarea
```

Visibility means nonzero layout dimensions or client rectangles; it does not establish that the element is Gemini’s actual composer.

Filling behavior:

- `textarea`: assigns `.value` and dispatches a bubbling `input` event.
- Contenteditable: focuses it, runs `execCommand('selectAll')`, then `execCommand('insertText')`.
- If the element still has no non-whitespace `textContent`, assigns `textContent` directly and dispatches an `InputEvent`.
- No final check confirms that Gemini’s framework accepted or displayed the intended prompt.

The generic contenteditable and `textarea` fallbacks are especially broad and could select search fields, dialogs, or unrelated controls.

## Send detection and submission

Selectors are tried in this order:

```text
button.send-button
button[aria-label*="send" i]
button[mattooltip*="send" i]
button[data-test-id="send-button"]
```

The first visible, enabled match wins. “Enabled” only excludes the HTML `disabled` state and `aria-disabled="true"`.

Submission calls `.click()`, then additionally dispatches pointer and mouse events. It does not press Enter, associate the button with the chosen editor, or verify that a message was submitted.

The label and tooltip substring selectors are language- and DOM-dependent; none ensures the button belongs to Gemini’s composer.

## Failure, login, and fallback behavior

- No editor after 20 seconds:
  - Path beginning with `/app`: removes the pending item and displays the fallback toast.
  - Any other path: leaves the item stored for a later content-script run.
- This is not actual login detection. A loading or login state under `/app` is treated as terminal failure.
- No send button after 8 seconds: displays the toast; the item was already removed.
- Exceptions during filling, waiting, or clicking also display the toast.
- Errors outside that guarded flow, including the outer `run()` failure, are silently swallowed.

The toast contains the prompt in a read-only textarea and offers:

- **Copy**: first tries `navigator.clipboard.writeText`; on failure, selects the textarea and uses `document.execCommand('copy')`.
- **Dismiss**: removes the toast.
- Copy success is displayed without independently verifying that the clipboard write succeeded.
- A second toast is suppressed if one with the same ID already exists.
- No automatic clipboard operation occurs without the user clicking Copy.

## What counts as success

There is no genuine success detection. The code only verifies:

1. A visible editor was found.
2. A send candidate appeared and was not marked disabled.
3. The click routine completed without throwing.

It does not verify prompt contents, framework state, network activity, response creation, composer clearing, or error messages.

## Duplication prevention

The pending item is removed immediately after editor discovery, intended to “claim” it before another Gemini tab can resend it. The read and remove operations are separate, however, so simultaneous tabs or concurrent runs can both read the item before either removes it; deduplication is therefore an assumption, not an atomic guarantee.
