```text
1	# YouTube Gemini Summary
2	
3	在 YouTube 影片卡片與觀看頁一鍵開啟 Gemini，送出繁中摘要提示。
4	
5	- **生效網站**：`https://www.youtube.com/*`、`https://gemini.google.com/app*`
6	- **安裝**：[點這裡安裝](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)（需先裝好 Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）
7	- **原始碼**：[`youtube-gemini-summary.user.js`](./youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)
8	
9	## 它做了什麼
10	
11	原本的手動流程：
12	
13	```text
14	複製 YouTube URL
15	  → 開 Gemini 新對話
16	  → 輸入「總結 <URL>」
17	  → Send
18	```
19	
20	安裝後，在 YouTube 影片卡片或已開啟的影片按 **✨ Gemini** 即可完成同一件事：
21	
22	1. 從 card 或目前頁面取得 video ID。
23	2. 正規化成 `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`，去掉 playlist、timestamp 與 tracking parameters。
24	3. 用短效 GM storage 把 URL 交給新開的 `https://gemini.google.com/app`。
25	4. Gemini 載入後填入 `總結 <canonical URL>`，確認文字正確才按一次 Send。
26	5. 找不到 composer／Send 或無法確認送出時，把 prompt 複製到 clipboard，顯示人工操作 panel，不會 silent fail 或重複 click。
27	
28	它會掃描首頁、搜尋、頻道、訂閱、related videos、playlist panel 等常見 card，也認得 Shorts card。一般 watch page 的按鈕會優先放進 action row；Shorts 或找不到 action row 的 layout 則顯示右下角浮動按鈕。
29	
30	## 使用方式
31	
32	1. 先登入 [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/app)。
33	2. 在 YouTube：
34	   - 瀏覽頁：把滑鼠移到影片 card，按左上角的 **✨ Gemini**。
35	   - 已開啟影片：按 action row 或右下角的 **✨ Gemini**。
36	3. 腳本會開一個新的 Gemini 分頁並自動送出摘要請求。
37	4. 若右下角出現「無法自動完成」，prompt 已盡量複製到 clipboard；依 panel 指示貼上或手動按 Send。
38	
39	一次只開一支影片的摘要。前一個 Gemini 分頁仍在載入時，腳本會暫時拒絕覆蓋 pending request。
40	
41	## 權限與資料
42	
43	| Grant | 用途 |
44	| --- | --- |
45	| `GM_addStyle` | 顯示 YouTube 按鈕與狀態／fallback panel |
46	| `GM_setValue` / `GM_getValue` / `GM_deleteValue` | 在同一支腳本的 YouTube、Gemini matches 之間交接一筆兩分鐘內有效的 URL |
47	| `GM_openInTab` | 開啟新的 Gemini `/app` 分頁 |
48	| `GM_setClipboard` | 自動化失敗時保留可手動貼上的 prompt |
49	
50	這支腳本：
51	
52	- 不需要 Gemini API key，也不呼叫 Gemini API。
53	- 沒有 `@connect`，不對第三方 server 發 request。
54	- 不抓 transcript、title、channel 或 Gemini 對話內容；跨站只傳遞 canonical YouTube URL。
55	- 使用你已登入的 Gemini Web session；送出 prompt 後的資料處理由 Google Gemini 負責。
56	
57	## 已知限制
58	
59	- Gemini Web composer 不是公開 API，DOM selector 改版後可能需要更新。
60	- Gemini 沒有公開、受支援的 prompt-prefill deep link；本腳本必須等待並操作 composer。
61	- YouTube card 與 action row 也是 private DOM；新 renderer 可能暫時沒有按鈕或改用浮動 fallback。
62	- 需要先登入 Gemini。Pending request 兩分鐘後過期，避免舊 request 在日後意外送出。
63	- 一次只支援一筆 request，不做 queue、既有 Gemini tab reuse 或跨分頁 acknowledgement。
64	- 只注入 desktop `www.youtube.com` UI；URL parser 雖認得 mobile／Music YouTube URL，腳本不會在那些站點加入按鈕。
65	- 自動送出後若 composer 沒清空、route 也沒改變，腳本只會提示「可能未送出」，不會再按第二次 Send。
66	
67	## 手動驗證
68	
69	這個 workflow 需要 userscript manager 的跨 domain storage 與新分頁能力，`npm run preview` 只能驗 UI/selector，不能代替真實 manager。發佈前應分別在 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 測試：
70	
71	- 首頁、搜尋、頻道、related videos、playlist panel、Shorts 與 watch page。
72	- YouTube SPA 換片、infinite scroll、card recycle 後沒有 duplicate 或 stale button。
73	- 只開一個新的 Gemini `/app`，prompt URL 正確且只送出一次。
74	- Composer 或 Send selector 失效時會顯示可複製的 fallback。
75	- 已有 Gemini conversation route 不會被誤填、誤送。
76	
77	## 參考實作
78	
79	- [ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary) — YouTube renderer coverage、watch action placement、SPA events
80	- [wizdes/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary) — strict video ID canonicalization、短效 handoff、Gemini fallback UX
81
```
</details></tool-use>

153-- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
154-- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
155-- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
156-- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
157:- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

"thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

101	async function loadRequire(requireUrl) {

133	await page.waitForTimeout(600);

141	}
142	
143	const menuCaption = value('--menu');
144	if (menuCaption) {
145	  const ran = await page.evaluate((caption) => {
146	    const cmd = window.__gmMenu.find((m) => m.caption === caption);
147	    if (!cmd) return false;
148	    cmd.fn();
149	    return true;
150	  }, menuCaption);

165	const result = await page.evaluate(() => ({
166	  title: document.title,
167	  menu: window.__gmMenu.map((m) => m.caption),
168	  storage: window.__gmStore,
169	  clipboard: window.__gmClipboard,
170	}));

172	await page.screenshot({ path: outFile, fullPage: false });

176	console.log(`menu commands  : ${result.menu.length ? result.menu.join(', ') : '(none)'}`);
177	console.log(`GM storage     : ${JSON.stringify(result.storage)}`);
178	if (result.clipboard) {

181	      .split('\n')
182	      .map((l) => `  | ${l}`)
183	      .join('\n')}`
184	  );
185	}
186	if (logs.length) console.log(`\nconsole:\n${logs.join('\n')}`);
187	console.log(`\nscreenshot     : ${outFile}`);

149	    }

162	);

1	#!/usr/bin/env node
2	// Regenerate the script index table in README.md from the metadata blocks.
3	// `--check` fails instead of writing, so CI can catch a stale README.
4	import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
5	import { join } from 'node:path';
6	import { REPO_ROOT, listUserscripts, first, rawUrlFor } from './lib/meta.mjs';
7	
8	const BEGIN = '<!-- BEGIN SCRIPT INDEX -->';
9	const END = '<!-- END SCRIPT INDEX -->';
10	const README = join(REPO_ROOT, 'README.md');
11	
12	const escapePipes = (s) => s.replace(/\|/g, '\\|');
13	
14	function renderTable(scripts) {
15	  if (scripts.length === 0) {
16	    return '_目前還沒有 userscript。用 `npm run new -- <slug> "<Name>"` 建立第一個。_';
17	  }
18	  const rows = scripts.map((s) => {
19	    const name = first(s.meta, 'name') || s.slug;
20	    const desc = first(s.meta, 'description') || '';
21	    const version = first(s.meta, 'version') || '?';
22	    const sites = (s.meta?.match ?? s.meta?.include ?? [])
23	      .map((m) => `\`${escapePipes(m)}\``)
24	      .join('<br>');
25	    return `| [${escapePipes(name)}](userscripts/${s.slug}/) | ${escapePipes(desc)} | ${sites} | ${version} | [Install](${rawUrlFor(s.slug)}) |`;
26	  });
27	  return [
28	    '| Script | 用途 | 生效網站 | Version | 安裝 |',
29	    '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |',
30	    ...rows,
31	  ].join('\n');
32	}
33	
34	const scripts = listUserscripts().filter((s) => !s.missing && s.meta);
35	const table = renderTable(scripts);
36	
37	const readme = readFileSync(README, 'utf8');
38	const start = readme.indexOf(BEGIN);
39	const end = readme.indexOf(END);
40	if (start === -1 || end === -1) {
41	  console.error(`README.md is missing the ${BEGIN} / ${END} markers.`);
42	  process.exit(1);
43	}
44	
45	const next = `${readme.slice(0, start + BEGIN.length)}\n\n${table}\n\n${readme.slice(end)}`;
46	
47	if (process.argv.includes('--check')) {
48	  if (next !== readme) {
49	    console.error('README.md script index is out of date. Run: npm run index');
50	    process.exit(1);
51	  }
52	  console.log('README.md script index is up to date.');
53	} else {
54	  writeFileSync(README, next);
55	  console.log(`README.md script index updated (${scripts.length} script(s)).`);
56	}
57
```

93	page.on('console', (msg) => logs.push(`  [${msg.type()}] ${msg.text()}`));
94	page.on('pageerror', (err) => logs.push(`  [pageerror] ${err.message}`));
95	
96	/**
97	 * Resolve one @require URL to its source. URLs pointing at this repo are read
98	 * from the working tree, so `npm run preview` tests uncommitted shared/ code
99	 * instead of whatever is on main.
100	 */
101	async function loadRequire(requireUrl) {
102	  if (requireUrl.startsWith(`${RAW_BASE}/`)) {
103	    const relPath = requireUrl.slice(RAW_BASE.length + 1);
104	    return { source: readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, relPath), 'utf8'), from: `local ${relPath}` };
105	  }
106	  const res = await fetch(requireUrl);
107	  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${requireUrl} -> HTTP ${res.status}`);
108	  return { source: await res.text(), from: `remote ${requireUrl}` };
109	}
110	
111	console.log(`→ ${url}`);
112	await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
113	
114	// @run-at document-idle roughly corresponds to after load + a beat.
115	await page.addScriptTag({ content: GM_SHIM });
116	
117	// A manager evaluates every @require in the script's scope before the script
118	// itself. Do the same, or a script built on shared/ dies on the first call.
119	for (const requireUrl of script.meta.require ?? []) {
120	  let loaded;
121	  try {
122	    loaded = await loadRequire(requireUrl);
123	  } catch (err) {
124	    console.error(`@require failed: ${err.message}`);
125	    await browser.close();
126	    process.exit(1);
127	  }
128	  await page.addScriptTag({ content: loaded.source });
129	  console.log(`@require       : ${loaded.from}`);
130	}
131	
132	await page.addScriptTag({ content: readFileSync(script.file, 'utf8') });
133	await page.waitForTimeout(600);
134	
135	// Optionally drive the script the way a user would, then re-screenshot.
136	const clickSelector = value('--click');
137	if (clickSelector) {
138	  await page.click(clickSelector);
139	  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
140	  console.log(`clicked        : ${clickSelector}`);
141	}
142	
143	const menuCaption = value('--menu');
144	if (menuCaption) {
145	  const ran = await page.evaluate((caption) => {
146	    const cmd = window.__gmMenu.find((m) => m.caption === caption);
147	    if (!cmd) return false;
148	    cmd.fn();
149	    return true;
150	  }, menuCaption);
151	  if (!ran) {
152	    console.error(`No menu command named "${menuCaption}"`);
153	    await browser.close();
154	    process.exit(1);
155	  }
156	  // A menu command may be async (e.g. it has to wait for the page's own data
157	  // before it has anything to export). Resolve as soon as the clipboard is
158	  // written, or after --wait ms for commands that never touch it.
159	  await page
160	    .waitForFunction(() => window.__gmClipboard !== null, null, { timeout: waitMs })
161	    .catch(() => {});
162	  console.log(`ran menu       : ${menuCaption}`);
163	}
164	
165	const result = await page.evaluate(() => ({
166	  title: document.title,
167	  menu: window.__gmMenu.map((m) => m.caption),
168	  storage: window.__gmStore,
169	  clipboard: window.__gmClipboard,
170	}));
171	
172	await page.screenshot({ path: outFile, fullPage: false });
173	await browser.close();
174	
175	console.log(`\ndocument.title : ${result.title}`);
176	console.log(`menu commands  : ${result.menu.length ? result.menu.join(', ') : '(none)'}`);
177	console.log(`GM storage     : ${JSON.stringify(result.storage)}`);
178	if (result.clipboard) {

182	      .map((l) => `  | ${l}`)
183	      .join('\n')}`
184	  );
185	}

40	  function waitForElement(selector, { timeout = 10_000 } = {}) {
41	    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
42	      const existing = document.querySelector(selector);
43	      if (existing) return resolve(existing);
44	
45	      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
46	        const el = document.querySelector(selector);
47	        if (el) {

68	        callback(location.href);

 `./docs/03-metadata-reference.md`

```text
1	# 03 · Metadata 完整參考
2	
3	metadata block 一定要放在檔案最前面，格式固定：
4	
5	```js
6	// ==UserScript==
7	// @key    value
8	// ==/UserScript==
9	```
10	
11	manager 是**用字串比對**找這兩行的，所以：
12	
13	- 不能用 `/* */` 包起來
14	- 前面不能有其他 code（`'use strict'` 也不行）
15	- 同一個 key 可以出現多次（`@match`、`@grant`、`@require`…）
16	
17	## 身分
18	
19	| Key            | 說明                                                                 |
20	| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
21	| `@name`        | 顯示名稱。可加 `@name:zh-TW` 提供在地化名稱                           |
22	| `@namespace`   | 命名空間。`@namespace` + `@name` 才是腳本的唯一識別；建議填 repo URL   |
23	| `@version`     | 版本號。**自動更新完全靠它**，建議用 `X.Y.Z`                          |
24	| `@description` | 一句話說明，同樣支援 `@description:zh-TW`                             |
25	| `@author`      | 作者                                                                  |
26	| `@license`     | 授權                                                                  |
27	| `@icon`        | 腳本清單裡的圖示。常用 `https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?sz=64&domain=example.com` |
28	| `@homepageURL` | 專案首頁                                                              |
29	| `@supportURL`  | 回報問題的地方                                                        |
30	
31	> ⚠️ 改了 `@name` 或 `@namespace` 等於變成「另一支腳本」，manager 會當成新的裝，
32	> 舊的那支還會留著。要改的話記得手動刪掉舊的。
33	
34	## 在哪裡執行
35	
36	### `@match`（建議用這個）
37	
38	Chrome extension 的 match pattern 格式：
39	
40	```text
41	<scheme>://<host><path>
42	```
43	
44	```js
45	// @match https://chatgpt.com/*          只有這個網域
46	// @match *://*.github.com/*             所有子網域，http/https 都算
47	// @match https://example.com/user/*     限定路徑
48	// @match *://*/*                        所有網站（謹慎使用）
49	```
50	
51	規則重點：
52	
53	- host 的萬用字元只能放在**最前面**：`*.github.com` 可以，`git*.com` 不行
54	- path 一定要有，至少一個 `/`
55	- `*://*.github.com/*` **包含** `github.com` 本身
56	
57	### `@include` / `@exclude`
58	
59	`@include` 較寬鬆，支援 `*` 萬用字元甚至正規表示式：
60	
61	```js
62	// @include /^https:\/\/(www\.)?example\.com\/(a|b)\//
63	```
64	
65	彈性大但容易誤中，**預設用 `@match`**，需要正規表示式時才用 `@include`。
66	
67	`@exclude` 用來扣掉：
68	
69	```js
70	// @match   *://*.github.com/*
71	// @exclude *://gist.github.com/*
72	```
73	
74	`@exclude` 的優先度高於 `@match` 和 `@include`。
75	
76	### `@noframes`
77	
78	```js
79	// @noframes
80	```
81	
82	預設情況下，頁面裡**每一個** iframe 只要網址符合 `@match` 就會各跑一次腳本。
83	有廣告或嵌入內容的網站，腳本可能被執行十幾次。除非你真的需要在 iframe 裡動作，
84	不然一律加這行。
85	
86	## 什麼時候執行
87	
88	```js
89	// @run-at document-start   HTML 剛開始解析，DOM 幾乎是空的
90	// @run-at document-body    <body> 出現時
91	// @run-at document-end     DOMContentLoaded 時
92	// @run-at document-idle    頁面大致載入完（預設值）
93	// @run-at context-menu     只有從右鍵選單點才執行
94	```
95	
96	選法：
97	
98	| 需求                                    | 用           |
99	| --------------------------------------- | ------------ |
100	| 攔截／覆寫網站的全域物件、擋掉某些請求   | `document-start` |
101	| 一般 DOM 操作、加按鈕                    | `document-idle` |
102	| 想早一點插入 CSS 避免閃爍                | `document-start` + `GM_addStyle` |
103	
104	細節見 [05 SPA 與執行時機](./05-spa-and-timing.md)。
105	
106	## 權限
107	
108	```js
109	// @grant none                    不用任何 GM API（腳本會直接跑在頁面 context）
110	// @grant GM_setValue
111	// @grant GM_getValue
112	// @grant GM_setClipboard
113	// @grant GM_xmlhttpRequest
114	// @grant GM_addStyle
115	// @grant GM_registerMenuCommand
116	// @grant unsafeWindow            存取頁面真正的 window
117	```
118	
119	三個重點：
120	
121	1. **沒宣告的 GM API 就是 `undefined`**，會直接 `ReferenceError`。
122	2. `@grant none` 和有 grant 的**執行環境不一樣**（sandbox），見
123	   [06 Sandbox 與 unsafeWindow](./06-sandbox-and-unsafewindow.md)。
124	3. 完全不寫 `@grant`，Tampermonkey 會自己猜要給哪些 —— 但別依賴這個，明寫比較穩。
125	
126	本 repo 的 `npm run check` 會掃程式碼裡實際用到的 `GM_*`，和 `@grant` 對不起來就報錯。
127	
128	## 跨域白名單
129	
130	```js
131	// @connect chatgpt.com
132	// @connect localhost
133	// @connect *                 允許所有網域（Tampermonkey 會跳提示）
134	```
135	
136	`GM_xmlhttpRequest` 要連的網域必須在 `@connect` 列出來。
137	
138	## 外部資源
139	
140	```js
141	// @require https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dayjs@1.11.13/dayjs.min.js
142	// @resource customCSS https://example.com/style.css
143	```
144	
145	- `@require` 會在腳本執行前先載入並執行那個 JS（會被 manager 快取）
146	- `@resource` 搭配 `GM_getResourceText` / `GM_getResourceURL` 取用
147	
148	⚠️ `@require` 等於把第三方 code 拉進你的腳本權限範圍，**務必鎖版本號**，
149	不要用 `@latest`。
150	
151	## 更新與發佈
152	
153	```js
154	// @updateURL   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/you/repo/main/foo.user.js
155	// @downloadURL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/you/repo/main/foo.user.js
156	```
157	
158	- `@updateURL`：manager 定期抓這個網址，只讀 metadata 比對 `@version`
159	- `@downloadURL`：真的要更新時，從這裡抓完整腳本
160	
161	兩個通常填一樣。沒有 `@version` 的話，這兩個 key 形同虛設。
162	
163	Violentmonkey 只看 `@downloadURL`（它的文件沒有 `@updateURL`），Tampermonkey 兩個都用。
164	**兩個都寫**就能同時滿足。
165	完整說明見 [08 發佈與同步](./08-distribution-and-sync.md)。
166	
167	## 其他常用
168	
169	| Key             | 說明                                                        | 支援          |
170	| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
171	| `@top-level-await` | 允許最外層 `await`                                        | 兩者皆可      |
172	| `@noframes`     | 見上                                                         | 兩者皆可      |
173	| `@unwrap`       | 不要把腳本包在函式裡（很少用）                               | 兩者皆可      |
174	| `@antifeature`  | 誠實標示腳本含廣告／追蹤／付費功能（Greasy Fork 需要）        | TM／市集      |
175	| `@sandbox`      | 指定執行環境：`raw` / `JavaScript` / `DOM`                   | **TM 限定**   |
176	| `@inject-into`  | 指定注入 context：`page` / `content` / `auto`（預設 `auto`） | **VM 限定**   |
177	| `@exclude-match`| 用 match pattern 語法排除                                    | **VM 限定**   |
178	
179	`@sandbox` 和 `@inject-into` 是兩邊各自解決「腳本要跑在哪個 JS context」的答案，
180	見 [06 Sandbox 與 unsafeWindow](./06-sandbox-and-unsafewindow.md)。
181	
182	## 本 repo 的慣例
183	
184	每支腳本都必須有：`@name`、`@namespace`、`@version`、`@description`、`@author`、
185	`@grant`、至少一個 `@match`、以及指向正確 raw 路徑的 `@updateURL` / `@downloadURL`。
186	`npm run check` 會強制這些規則。
187	
188	## 下一步
189	
190	[04 · GM API](./04-gm-api.md)
191
```
</details></tool-use>

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="Read"><details>

 `./docs/04-gm-api.md`

```text
1	# 04 · GM API
2	
3	GM API 是 userscript **比一般網頁 JS 多出來的能力**。用哪個就要在 metadata 加對應的
4	`// @grant`，否則該函式是 `undefined`。
5	
6	## 持久化儲存
7	
8	```js
9	// @grant GM_setValue
10	// @grant GM_getValue
11	// @grant GM_deleteValue
12	// @grant GM_listValues
13	```
14	
15	```js
16	GM_setValue('lastExport', Date.now());
17	const last = GM_getValue('lastExport', 0);   // 第二個參數是預設值
18	GM_deleteValue('lastExport');
19	GM_listValues();                             // ['lastExport', ...]
20	```
21	
22	特性：
23	
24	- 值會做 JSON 序列化，可以直接存物件、陣列、boolean
25	- 綁在「腳本」上，不是網域 —— 同一支腳本在不同網站看到的是同一份資料
26	- reload、關分頁、重開瀏覽器都還在
27	- 和 `localStorage` 不同：網站清 `localStorage` 動不到它，網站也讀不到它
28	
29	適合存：設定、上次執行時間、UI 狀態、已處理過的 ID 清單。
30	
31	### 監看變化
32	
33	```js
34	// @grant GM_addValueChangeListener
35	GM_addValueChangeListener('theme', (key, oldValue, newValue, remote) => {
36	  if (remote) applyTheme(newValue);  // remote = 另一個分頁改的
37	});
38	```
39	
40	多分頁之間同步設定很好用。
41	
42	## 剪貼簿
43	
44	```js
45	// @grant GM_setClipboard
46	GM_setClipboard(markdown, 'text');
47	GM_setClipboard('<b>hi</b>', 'html');
48	```
49	
50	比 `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` 好用的地方：**不需要使用者手勢**，
51	在 `setTimeout` 或 observer callback 裡也能寫入。
52	
53	典型用途——把整段對話轉成 Markdown 丟給 coding agent：
54	
55	```text
56	ChatGPT
57	──────────────────────
58	conversation...
59	
60	                  [Copy MD]
61	```
62	
63	## 跨域請求
64	
65	```js
66	// @grant   GM_xmlhttpRequest
67	// @connect api.example.com
68	```
69	
70	```js
71	GM_xmlhttpRequest({
72	  method: 'GET',
73	  url: 'https://api.example.com/data',
74	  headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
75	  onload(res) {
76	    const data = JSON.parse(res.responseText);
77	    console.log(data);
78	  },
79	  onerror(err) {
80	    console.error(err);
81	  },
82	});
83	```
84	
85	這是 GM API 最有價值的一個：**繞過 CORS**。一般網頁的 `fetch()` 打別的網域會被擋，
86	`GM_xmlhttpRequest` 由 extension 發出，不受同源政策限制。
87	
88	⚠️ 目標網域一定要列在 `@connect`。
89	
90	Promise 版本包裝：
91	
92	```js
93	function gmFetch(options) {
94	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
95	    GM_xmlhttpRequest({ ...options, onload: resolve, onerror: reject, ontimeout: reject });
96	  });
97	}
98	
99	const res = await gmFetch({ method: 'GET', url: 'https://api.example.com/data' });
100	```
101	
102	## 選單指令
103	
104	```js
105	// @grant GM_registerMenuCommand
106	GM_registerMenuCommand('Export conversation', exportConversation);
107	```
108	
109	⚠️ 第三個參數的 options 兩邊不完全一樣（`accessKey` 是 Tampermonkey 限定）。
110	想跨 manager 就只用前兩個參數。
111	
112	不用動網站 UI 就能提供功能：
113	
114	```text
115	Tampermonkey
116	 ├─ Export conversation
117	 ├─ Copy as Markdown
118	 └─ Debug selectors
119	```
120	
121	想移除的話，**自己指定一個 id**，不要依賴回傳值：
122	
123	```js
124	// @grant GM_unregisterMenuCommand
125	GM_registerMenuCommand('Stop', stop, { id: 'stop' });
126	GM_unregisterMenuCommand('stop');
127	```
128	
129	Tampermonkey 的 `GM_registerMenuCommand` 會回傳一個 id，Violentmonkey 則是用
130	caption 或你自己給的 id 來反註冊。明確指定 id 是唯一兩邊都可靠的寫法。
131	
132	## 注入 CSS
133	
134	```js
135	// @grant GM_addStyle
136	GM_addStyle(`
137	  .ad-banner { display: none !important; }
138	  #my-panel { position: fixed; z-index: 2147483647; }
139	`);
140	```
141	
142	搭配 `@run-at document-start` 可以避免元素先閃一下才被隱藏。
143	
144	沒有 `GM_addStyle` 的環境（例如 `@grant none`）可以自己來：
145	
146	```js
147	const style = document.createElement('style');
148	style.textContent = '...';
149	document.head.appendChild(style);
150	```
151	
152	## 通知與分頁
153	
154	```js
155	// @grant GM_notification
156	GM_notification({ title: 'Done', text: '匯出完成', timeout: 3000 });
157	
158	// @grant GM_openInTab
159	GM_openInTab('https://example.com', { active: false, insert: true });
160	
161	// @grant GM_download
162	GM_download({ url: blobUrl, name: 'conversation.md' });
163	```
164	
165	## 腳本自身資訊
166	
167	`GM_info` 不需要 `@grant`：
168	
169	```js
170	console.log(GM_info.script.version);   // '1.0.0'
171	console.log(GM_info.scriptHandler);    // 'Tampermonkey' / 'Violentmonkey'
172	```
173	
174	寫「版本更新後跳一次提示」很好用。
175	
176	## `GM_*` vs `GM.*`
177	
178	較新的規範提供 Promise 版本：
179	
180	```js
181	// @grant GM.setValue
182	const value = await GM.getValue('key', 0);
183	```
184	
185	- `GM_setValue`（底線）：同步，相容性最好
186	- `GM.setValue`（點）：回傳 Promise
187	
188	本 repo 統一用底線版，理由是相容性最廣、也不用處理 async 傳染。
189	
190	## 相容性提醒
191	
192	Tampermonkey 和 Violentmonkey 的 GM API 大致相同，但不是 100%。
193	會跨 manager 分享的腳本，用之前先確認一下。
194	
195	## 下一步
196	
197	[05 · SPA 與執行時機](./05-spa-and-timing.md)
198
```

 `./docs/06-sandbox-and-unsafewindow.md`

```text
1	# 06 · Sandbox 與 unsafeWindow
2	
3	這是從 Console 轉過來最容易踩的坑：**同一段 code，在 Console 跑得好好的，
4	搬進 userscript 就 `undefined`。**
5	
6	## 為什麼
7	
8	DevTools Console 直接操作頁面的 JavaScript context。
9	userscript 則可能跑在一個**隔離的 sandbox** 裡：
10	
11	```text
12	Page JS
13	┌──────────────────────┐
14	│ window               │
15	│ React                │
16	│ app globals          │
17	│ jQuery / $           │
18	└──────────┬───────────┘
19	           │  DOM（共享）
20	───────────┼──────────────
21	           │
22	┌──────────┴───────────┐
23	│ userscript           │
24	│ sandbox window       │
25	│ GM_* APIs            │
26	└──────────────────────┘
27	```
28	
29	**DOM 是共享的**，所以這些一定沒問題：
30	
31	```js
32	document.querySelector('.foo');
33	element.remove();
34	document.body.appendChild(button);
35	new MutationObserver(fn).observe(document.body, { childList: true });
36	```
37	
38	**JS 全域不一定共享**，所以這些可能失敗：
39	
40	```js
41	window.__NEXT_DATA__;     // 可能是 undefined
42	window.$;                 // 頁面的 jQuery 看不到
43	window.myAppState;
44	```
45	
46	## 什麼時候會被 sandbox
47	
48	| `@grant`           | 執行環境                                        |
49	| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- |
50	| `@grant none`      | 直接跑在**頁面 context**，`window` 就是頁面的 window |
51	| 有任何 `@grant`    | 跑在 **sandbox**，`window` 是包裝過的            |
52	
53	所以一個常見的偵錯發現是：「我加了 `@grant GM_setValue` 之後，
54	原本能讀的 `window.something` 就壞了。」——就是這個原因。
55	
56	## unsafeWindow
57	
58	要從 sandbox 碰到真正的頁面 window：
59	
60	```js
61	// @grant unsafeWindow
62	
63	const state = unsafeWindow.__APP_STATE__;
64	unsafeWindow.myHelper = () => console.log('called from page');
65	```
66	
67	名字裡的 "unsafe" 是提醒：你正在和網站可控的物件互動。
68	網站可以覆寫任何東西，所以不要盲信從那邊拿到的值。
69	
70	Violentmonkey / Tampermonkey 都支援 `unsafeWindow`，但 sandbox 的實作細節略有差異。
71	
72	## 實務建議：多數情況根本不用碰
73	
74	如果你要做的只是：
75	
76	- 抓 DOM
77	- 加按鈕
78	- 複製 Markdown
79	- `MutationObserver`
80	
81	那完全不需要碰頁面 context。**從 DOM 讀資料通常比從 app internals 讀更穩定**——
82	網站改一次 build，內部變數名就換了；DOM 結構相對穩。
83	
84	真的需要頁面內部狀態時，優先順序：
85	
86	1. 從 DOM 讀（最穩）
87	2. 從網站的 `<script type="application/json">` 或 `__NEXT_DATA__` 之類的資料島讀
88	3. 攔截網站發出的 API 請求（見下）
89	4. 才是碰 `unsafeWindow` 的 app internals（最脆弱）
90	
91	## 攔截網站的網路請求
92	
93	想拿網站自己 API 的資料，這招比翻 DOM 好用：
94	
95	```js
96	// @run-at document-start
97	// @grant unsafeWindow
98	
99	const origFetch = unsafeWindow.fetch;
100	unsafeWindow.fetch = async function (...args) {
101	  const response = await origFetch.apply(this, args);
102	  const url = typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : args[0].url;
103	
104	  if (url.includes('/api/conversation')) {
105	    response.clone().json().then((data) => {
106	      console.log('[my-script] captured', data);
107	    });
108	  }
109	  return response;   // 一定要把原本的 response 還回去
110	};
111	```
112	
113	兩個關鍵：
114	
115	- **必須 `@run-at document-start`**，否則網站早就抓完資料了
116	- **必須用 `response.clone()`**，body 只能讀一次，讀掉了網站就壞了
117	
118	## 明確指定 context（兩邊的 key 不一樣）
119	
120	Tampermonkey：
121	
122	```js
123	// @sandbox raw          不要 sandbox，直接在頁面 context
124	// @sandbox JavaScript   標準 sandbox
125	// @sandbox DOM          只保證 DOM 可用
126	```
127	
128	Violentmonkey：
129	
130	```js
131	// @inject-into auto     預設：先試 page context，被 CSP 擋就退回 content
132	// @inject-into page     頁面 context（等同 unsafeWindow 的世界）
133	// @inject-into content  content script context（較隔離，但不受頁面 CSP 影響）
134	```
135	
136	`@inject-into content` 是 Violentmonkey 拿來解 CSP 問題的手段——網站的
137	Content-Security-Policy 擋不到 content script。Tampermonkey 沒有等價的 key。
138	
139	兩個都是 manager 限定的 key，用了就等於放棄跨 manager 相容。
140	**一般情況不必碰**：只要你的腳本靠 DOM 而不是頁面 internals，預設值就夠用。
141	
142	## 下一步
143	
144	[07 · 開發工作流](./07-dev-workflow.md)
145
```
</details></tool-use>

80	  /**
81	   * batchexecute 的回應是 `)]}'` 開頭，接著「長度行 + JSON」重複（`rt=c` 時），
82	   * 或直接就是一個陣列（沒帶 `rt` 時）。

86	   *
87	   * @returns {{ rpcid: string, payload: unknown }[]}
88	   */
89	  function parseBatchExecute(body) {
90	    const text = String(body || '').replace(/^\)\]\}'\s*/, '');
91	    const out = [];
92	
93	    // 找出每個 top-level `[...]`，中間的長度行 parse 會失敗，跳過就好。
94	    for (let i = 0; i < text.length;) {
95	      const start = text.indexOf('[', i);
96	      if (start < 0) break;
97	      const end = matchBracket(text, start);
98	      if (end < 0) break;
99	      i = end + 1;
100	
101	      let envelope;
102	      try {
103	        envelope = JSON.parse(text.slice(start, end + 1));
104	      } catch {
105	        continue;
106	      }
107	      if (!Array.isArray(envelope)) continue;
108	
109	      for (const row of envelope) {
110	        if (!Array.isArray(row) || row[0] !== 'wrb.fr' || typeof row[2] !== 'string') continue;
111	        try {
112	          out.push({ rpcid: String(row[1] || ''), payload: JSON.parse(row[2]) });
113	        } catch {
114	          /* 這格不是 JSON 就算了，別擋住其他格 */
115	        }
116	      }
117	    }

121	  /** 從 `text[start]` 的 `[` 找到對應的 `]`，會跳過字串裡的括號。找不到回 -1。 */
122	  function matchBracket(text, start) {
123	    let depth = 0;
124	    let inString = false;
125	    let escaped = false;
126	    for (let i = start; i < text.length; i += 1) {
127	      const ch = text[i];
128	      if (escaped) {
129	        escaped = false;
130	        continue;
131	      }
132	      if (ch === '\\') {
133	        escaped = true;
134	        continue;
135	      }
136	      if (ch === '"') {
137	        inString = !inString;
138	        continue;
139	      }
140	      if (inString) continue;
141	      if (ch === '[') depth += 1;
142	      else if (ch === ']') {

144	        if (depth === 0) return i;

148	  }

175	      seen.add(node);

1	/* eslint-env browser */
2	/**
3	 * 共用 DOM 工具，給 userscript 用 `@require` 引入：
4	 *
5	 *   // @require https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/shared/dom.js
6	 *
7	 * 注意這不是 ES module —— `@require` 進來的檔案會直接在腳本的 scope 執行，
8	 * 所以這裡用的是全域函式宣告。
9	 *
10	 * 先讀 shared/README.md：多數情況直接把需要的函式複製到腳本裡更省事。
11	 */
12	
13	/** 等某個 selector 出現，逾時就 reject。SPA 上最常用的一個。 */
14	function waitForElement(selector, { timeout = 10_000, root = document.documentElement } = {}) {
15	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
16	    const existing = document.querySelector(selector);
17	    if (existing) return resolve(existing);
18	
19	    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
20	      const el = document.querySelector(selector);
21	      if (el) {
22	        observer.disconnect();
23	        clearTimeout(timer);
24	        resolve(el);
25	      }
26	    });
27	    observer.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true });
28	
29	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
30	      observer.disconnect();
31	      reject(new Error(`${selector} not found within ${timeout}ms`));
32	    }, timeout);
33	  });
34	}
35	
36	/** SPA 路由變化偵測。history.pushState 不會觸發任何原生事件，所以比對 URL。 */
37	function onUrlChange(callback) {
38	  let lastUrl = location.href;
39	  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
40	    if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
41	      lastUrl = location.href;
42	      callback(location.href);
43	    }
44	  });
45	  observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
46	  return () => observer.disconnect();
47	}
48	
49	/** MutationObserver callback 幾乎都該包一層 debounce。 */
50	function debounce(fn, ms = 200) {
51	  let timer;
52	  return (...args) => {
53	    clearTimeout(timer);
54	    timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), ms);
55	  };
56	}
57	
58	/** 只做一次：已標記過的節點直接跳過。SPA 重複呼叫時的去重手段。 */
59	function markOnce(element, key) {
60	  if (element.dataset[key]) return false;
61	  element.dataset[key] = '1';
62	  return true;
63	}
64	
65	/** 右下角浮動按鈕。重複呼叫只會建立一個。 */
66	function addFloatingButton({ id, label, onClick, offset = 16 }) {
67	  const existing = document.getElementById(id);
68	  if (existing) return existing;
69	
70	  const btn = document.createElement('button');
71	  btn.id = id;
72	  btn.textContent = label;
73	  btn.style.cssText = `
74	    position: fixed; right: ${offset}px; bottom: ${offset}px; z-index: 2147483647;
75	    padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
76	    background: #3ba3ff; color: #06131f; font-weight: 600;
77	    font: 600 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
78	    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
79	  `;
80	  btn.addEventListener('click', onClick);
81	  document.body.appendChild(btn);
82	  return btn;
83	}
84	
85	/** 不需要任何 @grant 的檔案下載。 */
86	function downloadText(filename, text, mime = 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8') {
87	  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: mime }));
88	  const a = document.createElement('a');
89	  a.href = url;
90	  a.download = filename;
91	  a.click();
92	  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
93	}

Exercise script against live Gemini without submitting

```bash
node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { chromium } from '/Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs';
const source = await readFile('/Users/david/Worktrees/Tampermonkey-Scripts/feat-youtube-gemini-summary/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js', 'utf8');
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 }, bypassCSP: true });
await page.goto('https://gemini.google.com/app', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 60000 });
await page.addScriptTag({ content: `
window.__store = { 'youtube-gemini-summary.pending.v1': { videoUrl: 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ', expiresAt: Date.now() + 120000 } };
window.GM_getValue = (k, d) => k in __store ? __store[k] : d;
window.GM_setValue = (k, v) => { __store[k] = v; };
window.GM_deleteValue = (k) => { delete __store[k]; };
window.GM_setClipboard = (v) => { window.__clipboard = v; };
window.GM_addStyle = (css) => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = css; document.head.append(s); };
window.GM_openInTab = () => {};
window.__clicked = [];
const originalClick = HTMLButtonElement.prototype.click;
HTMLButtonElement.prototype.click = function() { window.__clicked.push({ label: this.getAttribute('aria-label'), cls: this.className, text: this.textContent?.trim() }); };
` });
await page.addScriptTag({ content: source });
await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
const result = await page.evaluate(() => ({
  path: location.pathname,
  editor: document.querySelector('rich-textarea .ql-editor')?.innerText,
  clicked: window.__clicked,
  pending: window.__store['youtube-gemini-summary.pending.v1'],
  clipboard: window.__clipboard,
  notice: document.getElementById('youtube-gemini-summary-notice')?.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
}));
console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
await browser.close();
EOF

  const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = ["en", "es", "hi", "ar", "tr"];
  const normalizeLanguage = (value) => {
    if (!value) {
      return "en";
    }
    const normalized = String(value).toLowerCase();
    const base = normalized.split("-")[0];
    return SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.includes(base) ? base : "en";
  };
  const getDefaultLanguage = () => {
    try {
      const uiLanguage =
        chrome?.i18n?.getUILanguage?.() ||
        navigator?.language ||
        navigator?.languages?.[0] ||
        "";
      return normalizeLanguage(uiLanguage);
    } catch (error) {
      // Fallback below.
    }
    return "en";
  };

  const getDefaultPromptTemplate = (language) => {
    switch (normalizeLanguage(language)) {
      case "tr":
        return DEFAULT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_TR;
      case "es":
        return DEFAULT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_ES;
      case "hi":
        return DEFAULT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_HI;
      case "ar":
        return DEFAULT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_AR;
      case "en":
      default:
        return DEFAULT_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_EN;
    }
  };

  const defaultLanguage = getDefaultLanguage();
  const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
    language: defaultLanguage,
    autoSend: true,
    sendDelayMs: 150,
    promptTemplate: getDefaultPromptTemplate(defaultLanguage),
  };

  let delivering = false;
  let queuedOptions = null;

  const logInfo = (...args) => console.info(LOG_PREFIX, ...args);
  const logWarn = (...args) => console.warn(LOG_PREFIX, ...args);

  const querySelectorFromList = (selectors) => {
    for (const selector of selectors) {
      const node = document.querySelector(selector);
      if (node) {
        return node;
      }
    }
    return null;
  };

  const getEditorNode = () => querySelectorFromList(EDITOR_SELECTORS);
  const getSendButton = () => querySelectorFromList(SEND_BUTTON_SELECTORS);

  const storageGet = (key) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!chrome?.storage?.local) {
        resolve({});
        return;
      }
      try {
        chrome.storage.local.get(key, (result) => {
          const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
          if (error) {
            logWarn("Failed to read storage key.", error);
            resolve({});
            return;
          }
          resolve(result || {});
        });
      } catch (error) {
        logWarn("Failed to read storage key.", error);
        resolve({});
      }
    });

  const storageRemove = (key) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!chrome?.storage?.local) {
        resolve();
        return;
      }
      try {
        chrome.storage.local.remove(key, () => resolve());
      } catch (error) {
        logWarn("Failed to remove storage key.", error);
        resolve();
      }
    });

  const getSettings = async () => {
    const result = await storageGet(SETTINGS_KEY);
    const stored = result?.[SETTINGS_KEY];
    if (stored && typeof stored === "object") {
      return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...stored };
    }
    return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS };
  };

  const getPending = async () => {
    const result = await storageGet(PENDING_KEY);
    return result?.[PENDING_KEY] ?? null;
  };

  const clearPending = async () => {
    await storageRemove(PENDING_KEY);
  };

  const renderTemplate = (template, data, language) => {
    const resolvedLanguage = normalizeLanguage(language || defaultLanguage);
    const safeTemplate =
      typeof template === "string" && template.trim().length > 0
        ? template
        : getDefaultPromptTemplate(resolvedLanguage);
    const safeData = {
      url: data?.url ?? "",
      title: data?.title ?? "",
      channel: data?.channel ?? "",
    };
    return safeTemplate.replace(
      /\{(url|title|channel)\}/g,
      (_, key) => safeData[key] ?? ""
    );
  };

  const buildPromptFragment = (prompt) => {
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    const normalized = prompt.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").replace(/\r/g, "\n");
    const lines = normalized.split("\n");
    lines.forEach((line) => {
      const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
      if (line.length === 0) {
        paragraph.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
      } else {
        paragraph.textContent = line;
      }
      fragment.appendChild(paragraph);
    });
    return fragment;
  };

  const waitForEditor = (attempts = 15, intervalMs = 400) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      let remaining = attempts;
      const check = () => {
        const editor = getEditorNode();
        if (editor) {
          resolve(editor);
          return;
        }
        remaining -= 1;
        if (remaining <= 0) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        setTimeout(check, intervalMs);
      };
      check();
    });

  const writeToEditor = (editor, prompt) => {
    try {
      if (
        editor instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement ||
        editor instanceof HTMLInputElement
      ) {
        editor.value = prompt;
        editor.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
        editor.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
        return;
      }
      if (!(editor instanceof HTMLElement)) {
        logWarn("Gemini editor element not supported.");
        return;
      }
      const fragment = buildPromptFragment(prompt);
      while (editor.firstChild) {
        editor.removeChild(editor.firstChild);
      }
      editor.appendChild(fragment);
      editor.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
      editor.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
    } catch (error) {
      logWarn("Failed to write to Gemini editor.", error);
    }
  };

  const attemptSend = (sendDelayMs, retries) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      const tryClick = (remaining) => {
        try {
          const button = getSendButton();
          const disabled =
            button?.getAttribute?.("aria-disabled") === "true" ||
            Boolean(button?.disabled);
          if (button && !disabled) {
            button.click();
            resolve(true);
            return;
          }
          if (remaining <= 0) {
            resolve(false);
            return;
          }
          setTimeout(() => tryClick(remaining - 1), 300);
        } catch (error) {
          logWarn("Failed to click Gemini send button.", error);
          resolve(false);
        }
      };

      setTimeout(() => tryClick(retries), sendDelayMs);
    });

  const runDelivery = async ({ expectedId, onlyIfAutoSend }) => {
    const settings = await getSettings();
    if (onlyIfAutoSend && !settings.autoSend) {
      return;
    }

    const pending = await getPending();
    if (!pending) {
      logInfo("No pending prompt found for Gemini.");
      return;
    }

    if (expectedId && pending.id && expectedId !== pending.id) {
      logInfo("Pending prompt ID mismatch; ignoring delivery.");
      return;
    }

    const editor = await waitForEditor();
    if (!editor) {
      logWarn("Gemini editor not found; pending prompt retained.");
      return;
    }

    const prompt = renderTemplate(
      settings.promptTemplate,
      pending,
      settings.language
    );
    writeToEditor(editor, prompt);

    if (!settings.autoSend) {
      logInfo("Auto-send disabled; prompt filled only.");
      return;
    }

    const delayMs = Number.isFinite(settings.sendDelayMs)
      ? Math.min(Math.max(settings.sendDelayMs, 0), 2000)
      : 150;
    const sent = await attemptSend(delayMs, 2);
    if (sent) {
      await clearPending();
      return;
    }

    logWarn("Gemini send button not ready; pending prompt retained.");
  };

  const scheduleDelivery = (options) => {
    if (delivering) {
      queuedOptions = options;
      return;
    }
    delivering = true;
    runDelivery(options)
      .catch((error) => {
        logWarn("Failed to deliver Gemini prompt.", error);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        delivering = false;
        if (queuedOptions) {
          const next = queuedOptions;
          queuedOptions = null;
          scheduleDelivery(next);
        }
      });
  };

  chrome.runtime?.onMessage?.addListener((message) => {
    if (message?.type !== "DELIVER_PROMPT") {
      return;
    }
    scheduleDelivery({
      expectedId: message?.payload?.id,
      onlyIfAutoSend: false,
    });
  });

  const init = () => {
    scheduleDelivery({ expectedId: null, onlyIfAutoSend: true });
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

          chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "OPEN_GEMINI", payload }, () => {
            const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
            if (error) {
              if (isExtensionContextInvalidated(error)) {
                markExtensionUnavailable();
                return;
              }
              logWarn("Failed to send OPEN_GEMINI message.", error);
            }
          });
        } catch (error) {
          if (isExtensionContextInvalidated(error)) {
            markExtensionUnavailable();
            return;
          }
          throw error;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (isExtensionContextInvalidated(error)) {
          markExtensionUnavailable();
          return;
        }
        logError("Failed to handle summary click.", error);
      }
    });

    actions.prepend(button);
  };

  const scanCards = () => {
    if (!extensionAvailable) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(CARD_SELECTORS));
      for (let index = cards.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
        const card = cards[index];
        if (!(card instanceof HTMLElement)) {
          continue;
        }
        if (card.dataset[DATASET_FLAG] === "true") {
          const existingButton = card.querySelector(`.${BUTTON_CLASS}`);
          if (existingButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
            attachCardHoverHandlers(card, existingButton);
          }
          continue;
        }
        const existingButton = card.querySelector(`.${BUTTON_CLASS}`);
        if (existingButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
          card.dataset[DATASET_FLAG] = "true";
          attachCardHoverHandlers(card, existingButton);
          continue;
        }
        if (hasInjectedAncestor(card)) {
          continue;
        }
        const url = extractUrl(card);
        if (!url) {
          continue;
        }
        createButton(card);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logWarn("Failed to scan YouTube cards.", error);
    }
  };

  const scanWatchButton = () => {
    if (!extensionAvailable) {
      return;
    }
    if (!isWatchPage()) {
      return;
    }
    const actions = getWatchActionsContainer();
    if (!actions) {
      return;
    }
    createWatchButton(actions);
  };

  const attachCardHoverHandlers = (card, button) => {
    if (!(card instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      return;
    }
    if (!(button instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) {
      return;
    }
    if (card.dataset[HOVER_BOUND_FLAG] === "true") {
      return;
    }
    card.dataset[HOVER_BOUND_FLAG] = "true";
    const getButton = () => card.querySelector(`.${BUTTON_CLASS}`);
    const show = () => {
      const activeButton = getButton();
      if (activeButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
        activeButton.classList.add(BUTTON_VISIBLE_CLASS);
      }
    };
    const hide = (event) => {
      const related = event.relatedTarget;
      if (related instanceof Node && card.contains(related)) {
        return;
      }
      const activeButton = getButton();
      if (activeButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
        activeButton.classList.remove(BUTTON_VISIBLE_CLASS);
      }
    };
    card.addEventListener("mouseover", show);
    card.addEventListener("mouseout", hide);
  };

  const scanAll = () => {
    scanCards();
    scanWatchButton();
  };

  const scheduleScan = throttle(scanAll, THROTTLE_MS);
  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => scheduleScan());
  try {
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } catch (error) {
    logWarn("Failed to observe DOM mutations.", error);
  }
  window.addEventListener("yt-navigate-finish", scheduleScan);
  window.addEventListener("yt-page-data-updated", scheduleScan);

  getSettings()
    .then((settings) => {
      applyHoverMode(settings.showButtonOnHoverOnly);
      updateLanguage(settings.language);
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      logWarn("Failed to apply hover mode from settings.", error);
      applyHoverMode(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.showButtonOnHoverOnly);
    });

  if (chrome?.storage?.onChanged) {
    chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, areaName) => {
      try {
        if (areaName !== "local") {
          return;
        }
        const updated = changes?.[SETTINGS_KEY]?.newValue;
        if (updated && typeof updated === "object") {
          if (
            Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
              updated,
              "showButtonOnHoverOnly"
            )
          ) {
            applyHoverMode(updated.showButtonOnHoverOnly);
          }
          if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(updated, "language")) {
            updateLanguage(updated.language);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        logWarn("Failed to handle settings change.", error);
      }
    });
  }

  scheduleScan();
})();

// Runs on gemini.google.com. If the service worker stashed a prompt, type it
// into Gemini's input and hit send. If Gemini's DOM has changed and we can't
// find the box, fall back to a copy-and-paste toast so it never fails silently.
(() => {
  const PENDING_KEY = 'pendingGeminiPrompt';
  const MAX_AGE_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // ignore a stash older than 10 min

  // Ordered fallbacks: first match wins, so one Google rename doesn't kill it.
  const EDITOR_SELECTORS = [
    'rich-textarea .ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]',
    '.ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]',
    'div[contenteditable="true"][role="textbox"]',
    'div[contenteditable="true"]',
    'textarea',
  ];
  const SEND_SELECTORS = [
    'button.send-button',
    'button[aria-label*="send" i]',
    'button[mattooltip*="send" i]',
    'button[data-test-id="send-button"]',
  ];

  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const isVisible = (el) => !!(el && (el.offsetWidth || el.offsetHeight || el.getClientRects().length));

  function findFirst(selectors, { mustBeEnabled = false } = {}) {
    for (const sel of selectors) {
      for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) {
        if (!isVisible(el)) continue;
        if (mustBeEnabled && (el.disabled || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true')) continue;
        return el;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function waitFor(selectors, timeoutMs, opts) {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      const el = findFirst(selectors, opts);
      if (el) return el;
      await sleep(200);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function fillEditor(editor, text) {
    editor.focus();
    if (editor.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
      editor.value = text;
      editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    // contenteditable: execCommand keeps frameworks (Quill) in sync best.
    try {
      document.execCommand('selectAll', false, null);
      document.execCommand('insertText', false, text);
    } catch {
      /* fall through */
    }
    if (!editor.textContent || !editor.textContent.trim()) {
      editor.textContent = text;
      editor.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true, data: text, inputType: 'insertText' }));
    }
  }

  function clickEl(el) {
    el.click();
    // Belt and suspenders for Material buttons that want real pointer events.
    for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'mouseup', 'pointerup']) {
      el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  function showFallbackToast(prompt) {
    if (document.getElementById('ytgs-toast')) return;
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'ytgs-toast';
    box.style.cssText = [
      'position:fixed', 'right:16px', 'bottom:16px', 'z-index:2147483647',
      'width:340px', 'max-width:calc(100vw - 32px)', 'background:#1f1f1f',
      'color:#fff', 'border:1px solid #444', 'border-radius:12px', 'padding:14px',
      'box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45)', 'font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif',
    ].join(';');
    box.innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px">Could not auto-fill Gemini</div>' +
      '<div style="opacity:.85;margin-bottom:8px">Copy this prompt and paste it (Cmd/Ctrl+V).</div>';
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.readOnly = true;
    ta.value = prompt;
    ta.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:90px;resize:vertical;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #555;background:#111;color:#eee;padding:8px;box-sizing:border-box';
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;justify-content:flex-end';
    const copy = document.createElement('button');
    copy.textContent = 'Copy';
    const dismiss = document.createElement('button');
    dismiss.textContent = 'Dismiss';
    for (const b of [copy, dismiss]) {
      b.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit';
    }
    copy.style.background = '#8ab4f8';
    copy.style.color = '#202124';
    dismiss.style.background = '#3c3c3c';
    dismiss.style.color = '#fff';
    copy.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(prompt); // user gesture → allowed
        copy.textContent = 'Copied ✓';
      } catch {
        ta.focus();
        ta.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        copy.textContent = 'Copied ✓';
      }
    });
    dismiss.addEventListener('click', () => box.remove());
    row.append(copy, dismiss);
    box.append(ta, row);
    document.body.appendChild(box);
  }

  async function run() {
    const data = await chrome.storage.session.get(PENDING_KEY);
    const pending = data[PENDING_KEY];
    if (!pending) return;
    if (Date.now() - pending.ts > MAX_AGE_MS) {
      await chrome.storage.session.remove(PENDING_KEY);
      return;
    }

    const editor = await waitFor(EDITOR_SELECTORS, 20000);
    if (!editor) {
      // No editor on a /app page means the selectors broke → show the fallback.
      // On a login/loading page, leave the stash so the post-login load retries.
      if (location.pathname.startsWith('/app')) {
        await chrome.storage.session.remove(PENDING_KEY);
        showFallbackToast(pending.prompt);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Claim it now (editor only exists on the real app page) so a second Gemini
    // tab can't re-send the same prompt.
    await chrome.storage.session.remove(PENDING_KEY);

    try {
      fillEditor(editor, pending.prompt);
      const send = await waitFor(SEND_SELECTORS, 8000, { mustBeEnabled: true });
      if (send) {
        clickEl(send);
      } else {
        showFallbackToast(pending.prompt); // filled but couldn't find send
      }
    } catch {
      showFallbackToast(pending.prompt);
    }
  }

  run().catch(() => {});
})();

// Tells the service worker the current YouTube URL so it can light up a green
// "ready" badge on the toolbar icon when you're on a video. YouTube is a single
// page app, so we report on first load and on every in-page navigation.
(() => {
  let last = null;

  function report() {
    if (location.href === last) return;
    last = location.href;
    try {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: 'YT_URL', url: location.href });
    } catch {
      // service worker asleep or extension reloading, so the next nav retries.
    }
  }

  report();
  // YouTube fires this when it finishes an in-app navigation.
  window.addEventListener('yt-navigate-finish', report, true);
  window.addEventListener('yt-page-data-updated', report, true);
  // Belt-and-suspenders for history.pushState navigations.
  window.addEventListener('popstate', report);
})();
```

const LOG_PREFIX = "[YT→Gemini]";
const GEMINI_APP_URL = "https://gemini.google.com/app";
const GEMINI_MATCH_PATTERN = "https://gemini.google.com/*";
const PENDING_KEY = "pendingPrompt";
const SETTINGS_KEY = "settings";
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
const MENU_ID = "yt-gemini-summary-link";

let currentRequestId = null;
let activeDelivery = {
  requestId: null,
  tabId: null,
  timeoutId: null,
  listener: null,
};

const logInfo = (...args) => console.info(LOG_PREFIX, ...args);
const logWarn = (...args) => console.warn(LOG_PREFIX, ...args);

function uuidv4() {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
  crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  const hex = Array.from(bytes, (byte) =>
    byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
  ).join("");
  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(
    12,
    16
  )}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
}

function isYoutubeUrl(rawUrl) {
  if (!rawUrl) {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(rawUrl);
    if (parsed.hostname !== "www.youtube.com") {
      return false;
    }
    return (
      parsed.pathname.startsWith("/watch") ||
      parsed.pathname.startsWith("/shorts")
    );
  } catch (error) {
    logWarn("Invalid URL provided.", error);
    return false;
  }
}

function storageSet(values) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      chrome.storage.local.set(values, () => {
        const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
        if (error) {
          reject(error);
          return;
        }
        resolve();
      });
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error);
    }
  });
}

function storageGet(key) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      chrome.storage.local.get(key, (result) => {
        const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
        if (error) {
          reject(error);
          return;
        }
        resolve(result || {});
      });
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error);
    }
  });
}

async function getSettings() {
  try {
    const result = await storageGet(SETTINGS_KEY);
    const stored = result?.[SETTINGS_KEY];
    if (stored && typeof stored === "object") {
      return stored;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logWarn("Failed to read settings; using defaults.", error);
  }
  return {};
}

function tabsQuery(queryInfo) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      chrome.tabs.query(queryInfo, (tabs) => {
        const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
        if (error) {
          reject(error);
          return;
        }
        resolve(tabs || []);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error);
    }
  });
}

function tabsUpdate(tabId, updateProps) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      chrome.tabs.update(tabId, updateProps, (tab) => {
        const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
        if (error) {
          reject(error);
          return;
        }
        resolve(tab);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error);
    }
  });
}

function tabsCreate(createProps) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      chrome.tabs.create(createProps, (tab) => {
        const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
        if (error) {
          reject(error);
          return;
        }
        resolve(tab);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error);
    }
  });
}

function tabsSendMessage(tabId, message) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, message, (response) => {
        const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
        if (error) {
          reject(error);
          return;
        }
        resolve(response);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error);
    }
  });
}

function clearActiveDelivery() {
  if (activeDelivery.listener) {
    chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(activeDelivery.listener);
  }
  if (activeDelivery.timeoutId) {
    clearTimeout(activeDelivery.timeoutId);
  }
  activeDelivery = {
    requestId: null,
    tabId: null,
    timeoutId: null,
    listener: null,
  };
}

async function setPendingPrompt(pending) {
  try {
    await storageSet({ [PENDING_KEY]: pending });
  } catch (error) {
    logWarn("Failed to persist pending prompt.", error);
  }
}

async function getOrCreateGeminiTab() {
  const tabs = await tabsQuery({ url: GEMINI_MATCH_PATTERN });
  const existing = tabs.find((tab) => tab && tab.id !== undefined);
  if (existing?.id !== undefined) {
    const updated = await tabsUpdate(existing.id, {
      active: true,
      url: GEMINI_APP_URL,
    });
    return updated || existing;
  }
  return tabsCreate({ url: GEMINI_APP_URL, active: true });
}

async function deliverPromptToGemini(tabId, requestId) {
  if (requestId !== currentRequestId) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    await tabsSendMessage(tabId, {
      type: "DELIVER_PROMPT",
      payload: { id: requestId },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logWarn("Failed to deliver prompt to Gemini tab.", error);
  }
}

function waitForTabComplete(tabId, requestId) {
  clearActiveDelivery();
  activeDelivery.requestId = requestId;
  activeDelivery.tabId = tabId;

  const listener = (updatedTabId, changeInfo) => {
    try {
      if (updatedTabId !== tabId) {
        return;
      }
      if (changeInfo.status === "complete") {
        clearActiveDelivery();
        deliverPromptToGemini(tabId, requestId);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logWarn("Failed to handle tab update.", error);
    }
  };

  activeDelivery.listener = listener;
  chrome.tabs.onUpdated.addListener(listener);
  activeDelivery.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
    if (requestId !== currentRequestId) {
      clearActiveDelivery();
      return;
    }
    logWarn("Gemini tab did not finish loading within timeout.");
    clearActiveDelivery();
  }, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

async function openGeminiForPayload(payload) {
  const requestId = uuidv4();
  currentRequestId = requestId;
  clearActiveDelivery();

  const pending = {
    id: requestId,
    url: payload?.url || "",
    title: payload?.title || "",
    channel: payload?.channel || "",
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  await setPendingPrompt(pending);

  let tab;
  let settings = {};
  try {
    settings = await getSettings();
  } catch (error) {
    logWarn("Failed to load settings for tab behavior.", error);
  }
  const openInNewTab = settings?.openInNewTab !== false;
  try {
    tab = openInNewTab
      ? await tabsCreate({ url: GEMINI_APP_URL, active: true })
      : await getOrCreateGeminiTab();
  } catch (error) {
    logWarn("Failed to open Gemini tab.", error);
    return;
  }

  if (!tab?.id) {
    logWarn("Gemini tab was not created.");
    return;
  }

  if (tab.status === "complete") {
    deliverPromptToGemini(tab.id, requestId);
  } else {
    waitForTabComplete(tab.id, requestId);
  }
}

chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((message, sender, sendResponse) => {
  if (message?.type !== "OPEN_GEMINI") {
    return;
  }

  openGeminiForPayload(message.payload)
    .then(() => {
      sendResponse?.({ ok: true });
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      logWarn("Failed to handle OPEN_GEMINI message.", error);
      sendResponse?.({ ok: false });
    });

  return true;
});

if (chrome.contextMenus) {
  chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(() => {
    try {
      chrome.contextMenus.removeAll(() => {
        const error = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
        if (error) {
          logWarn("Failed to reset context menus.", error);
        }
        chrome.contextMenus.create(
          {
            id: MENU_ID,
            title: "Summarize with Gemini",
            contexts: ["link"],
          },
          () => {
            const createError = chrome.runtime?.lastError;
            if (createError) {
              logWarn("Failed to create context menu.", createError);
            }
          }
        );
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logWarn("Failed to initialize context menus.", error);
    }
  });

  chrome.contextMenus.onClicked.addListener((info) => {
    try {
      if (info.menuItemId !== MENU_ID) {
        return;
      }
      if (!isYoutubeUrl(info.linkUrl)) {
        return;
      }
      openGeminiForPayload({ url: info.linkUrl, title: "", channel: "" });
    } catch (error) {
      logWarn("Failed to handle context menu click.", error);
    }
  });
} else {
  logInfo("Context menus API not available; permission not granted.");
}

chrome.commands?.onCommand?.addListener((command) => {
  if (command !== "summarize-with-gemini") {
    return;
  }
  tabsQuery({ active: true, currentWindow: true })
    .then((tabs) => {
      const activeTab = tabs?.[0];
      if (!activeTab?.url || !isYoutubeUrl(activeTab.url)) {
        return;
      }
      openGeminiForPayload({
        url: activeTab.url,
        title: activeTab.title || "",
        channel: "",
      });
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      logWarn("Failed to handle command.", error);
    });
});

```text
// Service worker (module). On toolbar click: if the active tab is a YouTube
// video, build the prompt, stash it, and open Gemini. The content script picks
// it up there.
import { canonicalizeYouTubeUrl, stripTitle, buildPrompt, DEFAULT_PROMPT } from './lib.js';

const PENDING_KEY = 'pendingGeminiPrompt';

// session storage is TRUSTED_CONTEXTS-only by default; the content script runs
// in an untrusted context, so widen access or it can't read the prompt.
async function ensureSessionAccess() {
  try {
    await chrome.storage.session.setAccessLevel({
      accessLevel: 'TRUSTED_AND_UNTRUSTED_CONTEXTS',
    });
  } catch {
    // Older Chrome without setAccessLevel: the content script still reads in many
    // builds; the clipboard fallback covers the rest.
  }
}
ensureSessionAccess();
chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(ensureSessionAccess);
chrome.runtime.onStartup?.addListener(ensureSessionAccess);

async function flashBadge(tabId, text) {
  try {
    await chrome.action.setBadgeBackgroundColor({ tabId, color: '#E62117' });
    await chrome.action.setBadgeText({ tabId, text });
    setTimeout(() => chrome.action.setBadgeText({ tabId, text: '' }).catch(() => {}), 2500);
  } catch {
    // tab may be gone; ignore.
  }
}

// Toolbar icon variants: plain, and one with a small green "ready" dot baked in.
// We swap the whole icon per-tab (Chrome's native badge can't be made a subtle
// circle), so the dot only shows on tabs that are on a YouTube video.
const ICON_OFF = { 16: 'icons/icon16.png', 48: 'icons/icon48.png', 128: 'icons/icon128.png' };
const ICON_ON = { 16: 'icons/icon16-on.png', 48: 'icons/icon48-on.png', 128: 'icons/icon128-on.png' };

async function setReadyIcon(tabId, ready) {
  try {
    await chrome.action.setIcon({ tabId, path: ready ? ICON_ON : ICON_OFF });
  } catch {
    // tab gone / icon missing; ignore.
  }
}

// The YouTube content script reports the current URL; show the green dot when
// it's a video we can summarize.
chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg, sender) => {
  if (msg?.type === 'YT_URL' && sender.tab?.id != null) {
    setReadyIcon(sender.tab.id, !!canonicalizeYouTubeUrl(msg.url));
  }
});

// First install: Chrome has no API to pin an extension, so open a short page
// that tells the user how to pin it and confirms it's ready.
chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener((details) => {
  if (details.reason === 'install') {
    chrome.tabs.create({ url: chrome.runtime.getURL('welcome.html') }).catch(() => {});
  }
});

chrome.action.onClicked.addListener(async (tab) => {
  const canonical = canonicalizeYouTubeUrl(tab?.url || '');
  if (!canonical) {
    await flashBadge(tab?.id, 'YT?');
    return;
  }

  const title = stripTitle(tab.title);
  const stored = await chrome.storage.sync.get('instructions');
  const prompt = buildPrompt(stored.instructions || DEFAULT_PROMPT, title, canonical);

  await ensureSessionAccess();
  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [PENDING_KEY]: { prompt, ts: Date.now() } });
  await chrome.tabs.create({ url: 'https://gemini.google.com/app' });
});
```
</details></tool-use>

The resulting prompt is, however, deliberately submitted to Google Gemini.\n\n**Unknown:** the Store-linked external policy at [ipekbayrak.com.tr/privacy-policy](https://ipekbayrak.com.tr/privacy-policy) did not expose extension-specific policy content during this research.\n\n### YouTube surfaces\n\n**Verified selectors in current [`youtube.js`](https://github.com/ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/src/content/youtube.js):**\n\n```text\nytd-rich-item-renderer\nytd-video-renderer\nytd-grid-video-renderer\nytm-shorts-lockup-view-model-v2\nyt-lockup-view-model\nytd-compact-video-renderer\nytd-playlist-panel-video-renderer\n```\n\nIt also injects into the watch-page action row using variants of:\n\n```text\nytd-watch-metadata … #top-level-buttons-computed\nytd-watch-metadata #actions-inner\n```\n\nIt observes the SPA using a throttled `MutationObserver`, `yt-navigate-finish`, and `yt-page-data-updated`.\n\n**Inference, not an end-to-end guarantee:** these renderer types plausibly cover home feeds, search results, channel grids, Shorts shelves, related-video sidebars, playlist panels, and watch pages. No current automated browser test proves every named route, and YouTube can alter renderer structure independently. The transcript’s “homepage/search/channel/Shorts/video page” claim is reasonable but stronger than the evidence.\n\n### Handoff, injection, and submission\n\nThe architecture is:\n\n1. YouTube script extracts URL/title/channel.\n2. Service worker saves `{id,url,title,channel,createdAt}` as `pendingPrompt` in `chrome.storage.local`.\n3. It opens a new Gemini tab by default, or reloads/reuses one if configured.\n4. Gemini content script renders the saved prompt template and manipulates the composer DOM.\n5. It optionally finds and clicks Send.\n\nCurrent editor fallbacks include:\n\n```text\n.ql-editor.textarea.new-input-ui[contenteditable=\"true\"]\n.ql-editor[contenteditable=\"true\"]\ndiv[contenteditable=\"true\"][role=\"textbox\"]\ndiv[contenteditable=\"true\"][aria-label*=\"prompt\" i]\ntextarea[aria-label*=\"prompt\" i]\n```\n\nSend fallbacks include:\n\n```text\nbutton.send-button.submit\nbutton[aria-label*=\"send\" i]\nbutton[type=\"submit\"]\n```\n\nThe editor is polled for roughly six seconds. Submission uses a configurable 0–2000 ms delay and up to three button checks.\n\n### Configuration and failures\n\n**Verified configuration in `chrome.storage.local`:**\n\n- Five built-in languages: English, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish\n- Custom `{title}`, `{channel}`, `{url}` template\n- Auto-submit\n- New/reused tab\n- Hover-only controls\n- Send delay\n\nThere is **no built-in Traditional Chinese option**; a user can still write a Traditional Chinese custom template.\n\n**Failure behavior:**\n\n- Missing editor or send button: retains the pending request and writes only a console warning.\n- Signed-out/login flow: retained pending state can be retried on a later Gemini load.\n- Invalidated extension context: disables YouTube buttons until reload.\n- No visible clipboard/toast fallback.\n- If auto-submit is disabled, the script fills the composer but leaves `pendingPrompt` stored.\n- A write failure is swallowed before submission logic, so the code does not positively verify that the intended text reached the editor before clicking Send.\n\nThus the transcript correctly attributes clipboard fallback only to the second extension, not this one.\n\n---\n\n## 3. `wizdes/yt-gemini-summary`\n\n### Matching source and permissions\n\nThe Store listing directly links [`wizdes/yt-gemini-summary`](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary), and the name, version, workflow, prompt editor, ready indicator, and fallback all match. This is the discoverable second source repository.\n\nIts [manifest](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/manifest.json) requests:\n\n- `storage`\n- `activeTab`\n- `clipboardWrite`\n- Host access to:\n  - `https://www.youtube.com/*`\n  - `https://m.youtube.com/*`\n  - `https://gemini.google.com/*`\n\nThe Store says the developer does not collect or use user data and gives the same three no-sale/no-unrelated-use/no-credit certifications.\n\n### Privacy discrepancy\n\nThe source contains no apparent analytics, ads, or developer server, and the policy correctly acknowledges that title/link are sent to Google Gemini.\n\nHowever, its [privacy policy](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) says the saved prompt lives locally/on-device, while [`options.js`](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/options.js) actually uses `chrome.storage.sync`.\n\nAccording to Chrome’s official [Storage API documentation](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/reference/api/storage), `storage.sync` synchronizes to the user’s other signed-in Chrome instances when Chrome Sync is enabled. Therefore:\n\n- “Nothing is sent to the developer” is consistent with source.\n- “Only on this device” is inaccurate unless Chrome Sync is disabled.\n- The built prompt handoff itself uses memory-only `chrome.storage.session`, which is cleared on browser restart, extension reload/update, or disable.\n\n### YouTube surface and URL handling\n\nThis extension deliberately avoids YouTube renderer selectors:\n\n- [`content-youtube.js`](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/content-youtube.js) only reports URL changes so the toolbar icon can show a green ready dot.\n- The toolbar click reads the active tab’s URL/title.\n- On a search/home/channel page, clicking does nothing except show `YT?`.\n- It does not inject controls into thumbnails, cards, or the watch-page action row.\n\nIts pure URL helper accepts strict 11-character IDs from:\n\n- `/watch?v=`\n- `youtu.be`\n- `/shorts/`\n- `/live/`\n- `/embed/`\n- `/v/`\n- mobile and music hosts\n\nIt canonicalizes them to `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ID` and removes playlist, timestamp, and tracking parameters. Tests cover these cases in [`test/lib.test.mjs`](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/test/lib.test.mjs).\n\n### Handoff, injection, submission, and fallback\n\nThe [background worker](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/background.js):\n\n1. Reads custom instructions from `chrome.storage.sync`.\n2. Appends the cleaned title and canonical URL.\n3. Saves `{prompt,ts}` in `chrome.storage.session`.\n4. Always opens `https://gemini.google.com/app`.\n\nThe [Gemini script](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary/blob/main/content-gemini.js) waits up to 20 seconds for these visible editor candidates:\n\n```text\nrich-textarea .ql-editor[contenteditable=\"true\"]\n.ql-editor[contenteditable=\"true\"]\ndiv[contenteditable=\"true\"][role=\"textbox\"]\ndiv[contenteditable=\"true\"]\ntextarea\n```\n\nIt fills with `execCommand('insertText')`, falling back to `textContent` plus an input event. It then waits up to eight seconds for:\n\n```text\nbutton.send-button\nbutton[aria-label*=\"send\" i]\nbutton[mattooltip*=\"send\" i]\nbutton[data-test-id=\"send-button\"]\n```\n\nSubmission is always automatic; there is no auto-submit toggle or delay setting.\n\nPending state expires after ten minutes. Once an editor is found, it is removed **before** filling/submitting, preventing another Gemini tab from duplicating the request.\n\nIf injection or submission fails, it shows a toast with a read-only textarea plus **Copy** and **Dismiss**. Correction to the transcript/listing shorthand: it does not automatically write to the clipboard; clipboard access occurs only when the user presses Copy.\n\nOne concern is the very broad late fallback `div[contenteditable=\"true\"]`, which could select the wrong editor if Gemini introduces another visible contenteditable element.\n\nThe README’s assertion that private/unlisted videos “fall back to the title and transcript” is **not implemented by this extension**: it does not obtain a transcript. That behavior, if it occurs at all, would belong to Gemini Web and was not verified in Google’s Apps documentation.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Gemini claims from the transcript\n\n### Verified\n\n- Gemini Apps officially supports finding YouTube videos/playlists/channels and answering questions about their content. It requires sign-in and Activity enabled ([Gemini Apps Help](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16622858?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en)).\n- The Gemini API explicitly accepts a public YouTube URL as a video input. The current documentation marks this **Preview**, allows up to ten videos for Gemini 2.5+, lists an eight-hour/day free-tier YouTube allowance, and says the paid tier has no limit based specifically on video length ([video-understanding documentation](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video-understanding)).\n- API video understanding uses sound and imagery and supports timestamp questions.\n\n### Overstated or unverified\n\n- The Apps help page does **not** document “paste any YouTube URL” as its prescribed workflow or provide a public/unlisted/private compatibility matrix. Therefore, the transcript’s conclusion that the user’s exact pasted-URL workflow is officially guaranteed goes beyond the cited Apps documentation.\n- The API’s explicit URL support does not establish equivalent contractual behavior for the signed-in Gemini Web UI. API keys, quotas, billing, and endpoints are a separate integration path.\n\n### Prompt-prefill deep link\n\nNo current official Gemini Apps help page located in this research documents a prompt-bearing URL such as:\n\n```text\nhttps://gemini.google.com/app?prompt=...\n```\n\nThe official [Gemini usage page](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13275745?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en) documents opening Gemini, entering a prompt, and starting a new chat, but no `prompt`, `q`, launch, or prefill parameter.\n\nThis verifies the narrower claim **“there is no documented, supported prompt-prefill deep link.”** Absence from public documentation cannot prove that no internal or experimental scheme exists.\n\nThird-party projects such as [`gaiar/gemini-url-prompt`](https://github.com/gaiar/gemini-url-prompt) accept `?prompt=` or `?q=`, but only because their own content script reads that parameter and injects it into Gemini. That is a workaround, not native Gemini behavior.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Lessons for a minimal cross-manager userscript MVP\n\nUse the wizdes architecture as the baseline, not ipek’s full surface coverage:\n\n1. **One userscript, two matches:** YouTube and Gemini. Use per-script GM storage for the handoff; no service worker or backend is needed.\n2. **Start only on current `/watch` and `/shorts` pages.** Add a small fixed button or `GM_registerMenuCommand`. Do not initially support seven thumbnail/card renderers.\n3. **Canonicalize the video ID.** Preserve only the 11-character ID and remove playlist/tracking/time parameters.\n4. **Persist two separate classes of state:**\n   - Long-lived preferences: Traditional Chinese prompt template and optional auto-submit.\n   - Short-lived handoff: `{id,prompt,createdAt}`, with a five- or ten-minute TTL.\n5. **Open plain `https://gemini.google.com/app`.** Do not depend on an undocumented query parameter.\n6. **Prefill first; make auto-submit opt-in.** Manual Send removes the most fragile selector and reduces accidental submission. If enabled later, require visible/enabled controls and verify composer text first.\n7. **Centralize ordered Gemini selectors.** Prefer specific Quill/role selectors; avoid accepting a generic `div[contenteditable]` without validating its role/ancestor.\n8. **Never fail silently.** On timeout, show the complete prompt in a selectable toast with a user-initiated Copy button.\n9. **Handle login and duplication explicitly:** retain pending state on a login route; claim/delete it only after finding the intended composer; show fallback if fill/send then fails.\n10. **Keep grants minimal:** storage, deletion, and optionally menu/open-tab APIs. No `GM_xmlhttpRequest`, Gemini API key, transcript pipeline, analytics, or remote code.\n11. **Test Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey separately:** legacy `GM_*` storage calls are synchronous in those managers, while `GM.*` storage APIs are Promise-based. A tiny wrapper prevents API-style differences ([Tampermonkey docs](https://www.tampermonkey.net/documentation.php?locale=en&q=GM_values), [Violentmonkey API](https://violentmonkey.github.io/api/gm/)).\n12. **Defer full-product features:** homepage/search overlays, channel extraction, tab reuse, language selector UI, delay slider, multiple presets, transcript extraction, and Gemini API support.\n\nThis MVP retains the user’s existing Gemini Web account/session and provides the desired Traditional Chinese prompt while limiting maintenance to one YouTube route check, a small handoff state machine, and Gemini’s composer selectors.\n\n## Inaccessible or unknown\n\n- Exact byte-level contents of both Chrome Web Store packages.\n- Whether current signed-in Gemini DOM automation succeeds in every account/UI experiment; no authenticated browser test was performed.\n- Public install history or active-user telemetry beyond the Store’s displayed “users.”\n- Permission-warning prose, which was absent from accessible Store page content; requested permissions were verified from source manifests.\n- Any undocumented internal Gemini prefill scheme.\n- Extension-specific content of ipek’s externally hosted Store privacy-policy URL."

for(const q of ['music playlist','javascript course playlist','lofi playlist']){const p=await b.newPage({viewport:{width:1280,height:800}});await p.goto('https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query='+encodeURIComponent(q),{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await p.waitForTimeout(5000);const d=await p.evaluate(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('yt-lockup-view-model')].map((e,i)=>({i,rect:[e.getBoundingClientRect().x,e.getBoundingClientRect().y,e.getBoundingClientRect().width,e.getBoundingClientRect().height],ancestor:e.parentElement?.closest('ytd-rich-item-renderer,ytd-video-renderer,ytd-grid-video-renderer,ytm-shorts-lockup-view-model-v2,yt-lockup-view-model,ytd-compact-video-renderer,ytd-playlist-panel-video-renderer')?.tagName||'',text:(e.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,200),anchors:[...e.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].slice(0,12).map(a=>({href:a.getAttribute('href'),text:(a.innerText||a.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,60),aria:a.getAttribute('aria-label')}))})));console.log(q,JSON.stringify(d.slice(0,20),null,2));await p.close()}await b.close();
