64559	
64560	```text
64561	1	# YouTube Gemini Summary
64562	2	
64563	3	在 YouTube 影片卡片與觀看頁一鍵開啟 Gemini，送出繁中摘要提示。
64564	4	
64565	5	- **生效網站**：`https://www.youtube.com/*`、`https://gemini.google.com/app*`
64566	6	- **安裝**：[點這裡安裝](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)（需先裝好 Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）
64567	7	- **原始碼**：[`youtube-gemini-summary.user.js`](./youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)
64568	8	
64569	9	## 它做了什麼
64570	10	
64571	11	原本的手動流程：
64572	12	
64573	13	```text
64574	14	複製 YouTube URL
64575	15	  → 開 Gemini 新對話
64576	16	  → 輸入「總結 <URL>」
64577	17	  → Send
64578	18	```
64579	19	
64580	20	安裝後，在 YouTube 影片卡片或已開啟的影片按 **✨ Gemini** 即可完成同一件事：
64581	21	
64582	22	1. 從 card 或目前頁面取得 video ID。
64583	23	2. 正規化成 `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`，去掉 playlist、timestamp 與 tracking parameters。
64584	24	3. 用短效 GM storage 保存 URL，再以 URL fragment 裡的 random request ID 指定剛開出的 `https://gemini.google.com/app` 分頁；prompt 本身不放進 URL。
64585	25	4. Gemini 載入後填入 `總結 <canonical URL>`，確認文字正確才按一次 Send。
64586	26	5. 找不到 composer／Send、輸入框已有草稿或無法確認送出時，把 prompt 複製到 clipboard，顯示人工操作 panel，不會 silent fail、覆寫草稿或重複 click。
64587	27	
64588	28	它會掃描首頁、搜尋、頻道、訂閱、related videos、playlist panel 等常見 card，也認得 Shorts card；playlist/course collection card 不會誤用第一支 lesson。一般 watch／live page 的按鈕會優先放進 action row；Shorts 或找不到 action row 的 layout 則顯示右下角浮動按鈕。
64589	29	
64590	30	## 使用方式
64591	31	
64592	32	1. 先登入 [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/app)。
64593	33	2. 在 YouTube：
64594	34	   - 瀏覽頁：把滑鼠移到影片 card，按左上角的 **✨ Gemini**。
64595	35	   - 已開啟影片：按 action row 或右下角的 **✨ Gemini**。
64596	36	3. 腳本會開一個新的 Gemini 分頁並自動送出摘要請求。
64597	37	4. 若右下角出現「無法自動完成」，prompt 已盡量複製到 clipboard；依 panel 指示貼上或手動按 Send。
64598	38	
64599	39	一次只開一支影片的摘要。前一個 Gemini 分頁仍在載入時，腳本會暫時拒絕覆蓋 pending request。
64600	40	
64601	41	## 權限與資料
64602	42	
64603	43	| Grant | 用途 |
64604	44	| --- | --- |
64605	45	| `GM_addStyle` | 顯示 YouTube 按鈕與狀態／fallback panel |
64606	46	| `GM_setValue` / `GM_getValue` / `GM_deleteValue` | 在同一支腳本的 YouTube、Gemini matches 之間交接一筆兩分鐘內有效的 URL |
64607	47	| `GM_openInTab` | 開啟新的 Gemini `/app` 分頁 |
64608	48	| `GM_setClipboard` | 自動化失敗時保留可手動貼上的 prompt |
64609	49	
64610	50	這支腳本：
64611	51	
64612	52	- 不需要 Gemini API key，也不呼叫 Gemini API。
64613	53	- 沒有 `@connect`，不對第三方 server 發 request。
64614	54	- 不抓 transcript、title、channel 或 Gemini 對話內容；GM storage 只交接 canonical YouTube URL 與短效 request metadata。
64615	55	- 新分頁 URL fragment 只含 random request ID，不含 video URL 或 prompt；瀏覽器的 HTTP request 不會攜帶 fragment。
64616	56	- 使用你已登入的 Gemini Web session；送出 prompt 後的資料處理由 Google Gemini 負責。
64617	57	
64618	58	## 已知限制
64619	59	
64620	60	- Gemini Web composer 不是公開 API，DOM selector 改版後可能需要更新。
64621	61	- Gemini 沒有公開、受支援的 prompt-prefill deep link；本腳本必須等待並操作 composer。
64622	62	- YouTube card 與 action row 也是 private DOM；新 renderer 可能暫時沒有按鈕或改用浮動 fallback。
64623	63	- 需要先登入 Gemini。Pending request 兩分鐘後過期，避免舊 request 在日後意外送出。
64624	64	- 一次只支援一筆 request，不做 queue、既有 Gemini tab reuse 或跨分頁 acknowledgement；random ID 只負責避免其他 `/app` tab 搶走這一筆。
64625	65	- 只注入 top-level desktop `www.youtube.com` UI；URL parser 雖認得 mobile／Music YouTube URL，腳本不會在那些站點或 iframe 加入按鈕。
64626	66	- Gemini `/app` 若恢復了未送出的草稿，腳本不會覆寫，而會保留草稿並退回人工操作。
64627	67	- 自動 click 後若原 composer 沒清空，腳本只會提示「可能未送出」，不以 route change 當成功，也不按第二次 Send。
64628	68	
64629	69	## 手動驗證
64630	70	
64631	71	這個 workflow 需要 userscript manager 的跨 domain storage 與新分頁能力，`npm run preview` 只能驗 UI/selector，不能代替真實 manager。發佈前應分別在 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 測試：
64632	72	
64633	73	- 首頁、搜尋、頻道、related videos、playlist panel、Shorts、watch 與 live page。
64634	74	- YouTube SPA 換片、infinite scroll、card recycle 後沒有 duplicate 或 stale button。
64635	75	- 只開一個新的 Gemini `/app`，prompt URL 正確且只送出一次。
64636	76	- Composer 或 Send selector 失效時會顯示可複製的 fallback。
64637	77	- 已有 Gemini conversation route 不會被誤填、誤送。
64638	78	
64639	79	## 參考實作
64640	80	
64641	81	- [ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary) — YouTube renderer coverage、watch action placement、SPA events
64642	82	- [wizdes/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary) — strict video ID canonicalization、短效 handoff、Gemini fallback UX
64643	83
64644	```

64822	+## Userscript + manager vs. 自製 Chrome extension
64823	+
64824	+Chrome extension 不是單純「更正式的 userscript」。兩者都能修改網頁，但技術形狀不同：
64825	+
64826	+- **Tampermonkey／Violentmonkey 本身才是 extension**；`.user.js` 是交給 manager 代管與執行的腳本。
64827	+- **自製 extension 是獨立的 browser application**；它有自己的 manifest、execution contexts、權限、UI 與發佈生命週期。
64828	+
64829	+```text
64830	+Userscript 路線
64831	+.user.js → userscript manager（extension）→ browser
64832	+
64833	+自製 extension 路線
64834	+manifest + content script + service worker／UI → browser
64835	+```
64836	+
64837	+|                | Userscript + manager                                              | 自製 Chrome extension                                                                          |
64838	+| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
64839	+| 最小專案       | 一個 `.user.js` + metadata                                        | `manifest.json` + content script；視需求再加 service worker、popup、options、side panel、icons |
64840	+| 執行位置       | manager sandbox 裡操作 matched page 的 DOM                        | content script、extension page、service worker 分開，彼此通常要 message passing                |
64841	+| Browser API    | 兩邊 manager 都有的 portable `GM_*` subset                        | 較完整的 `chrome.*`，例如 toolbar、context menu、side panel、bookmarks、native messaging       |
64842	+| 持久設定       | `GM_setValue`，由 manager 依 script identity 保存                 | `chrome.storage.local`／`sync`；暫存資料另有 `storage.session`                                 |
64843	+| 跨站協作       | 同一支 script 的 GM storage 可跨它的多個 `@match` 共用            | 多支 content script 通常透過 service worker／extension storage 傳遞                            |
64844	+| Portability    | 同一檔可同時支援 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 與多種 browser       | Chrome MV3 為主要目標；移植其他 browser 仍要檢查 API 與 packaging                              |
64845	+| 安裝／發佈     | Raw `.user.js`、腳本市集、`@updateURL`                            | Unpacked package、Chrome Web Store、enterprise distribution                                    |
64846	+| Trust boundary | Manager 有廣泛權限；每一支安裝的 script 也要獨立審查              | Extension package、publisher 與 manifest permissions                                           |
64847	+| 適合情境       | 少量 matched pages 的 DOM enhancement、個人／小團隊工具、快速迭代 | 完整 browser UI、背景事件、複雜跨 context 架構、產品化與 Store distribution                    |
64848	+
64849	+### 兩邊都能有持久化 config
64850	+
64851	+「Extension 可以保存設定，userscript 不行」是誤解。`GM_setValue` 的資料綁在**腳本**而非網域；同一支腳本在 YouTube 與 Gemini 都看得到，而且 reload、關分頁、重開 browser 後仍在。網站自己的 JavaScript 也讀不到這份 storage。完整 API 見 [04 GM API](./04-gm-api.md#持久化儲存)。
64852	+
64853	+Extension 則要明確選 storage：
64854	+
64855	+- `chrome.storage.local`：保留在這個 browser profile。
64856	+- `chrome.storage.sync`：啟用 Chrome Sync 時可同步到其他登入裝置，但有 quota。
64857	+- `chrome.storage.session`：只適合 browser session 內的短效資料。
64858	+- **Service worker 的 global variable 不算 storage**；worker 隨時可能被暫停，記憶體狀態會消失。
64859	+
64860	+兩條路線預設都不是「全世界共用設定」：userscript 要另外開 manager sync，extension 要選 `storage.sync` 並依賴 browser account/sync 設定。
64861	+
64862	+### 什麼時候升級成 extension
64863	+
64864	+像「YouTube 按一下 → 用短效 GM storage 交給 Gemini」這種 workflow，userscript 已經有足夠能力，做 extension 只會先增加 manifest、service worker 與 message passing。
64865	+
64866	+當需求核心變成以下能力，再升級比較值得：
64867	+
64868	+- Toolbar badge、context menu、side panel 或 omnibox
64869	+- Page 不開著也要接 browser-level background events
64870	+- Bookmarks、history、downloads、native messaging 等 extension APIs
64871	+- 多個 content scripts 與完整 options UI
64872	+- 需要 Chrome Web Store review、enterprise policy 或一般使用者的一鍵安裝體驗
64873	+
64874	+相關細節不用全塞在這一篇：metadata 與權限見 [03](./03-metadata-reference.md)，sandbox 見 [06](./06-sandbox-and-unsafewindow.md)，開發與升級成本見 [07](./07-dev-workflow.md)，發佈見 [08](./08-distribution-and-sync.md)，manager 選擇見 [09](./09-managers-comparison.md)，安全與第三方 script 審查見 [12](./12-security.md)。
64875	+
64876	 ## 下一步
64877	 
64878	 [02 · 第一支腳本](./02-getting-started.md)
64879	```

66070	1	# YouTube Gemini Summary
66071	2	
66072	3	在 YouTube 影片卡片與觀看頁一鍵開啟 Gemini，送出繁中摘要提示。
66073	4	
66074	5	- **生效網站**：`https://www.youtube.com/*`、`https://gemini.google.com/app*`
66075	6	- **安裝**：[點這裡安裝](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)（需先裝好 Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）
66076	7	- **原始碼**：[`youtube-gemini-summary.user.js`](./youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)
66077	8	
66078	9	## 它做了什麼
66079	10	
66080	11	原本的手動流程：
66081	12	
66082	13	```text
66083	14	複製 YouTube URL
66084	15	  → 開 Gemini 新對話
66085	16	  → 輸入「總結 <URL>」
66086	17	  → Send
66087	18	```
66088	19	
66089	20	安裝後，在 YouTube 影片卡片或已開啟的影片按 **✨ Gemini** 即可完成同一件事：
66090	21	
66091	22	1. 從 card 或目前頁面取得 video ID。
66092	23	2. 正規化成 `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`，去掉 playlist、timestamp 與 tracking parameters。
66093	24	3. 用短效 GM storage 保存 URL，再以 URL fragment 裡的 random request ID 指定剛開出的 `https://gemini.google.com/app` 分頁；prompt 本身不放進 URL。
66094	25	4. Gemini 載入後填入 `總結 <canonical URL>`，確認文字正確才按一次 Send。
66095	26	5. 找不到 composer／Send、輸入框已有草稿或無法確認送出時，把 prompt 複製到 clipboard，顯示人工操作 panel，不會 silent fail、覆寫草稿或重複 click。
66096	27	
66097	28	它會掃描首頁、搜尋、頻道、訂閱、related videos、playlist panel 等常見 card，也認得 Shorts card；playlist/course collection card 不會誤用第一支 lesson。一般 watch／live page 的按鈕會優先放進 action row；Shorts 或找不到 action row 的 layout 則顯示右下角浮動按鈕。
66098	29	
66099	30	## 使用方式
66100	31	
66101	32	1. 先登入 [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/app)。
66102	33	2. 在 YouTube：
66103	34	   - 瀏覽頁：把滑鼠移到影片 card，按左上角的 **✨ Gemini**。
66104	35	   - 已開啟影片：按 action row 或右下角的 **✨ Gemini**。
66105	36	3. 腳本會開一個新的 Gemini 分頁並自動送出摘要請求。
66106	37	4. 若右下角出現「無法自動完成」，prompt 已盡量複製到 clipboard；依 panel 指示貼上或手動按 Send。
66107	38	
66108	39	一次只開一支影片的摘要。前一個 Gemini 分頁仍在載入時，腳本會暫時拒絕覆蓋 pending request。
66109	40	
66110	41	## 權限與資料
66111	42	
66112	43	| Grant | 用途 |
66113	44	| --- | --- |
66114	45	| `GM_addStyle` | 顯示 YouTube 按鈕與狀態／fallback panel |
66115	46	| `GM_setValue` / `GM_getValue` / `GM_deleteValue` | 在同一支腳本的 YouTube、Gemini matches 之間交接一筆兩分鐘內有效的 URL |
66116	47	| `GM_openInTab` | 開啟新的 Gemini `/app` 分頁 |
66117	48	| `GM_setClipboard` | 自動化失敗時保留可手動貼上的 prompt |
66118	49	
66119	50	這支腳本：
66120	51	
66121	52	- 不需要 Gemini API key，也不呼叫 Gemini API。
66122	53	- 沒有 `@connect`，不對第三方 server 發 request。
66123	54	- 不抓 transcript、title、channel 或 Gemini 對話內容；GM storage 只交接 canonical YouTube URL 與短效 request metadata。
66124	55	- 新分頁 URL fragment 只含 random request ID，不含 video URL 或 prompt；瀏覽器的 HTTP request 不會攜帶 fragment。
66125	56	- 使用你已登入的 Gemini Web session；送出 prompt 後的資料處理由 Google Gemini 負責。
66126	57	
66127	58	## 已知限制
66128	59	
66129	60	- Gemini Web composer 不是公開 API，DOM selector 改版後可能需要更新。
66130	61	- Gemini 沒有公開、受支援的 prompt-prefill deep link；本腳本必須等待並操作 composer。
66131	62	- YouTube card 與 action row 也是 private DOM；新 renderer 可能暫時沒有按鈕或改用浮動 fallback。
66132	63	- 需要先登入 Gemini。Pending request 兩分鐘後過期，避免舊 request 在日後意外送出。
66133	64	- 一次只支援一筆 request，不做 queue、既有 Gemini tab reuse 或跨分頁 acknowledgement；random ID 只負責避免其他 `/app` tab 搶走這一筆。
66134	65	- 只注入 top-level desktop `www.youtube.com` UI；URL parser 雖認得 mobile／Music YouTube URL，腳本不會在那些站點或 iframe 加入按鈕。
66135	66	- Gemini `/app` 若恢復了未送出的草稿，腳本不會覆寫，而會保留草稿並退回人工操作。
66136	67	- 自動 click 後若原 composer 沒清空，腳本只會提示「可能未送出」，不以 route change 當成功，也不按第二次 Send。
66137	68	
66138	69	## 手動驗證
66139	70	
66140	71	這個 workflow 需要 userscript manager 的跨 domain storage 與新分頁能力，`npm run preview` 只能驗 UI/selector，不能代替真實 manager。發佈前應分別在 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 測試：
66141	72	
66142	73	- 首頁、搜尋、頻道、related videos、playlist panel、Shorts、watch 與 live page。
66143	74	- YouTube SPA 換片、infinite scroll、card recycle 後沒有 duplicate 或 stale button。
66144	75	- 只開一個新的 Gemini `/app`，prompt URL 正確且只送出一次。
66145	76	- Composer 或 Send selector 失效時會顯示可複製的 fallback。
66146	77	- 已有 Gemini conversation route 不會被誤填、誤送。
66147	78	
66148	79	## 參考實作
66149	80	
66150	81	- [ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary) — YouTube renderer coverage、watch action placement、SPA events
66151	82	- [wizdes/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary) — strict video ID canonicalization、短效 handoff、Gemini fallback UX
66152	83
66153	```

Without schema, returns its final text as a string. With schema (a JSON Schema), the subagent is forced to call a StructuredOutput tool and agent() returns the validated object — no parsing needed. Returns null if the user skips the agent mid-run or the subagent dies on a terminal API error after retries (filter with .filter(Boolean)). opts.label overrides the display label. opts.phase explicitly assigns this agent to a progress group (use this inside pipeline()/parallel() stages to avoid races on the global phase() state — same phase string → same group box). opts.model overrides the model for this agent call. Default to omitting it — the agent inherits the main-loop model (the resolved session model), which is almost always correct. Only set it when you're highly confident a different tier fits the task; when unsure, omit. opts.effort overrides the reasoning effort for this agent call ('low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max') — omit to inherit the session effort; use 'low' for cheap mechanical stages and higher tiers only for the hardest verify/judge stages. opts.isolation: 'worktree' runs the agent in a fresh git worktree — EXPENSIVE (~200-500ms setup + disk per agent), use ONLY when agents mutate files in parallel and would otherwise conflict; the worktree is auto-removed if unchanged. opts.agentType uses a custom subagent type (e.g. 'general-purpose', 'code-reviewer') instead of the default workflow subagent — resolved from the same registry as the Agent tool; composes with schema (the custom agent's system prompt gets a StructuredOutput instruction appended).

88618	 ## 這個 repo 怎麼運作
88619	 
88620	 ```text
88621	 本 repo（source of truth）
88622	         │ git push
88623	         ▼
88624	    GitHub
88625	         │ raw.githubusercontent.com + @updateURL
88626	         ▼

88635	 ```text

88639	 │   └── <slug>/

88641	 │       └── README.md            # 這支腳本的說明
88642	 ├── shared/                      # 可用 @require 引入的共用工具

88670	 # 01 · 什麼是 userscript
88671	 
88672	 一句話：**把你原本會貼到 Chrome DevTools Console 執行的 JavaScript，包裝成會自動比對網址、
88673	 持久保存、有權限管理的瀏覽器腳本。**
88674	 
88675	 它比 Console script 多了幾個關鍵能力，所以實際上更接近「超輕量 browser extension」。
88676	 
88677	 ## 三層定位
88678	 
88679	 ```text
88680	 DevTools Console
88681	     ↓
88682	 「臨時 hack 一下」
88683	 
88684	 Userscript
88685	     ↓
88686	 「我要長期 hack 這個網站，但不值得造一個 extension」
88687	 
88688	 Browser Extension
88689	     ↓
88690	 「我要做成完整產品／深度 browser integration」
88691	 ```
88692	 
88693	 ## 能力對照
88694	 
88695	-|                     | DevTools Console | Userscript          | Browser Extension |
88696	-| ------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------- | ----------------- |
88697	-| 執行 JS             | ✅               | ✅                  | ✅                |
88698	-| 操作 DOM            | ✅               | ✅                  | ✅                |
88699	-| 關掉頁面後還存在    | ❌               | ✅                  | ✅                |
88700	-| 每次開網站自動執行  | ❌               | ✅                  | ✅                |
88701	-| 指定哪些 URL 執行   | 手動             | ✅ `@match`         | ✅                |
88702	-| 跨頁持久化資料      | 麻煩             | ✅ `GM_setValue`    | ✅                |
88703	-| 跨域 HTTP request   | 受 CORS 限制     | ✅ `GM_xmlhttpRequest` | ✅             |
88704	-| 插入 menu / UI      | 手動             | ✅                  | ✅                |
88705	-| 安裝／分享          | 貼 code          | 一個 `.user.js`     | extension package |
88706	-| 開發成本            | 最低             | 很低                | 較高              |
88707	+|                    | DevTools Console | Userscript             | Browser Extension |
88708	+| ------------------ | ---------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------- |
88709	+| 執行 JS            | ✅               | ✅                     | ✅                |
88710	+| 操作 DOM           | ✅               | ✅                     | ✅                |
88711	+| 關掉頁面後還存在   | ❌               | ✅                     | ✅                |
88712	+| 每次開網站自動執行 | ❌               | ✅                     | ✅                |
88713	+| 指定哪些 URL 執行  | 手動             | ✅ `@match`            | ✅                |
88714	+| 跨頁持久化資料     | 麻煩             | ✅ `GM_setValue`       | ✅                |
88715	+| 跨域 HTTP request  | 受 CORS 限制     | ✅ `GM_xmlhttpRequest` | ✅                |
88716	+| 插入 menu / UI     | 手動             | ✅                     | ✅                |
88717	+| 安裝／分享         | 貼 code          | 一個 `.user.js`        | extension package |
88718	+| 開發成本           | 最低             | 很低                   | 較高              |
88719	 
88720	 概念上就是：
88721	 
88722	 ```text
88723	 Console snippet
88724	     ↓ 加上
88725	 URL matching
88726	 自動執行
88727	 persistent storage
88728	 extra browser APIs
88729	 權限管理
88730	 更新機制
88731	     ↓
88732	 Userscript
88733	 ```

88735	 ## 最小可用範例
88736	 
88737	 每次打開 ChatGPT 都把分頁標題前面加 `[GPT]`：
88738	 
88739	 ```js
88740	 // ==UserScript==
88741	 // @name         ChatGPT Title Modifier
88742	 // @namespace    local
88743	 // @version      1.0.0
88744	 // @match        https://chatgpt.com/*
88745	 // @grant        none
88746	 // ==/UserScript==
88747	 
88748	 (function () {
88749	   'use strict';
88750	   document.title = `[GPT] ${document.title}`;
88751	 })();
88752	 ```
88753	 
88754	 真正的關鍵是 metadata 裡的：
88755	 
88756	 ```js
88757	 // @match https://chatgpt.com/*
88758	 ```
88759	 
88760	 意思是「只要網址符合，就自動執行」。你不再需要開 DevTools → 切 Console → 貼 code → Enter，
88761	 reload 網頁就跑。
88762	 
88763	 > ⚠️ 這個版本在 ChatGPT 上其實**會失效**，因為它是 SPA，切換對話時網站會自己蓋掉標題。
88764	 > 正確做法見 [05 SPA 與執行時機](./05-spa-and-timing.md) 和
88765	 > [`page-title-tag`](../userscripts/page-title-tag/) 這支腳本。

88796	 ## userscript vs. userscript manager
88797	 
88798	 `userscript` 是這個概念本身；Tampermonkey 之類的是**執行它的軟體**：
88799	 
88800	 ```text
88801	         userscript
88802	             ↑
88803	 ┌───────────────────────┐
88804	 │ Tampermonkey          │
88805	 │ Violentmonkey         │
88806	 │ Greasemonkey          │
88807	 └───────────────────────┘
88808	 ```
88809	 
88810	 怎麼選見 [09 Manager 比較](./09-managers-comparison.md)。
88811	 
88812	+## Userscript + manager vs. 自製 Chrome extension
88813	+
88814	+Chrome extension 不是單純「更正式的 userscript」。兩者都能修改網頁，但技術形狀不同：
88815	+
88816	+- **Tampermonkey／Violentmonkey 本身才是 extension**；`.user.js` 是交給 manager 代管與執行的腳本。
88817	+- **自製 extension 是獨立的 browser application**；它有自己的 manifest、execution contexts、權限、UI 與發佈生命週期。
88818	+
88819	+```text
88820	+Userscript 路線
88821	+.user.js → userscript manager（extension）→ browser
88822	+
88823	+自製 extension 路線
88824	+manifest + content scripts → browser
88825	+                    └─ 需要時再加 service worker／UI
88826	+```
88827	+
88828	+|                | Userscript + manager                                              | 自製 Chrome extension                                                                          |
88829	+| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
88830	+| 最小專案       | 一個 `.user.js` + metadata                                        | `manifest.json` + content script；視需求再加 service worker、popup、options、side panel、icons |
88831	+| 執行位置       | manager sandbox 裡操作 matched page 的 DOM                        | content script、extension page、service worker 分開，彼此通常要 message passing                |
88832	+| Browser API    | 兩邊 manager 都有的 portable `GM_*` subset                        | 較完整的 `chrome.*`，例如 toolbar、context menu、side panel、bookmarks、native messaging       |
88833	+| 持久設定       | `GM_setValue`，由 manager 依 script identity 保存                 | `chrome.storage.local`／`sync`；暫存資料另有 `storage.session`                                 |
88834	+| 跨站協作       | 同一支 script 的 GM storage 可跨它的多個 `@match` 共用            | 多支 content script 可共用 `chrome.storage`；需要集中協調時再加 service worker/message passing |
88835	+| Portability    | 同一檔可同時支援 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 與多種 browser       | Chrome MV3 為主要目標；移植其他 browser 仍要檢查 API 與 packaging                              |
88836	+| 安裝／發佈     | Raw `.user.js`、腳本市集、`@updateURL`                            | Unpacked package、Chrome Web Store、enterprise distribution                                    |
88837	+| Trust boundary | Manager 有廣泛權限；每一支安裝的 script 也要獨立審查              | Extension package、publisher 與 manifest permissions                                           |
88838	+| 適合情境       | 少量 matched pages 的 DOM enhancement、個人／小團隊工具、快速迭代 | 完整 browser UI、背景事件、複雜跨 context 架構、產品化與 Store distribution                    |
88839	+
88840	+### 兩邊都能有持久化 config
88841	+
88842	+「Extension 可以保存設定，userscript 不行」是誤解。`GM_setValue` 的資料綁在**腳本**而非網域；同一支腳本在 YouTube 與 Gemini 都看得到，而且 reload、關分頁、重開 browser 後仍在。網站自己的 JavaScript 也讀不到這份 storage。完整 API 見 [04 GM API](./04-gm-api.md#持久化儲存)。
88843	+
88844	+Extension 則要明確選 storage：
88845	+
88846	+- `chrome.storage.local`：保留在這個 browser profile。
88847	+- `chrome.storage.sync`：啟用 Chrome Sync 時可同步到其他登入裝置，但有 quota。
88848	+- `chrome.storage.session`：只適合 browser session 內的短效資料。
88849	+- **Service worker 的 global variable 不算 storage**；worker 隨時可能被暫停，記憶體狀態會消失。
88850	+
88851	+兩條路線預設都不是「全世界共用設定」：userscript 要另外開 manager sync，extension 要選 `storage.sync` 並依賴 browser account/sync 設定。
88852	+
88853	+### 什麼時候升級成 extension
88854	+
88855	+像「YouTube 按一下 → 用短效 GM storage 交給 Gemini」這種 workflow，userscript 已經有足夠能力。改做 extension 必然會增加 manifest、host/storage permissions、content scripts 與 packaging；只有需要 background events 或集中協調時，才必須再加 service worker 與 message passing。
88856	+
88857	+當需求核心變成以下能力，再升級比較值得：
88858	+
88859	+- Toolbar badge、context menu、side panel 或 omnibox
88860	+- Page 不開著也要接 browser-level background events
88861	+- Bookmarks、history、downloads、native messaging 等 extension APIs
88862	+- 多個 content scripts 與完整 options UI
88863	+- 需要 Chrome Web Store review、enterprise policy 或一般使用者的一鍵安裝體驗
88864	+
88865	+相關細節不用全塞在這一篇：metadata 與權限見 [03](./03-metadata-reference.md)，sandbox 見 [06](./06-sandbox-and-unsafewindow.md)，開發與升級成本見 [07](./07-dev-workflow.md)，發佈見 [08](./08-distribution-and-sync.md)，manager 選擇見 [09](./09-managers-comparison.md)，安全與第三方 script 審查見 [12](./12-security.md)。
88866	+

88870	```

    window.__clipboard = null;
    GM_getValue = (k, d) => k in window.__store ? window.__store[k] : d;
    GM_setValue = (k, v) => window.__store[k] = v;
    GM_deleteValue = k => { delete window.__store[k]; };
    GM_setClipboard = text => window.__clipboard = text;
    GM_openInTab = () => {};
    GM_addStyle = () => {};
    document.querySelector('#local').addEventListener('click', () => { window.__clicks.local++; document.querySelector('.ql-editor').textContent = ''; });
    document.querySelector('#decoy').addEventListener('click', () => window.__clicks.decoy++);
  }, { key, id, video });
  await page.addScriptTag({ content: source });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
  const result = await page.evaluate(key => ({ clicks: window.__clicks, pending: key in window.__store, editor: document.querySelector('.ql-editor').textContent, attachment: Boolean(document.querySelector('uploader-file-preview')), clipboard: window.__clipboard }), key);
  await page.close();
  return result;
}

assert.equal(attachment.attachment, true);

```text
1	# YouTube Gemini Summary
2	
3	在 YouTube 影片卡片與觀看頁一鍵開啟 Gemini，送出繁中摘要提示。
4	
5	- **生效網站**：`https://www.youtube.com/*`、`https://gemini.google.com/app*`
6	- **安裝**：[點這裡安裝](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)（需先裝好 Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）
7	- **原始碼**：[`youtube-gemini-summary.user.js`](./youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)
8	
9	## 它做了什麼
10	
11	原本的手動流程：
12	
13	```text
14	複製 YouTube URL
15	  → 開 Gemini 新對話
16	  → 輸入「總結 <URL>」
17	  → Send
18	```
19	
20	安裝後，在 YouTube 影片卡片或已開啟的影片按 **✨ Gemini** 即可完成同一件事：
21	
22	1. 從 card 或目前頁面取得 video ID。
23	2. 正規化成 `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`，去掉 playlist、timestamp 與 tracking parameters。
24	3. 用短效 GM storage 保存 URL，再以 URL fragment 裡的 random request ID 指定剛開出的 `https://gemini.google.com/app` 分頁；prompt 本身不放進 URL。
25	4. Gemini 載入後填入 `總結 <canonical URL>`，確認文字正確才按一次 Send。
26	5. 找不到 composer／Send、輸入框已有草稿或無法確認送出時，把 prompt 複製到 clipboard，顯示人工操作 panel，不會 silent fail、覆寫草稿或重複 click。
27	
28	它會掃描首頁、搜尋、頻道、訂閱、related videos、playlist panel 等常見 card，也認得 Shorts card；playlist/course collection card 不會誤用第一支 lesson。一般 watch／live page 的按鈕會優先放進 action row；Shorts 或找不到 action row 的 layout 則顯示右下角浮動按鈕。
29	
30	## 使用方式
31	
32	1. 先登入 [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/app)。
33	2. 在 YouTube：
34	   - 瀏覽頁：把滑鼠移到影片 card，按左上角的 **✨ Gemini**。
35	   - 已開啟影片：按 action row 或右下角的 **✨ Gemini**。
36	3. 腳本會開一個新的 Gemini 分頁並自動送出摘要請求。
37	4. 若右下角出現「無法自動完成」，prompt 已盡量複製到 clipboard；依 panel 指示貼上或手動按 Send。
38	
39	一次只開一支影片的摘要。前一個 Gemini 分頁仍在載入時，腳本會暫時拒絕覆蓋 pending request。
40	
41	## 權限與資料
42	
43	| Grant | 用途 |
44	| --- | --- |
45	| `GM_addStyle` | 顯示 YouTube 按鈕與狀態／fallback panel |
46	| `GM_setValue` / `GM_getValue` / `GM_deleteValue` | 在同一支腳本的 YouTube、Gemini matches 之間交接一筆兩分鐘內有效的 URL |
47	| `GM_openInTab` | 開啟新的 Gemini `/app` 分頁 |
48	| `GM_setClipboard` | 自動化失敗時保留可手動貼上的 prompt |
49	
50	這支腳本：
51	
52	- 不需要 Gemini API key，也不呼叫 Gemini API。
53	- 沒有 `@connect`，不對第三方 server 發 request。
54	- 不抓 transcript、title、channel 或 Gemini 對話內容；GM storage 只交接 canonical YouTube URL 與短效 request metadata。
55	- 新分頁 URL fragment 只含 random request ID，不含 video URL 或 prompt；瀏覽器的 HTTP request 不會攜帶 fragment。
56	- 使用你已登入的 Gemini Web session；送出 prompt 後的資料處理由 Google Gemini 負責。
57	
58	## 已知限制
59	
60	- Gemini Web composer 不是公開 API，DOM selector 改版後可能需要更新。
61	- Gemini 沒有公開、受支援的 prompt-prefill deep link；本腳本必須等待並操作 composer。
62	- YouTube card 與 action row 也是 private DOM；新 renderer 可能暫時沒有按鈕或改用浮動 fallback。
63	- 需要先登入 Gemini。Pending request 兩分鐘後過期，避免舊 request 在日後意外送出。
64	- 一次只支援一筆 request，不做 queue、既有 Gemini tab reuse 或跨分頁 acknowledgement；random ID 只負責避免其他 `/app` tab 搶走這一筆。
65	- 只注入 top-level desktop `www.youtube.com` UI；URL parser 雖認得 mobile／Music YouTube URL，腳本不會在那些站點或 iframe 加入按鈕。
66	- Gemini `/app` 若恢復了未送出的文字或附件草稿，腳本不會覆寫／夾帶送出，而會保留草稿並退回人工操作。
67	- 自動 click 後若原 composer 沒清空，腳本只會提示「可能未送出」，不以 route change 當成功，也不按第二次 Send。
68	
69	## 手動驗證
70	
71	這個 workflow 需要 userscript manager 的跨 domain storage 與新分頁能力，`npm run preview` 只能驗 UI/selector，不能代替真實 manager。發佈前應分別在 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 測試：
72	
73	- 首頁、搜尋、頻道、related videos、playlist panel、Shorts、watch 與 live page。
74	- YouTube SPA 換片、infinite scroll、card recycle 後沒有 duplicate 或 stale button。
75	- 只開一個新的 Gemini `/app`，prompt URL 正確且只送出一次。
76	- Composer 或 Send selector 失效時會顯示可複製的 fallback。
77	- 已有 Gemini conversation route 不會被誤填、誤送。
78	
79	## 參考實作
80	
81	- [ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary) — YouTube renderer coverage、watch action placement、SPA events
82	- [wizdes/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary) — strict video ID canonicalization、短效 handoff、Gemini fallback UX
83
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	# YouTube Gemini Summary
2	
3	在 YouTube 影片卡片與觀看頁一鍵開啟 Gemini，送出繁中摘要提示。
4	
5	- **生效網站**：`https://www.youtube.com/*`、`https://gemini.google.com/app*`
6	- **安裝**：[點這裡安裝](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/Tampermonkey-Scripts/main/userscripts/youtube-gemini-summary/youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)（需先裝好 Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey）
7	- **原始碼**：[`youtube-gemini-summary.user.js`](./youtube-gemini-summary.user.js)
8	
9	## 它做了什麼
10	
11	原本的手動流程：
12	
13	```text
14	複製 YouTube URL
15	  → 開 Gemini 新對話
16	  → 輸入「總結 <URL>」
17	  → Send
18	```
19	
20	安裝後，在 YouTube 影片卡片或已開啟的影片按 **✨ Gemini** 即可完成同一件事：
21	
22	1. 從 card 或目前頁面取得 video ID。
23	2. 正規化成 `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`，去掉 playlist、timestamp 與 tracking parameters。
24	3. 用短效 GM storage 保存 URL，再以 URL fragment 裡的 random request ID 指定剛開出的 `https://gemini.google.com/app` 分頁；prompt 本身不放進 URL。
25	4. Gemini 載入後填入 `總結 <canonical URL>`，確認文字正確才按一次 Send。
26	5. 找不到 composer／Send、輸入框已有草稿或無法確認送出時，把 prompt 複製到 clipboard，顯示人工操作 panel，不會 silent fail、覆寫草稿或重複 click。
27	
28	它會掃描首頁、搜尋、頻道、訂閱、related videos、playlist panel 等常見 card，也認得 Shorts card；playlist/course collection card 不會誤用第一支 lesson。一般 watch／live page 的按鈕會優先放進 action row；Shorts 或找不到 action row 的 layout 則顯示右下角浮動按鈕。
29	
30	## 使用方式
31	
32	1. 先登入 [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/app)。
33	2. 在 YouTube：
34	   - 瀏覽頁：把滑鼠移到影片 card，按左上角的 **✨ Gemini**。
35	   - 已開啟影片：按 action row 或右下角的 **✨ Gemini**。
36	3. 腳本會開一個新的 Gemini 分頁並自動送出摘要請求。
37	4. 若右下角出現「無法自動完成」，prompt 已盡量複製到 clipboard；依 panel 指示貼上或手動按 Send。
38	
39	一次只開一支影片的摘要。前一個 Gemini 分頁仍在載入時，腳本會暫時拒絕覆蓋 pending request。
40	
41	## 權限與資料
42	
43	| Grant | 用途 |
44	| --- | --- |
45	| `GM_addStyle` | 顯示 YouTube 按鈕與狀態／fallback panel |
46	| `GM_setValue` / `GM_getValue` / `GM_deleteValue` | 在同一支腳本的 YouTube、Gemini matches 之間交接一筆兩分鐘內有效的 URL |
47	| `GM_openInTab` | 開啟新的 Gemini `/app` 分頁 |
48	| `GM_setClipboard` | 自動化失敗時保留可手動貼上的 prompt |
49	
50	這支腳本：
51	
52	- 不需要 Gemini API key，也不呼叫 Gemini API。
53	- 沒有 `@connect`，不對第三方 server 發 request。
54	- 不抓 transcript、title、channel 或 Gemini 對話內容；GM storage 只交接 canonical YouTube URL 與短效 request metadata。
55	- 新分頁 URL fragment 只含 random request ID，不含 video URL 或 prompt；瀏覽器的 HTTP request 不會攜帶 fragment。
56	- 使用你已登入的 Gemini Web session；送出 prompt 後的資料處理由 Google Gemini 負責。
57	
58	## 已知限制
59	
60	- Gemini Web composer 不是公開 API，DOM selector 改版後可能需要更新。
61	- Gemini 沒有公開、受支援的 prompt-prefill deep link；本腳本必須等待並操作 composer。
62	- YouTube card 與 action row 也是 private DOM；新 renderer 可能暫時沒有按鈕或改用浮動 fallback。
63	- 需要先登入 Gemini。Pending request 兩分鐘後過期，避免舊 request 在日後意外送出。
64	- 一次只支援一筆 request，不做 queue、既有 Gemini tab reuse 或跨分頁 acknowledgement；random ID 只負責避免其他 `/app` tab 搶走這一筆。
65	- 只注入 top-level desktop `www.youtube.com` UI；URL parser 雖認得 mobile／Music YouTube URL，腳本不會在那些站點或 iframe 加入按鈕。
66	- Gemini `/app` 若恢復了未送出的文字或附件草稿，腳本不會覆寫／夾帶送出，而會保留草稿並退回人工操作。
67	- 自動 click 後若原 composer 沒清空，腳本只會提示「可能未送出」，不以 route change 當成功，也不按第二次 Send。
68	
69	## 手動驗證
70	
71	這個 workflow 需要 userscript manager 的跨 domain storage 與新分頁能力，`npm run preview` 只能驗 UI/selector，不能代替真實 manager。發佈前應分別在 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 測試：
72	
73	- 首頁、搜尋、頻道、related videos、playlist panel、Shorts、watch 與 live page。
74	- YouTube SPA 換片、infinite scroll、card recycle 後沒有 duplicate 或 stale button。
75	- 只開一個新的 Gemini `/app`，prompt URL 正確且只送出一次。
76	- Composer 或 Send selector 失效時會顯示可複製的 fallback。
77	- 已有 Gemini conversation route 不會被誤填、誤送。
78	
79	## 參考實作
80	
81	- [ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/ipekbayrak/yt-gemini-summary) — YouTube renderer coverage、watch action placement、SPA events
82	- [wizdes/yt-gemini-summary](https://github.com/wizdes/yt-gemini-summary) — strict video ID canonicalization、短效 handoff、Gemini fallback UX
83
```

```text
115	## userscript vs. userscript manager
116	
117	`userscript` 是這個概念本身；Tampermonkey 之類的是**執行它的軟體**：
118	
119	```text
120	        userscript
121	            ↑
122	┌───────────────────────┐
123	│ Tampermonkey          │
124	│ Violentmonkey         │
125	│ Greasemonkey          │
126	└───────────────────────┘
127	```
128	
129	怎麼選見 [09 Manager 比較](./09-managers-comparison.md)。
130	
131	## Userscript + manager vs. 自製 Chrome extension
132	
133	Chrome extension 不是單純「更正式的 userscript」。兩者都能修改網頁，但技術形狀不同：
134	
135	- **Tampermonkey／Violentmonkey 本身才是 extension**；`.user.js` 是交給 manager 代管與執行的腳本。
136	- **自製 extension 是獨立的 browser application**；它有自己的 manifest、execution contexts、權限、UI 與發佈生命週期。
137	
138	```text
139	Userscript 路線
140	.user.js → userscript manager（extension）→ browser
141	
142	自製 extension 路線
143	manifest + content scripts → browser
144	                    └─ 需要時再加 service worker／UI
145	```
146	
147	|                | Userscript + manager                                              | 自製 Chrome extension                                                                          |
148	| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
149	| 最小專案       | 一個 `.user.js` + metadata                                        | `manifest.json` + content script；視需求再加 service worker、popup、options、side panel、icons |
150	| 執行位置       | manager sandbox 裡操作 matched page 的 DOM                        | content script、extension page、service worker 分開，彼此通常要 message passing                |
151	| Browser API    | 兩邊 manager 都有的 portable `GM_*` subset                        | 較完整的 `chrome.*`，例如 toolbar、context menu、side panel、bookmarks、native messaging       |
152	| 持久設定       | `GM_setValue`，由 manager 依 script identity 保存                 | `chrome.storage.local`／`sync`；暫存資料另有 `storage.session`                                 |
153	| 跨站協作       | 同一支 script 的 GM storage 可跨它的多個 `@match` 共用            | 多支 content script 可共用 `chrome.storage`；需要集中協調時再加 service worker/message passing |
154	| Portability    | 同一檔可同時支援 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey 與多種 browser       | Chrome MV3 為主要目標；移植其他 browser 仍要檢查 API 與 packaging                              |
155	| 安裝／發佈     | Raw `.user.js`、腳本市集、`@updateURL`                            | Unpacked package、Chrome Web Store、enterprise distribution                                    |
156	| Trust boundary | Manager 有廣泛權限；每一支安裝的 script 也要獨立審查              | Extension package、publisher 與 manifest permissions                                           |
157	| 適合情境       | 少量 matched pages 的 DOM enhancement、個人／小團隊工具、快速迭代 | 完整 browser UI、背景事件、複雜跨 context 架構、產品化與 Store distribution                    |
158	
159	### 兩邊都能有持久化 config
160	
161	「Extension 可以保存設定，userscript 不行」是誤解。`GM_setValue` 的資料綁在**腳本**而非網域；同一支腳本在 YouTube 與 Gemini 都看得到，而且 reload、關分頁、重開 browser 後仍在。網站自己的 JavaScript 也讀不到這份 storage。完整 API 見 [04 GM API](./04-gm-api.md#持久化儲存)。
162	
163	Extension 則要明確選 storage：
164	
165	- `chrome.storage.local`：保留在這個 browser profile。
166	- `chrome.storage.sync`：啟用 Chrome Sync 時可同步到其他登入裝置，但有 quota。
167	- `chrome.storage.session`：只適合 browser session 內的短效資料。
168	- **Service worker 的 global variable 不算 storage**；worker 隨時可能被暫停，記憶體狀態會消失。
169	
170	兩條路線預設都不是「全世界共用設定」：userscript 要另外開 manager sync，extension 要選 `storage.sync` 並依賴 browser account/sync 設定。
171	
172	### 什麼時候升級成 extension
173	
174	像「YouTube 按一下 → 用短效 GM storage 交給 Gemini」這種 workflow，userscript 已經有足夠能力。改做 extension 必然會增加 manifest、host/storage permissions、content scripts 與 packaging；只有需要 background events 或集中協調時，才必須再加 service worker 與 message passing。
175	
176	當需求核心變成以下能力，再升級比較值得：
177	
178	- Toolbar badge、context menu、side panel 或 omnibox
179	- Page 不開著也要接 browser-level background events
180	- Bookmarks、history、downloads、native messaging 等 extension APIs
181	- 多個 content scripts 與完整 options UI
182	- 需要 Chrome Web Store review、enterprise policy 或一般使用者的一鍵安裝體驗
183	
184	相關細節不用全塞在這一篇：metadata 與權限見 [03](./03-metadata-reference.md)，sandbox 見 [06](./06-sandbox-and-unsafewindow.md)，開發與升級成本見 [07](./07-dev-workflow.md)，發佈見 [08](./08-distribution-and-sync.md)，manager 選擇見 [09](./09-managers-comparison.md)，安全與第三方 script 審查見 [12](./12-security.md)。
185	
186	## 下一步
187	
188	[02 · 第一支腳本](./02-getting-started.md)
189
```
</details></tool-use>

# dev-cli

The `dev` command is a thin glue layer over git, worktrees, forges and agent
runtimes. It exists to stop four different things collapsing into one:

```
git remote      durable code state, the source of truth
git worktree    a disposable local checkout
herdr / tmux / zellij
                a per-host live runtime
dev             human intent: what am I working on, and what is next
```

Everything derivable from git or the runtime is derived live. `dev` persists
human/task facts such as identity, checkout mode, **state**, **owner** and **next
action** in one TOML file per task under configured `paths.state_dir/tasks`
(default `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/tasks`); transient pane data is not persisted.

**The problem it solves:** when a terminal multiplexer's sidebar is the only
record of what you are working on, nothing can ever be closed. `dev` gives that
record a home outside the runtime, so closing a session stops meaning
abandoning a task.

## Check it is there first

`dev` is not installed everywhere. Before using it:

```bash
command -v dev || echo "not installed"
dev doctor          # what works on this machine, and what degrades
```

Only **git** is required. `herdr`, `tmux`, `zellij`, `gh`, `glab` and Azure CLI
each enable more and degrade cleanly when absent — never make a step
hard-depend on one.

## Worktree ownership — read this before creating any worktree

There are three mechanisms that create git worktrees, and picking the wrong one
is the most common source of confusion. The rule:

| Kind of worktree | Owner | Where | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|---|
| Feature, fix, experiment, cross-machine handoff — anything you might return to | **`dev`** | `paths.worktree_path`, default `~/Worktrees/<repo>/<branch-slug>` | until `dev done` or `dev sweep` |
| Harness-owned turn-scoped isolation (`isolation: worktree`, `/batch`, `EnterWorktree`) | **Claude Code** | `.claude/worktrees/` (keep gitignored) | owned by that harness; not a transcript-relocation guarantee |
| `herdr worktree create` | **not used** — `dev` runs `git worktree add` itself, then `herdr worktree open --path …` | — | — |

**Rule of thumb: if code/history/plan must remain reviewable or a human may
return tomorrow, use `dev`. Use native isolation only when the harness owns the
entire turn-scoped lifecycle.**

Why `dev` does not delegate to `herdr worktree create`: the path policy has to
hold on machines where herdr is not installed. `dev` creates the checkout with
plain git and asks herdr only to *open* it — which still makes it appear in the
sidebar grouped under its parent repo with its own branch and ahead/behind row.

Never nest a `dev` worktree inside a repository. A checkout inside another
checkout makes every indexer, file watcher and `rg` run see a second copy of
the tree. `dev` refuses to do it.

Full detail: `references/worktree-ownership.md`.

## The task lifecycle

| State | Git | Runtime | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🔥 `hot` | worktree + branch | session open | working on it now |
| 🌤 `warm` | worktree + branch kept | normally closed | back within days |
| ❄️ `cold` | committed and pushed; worktree removed | nothing | paused, reconstructible anywhere |
| ✅ `done` | merged | may remain open | MERGED; external retirement pending |

```bash
dev repo open api                                  # ad hoc; no task/worktree
dev start api --task "typo" --direct                # track current/main directly
dev start api --task "small" --branch-only --base main
dev start api --task "token refresh" --base main   # isolated worktree → hot
dev park --next "add the regression test" --wip    # → warm, session closed
dev park --cold --push                             # → cold, worktree removed
dev resume "token refresh"                         # → hot, rebuilt if needed
dev prepare --session claude:<uuid>                # arm final transcript handoff
dev done                                           # TTY wizard: inspect dirty state, then FF/PR/merged
dev done --ff                                      # → done/MERGED; resources kept
dev retire "token refresh"                         # external-only cleanup → RETIRED
```

**Parking is the move that matters.** `dev park --next "…"` is what makes it
safe to close a session, and the `--next` text is what makes resuming cheap.
Always suggest a `--next` when parking.

Full detail: `references/task-lifecycle.md`. Before integrating or deleting an
agent-owned checkout, read `references/agent-retirement.md`.

## Pick the task's checkout mode

A task does not imply a worktree. Use the lightest explicit boundary:

- `dev repo open <repo>` / REPOS Enter — ad-hoc open, no task at all.
- `dev start … --direct` / REPOS `d` — track current branch (usually main),
  create no branch/worktree. HOT ↔ WARM only; `dev done` needs no merge mode.
- `dev start … --branch-only` — create and switch a branch in the canonical
  checkout. No concurrent branch there.
- `dev start …` / REPOS `s` — default isolated branch + worktree. Use once work
  may be interrupted, experimental, or parallel.

Do not create isolation before it has a job, but do not carry dirty main changes
into a parallel task implicitly either: a worktree starts from committed HEAD.
Checkpoint first when the new task depends on that work.

## Parallel background work

Read `references/parallel-agents.md` before spawning an independent agent while
another remains live. The fail-closed workflow uses `dev start --json`, requires
a newly created first-class Herdr worktree and its exact returned root pane,
then launches an explicit SpecStory/profile command there. Reused, fallback,
non-Herdr, missing or unverified panes are never launch targets.

`dev` guards writer-claiming direct/branch starts and resume when another
recognized Herdr agent occupies the same canonical Git worktree. Every state,
including `idle`, `done`, and `unknown`, is occupied; Herdr resolves the current
pane before excluding it. Pure repo/worktree/TUI open is navigation to the live
owner, not writer authorization. Never add `--allow-shared-checkout` unless
agents already have coordinated disjoint file ownership.

A new external agent does not inherit the parent permission mode, and a resumed
Claude fork does not restore bypass. Inspect the effective SpecStory/provider
command: local wrappers may already be elevated, so never claim they are safe or
append a conflicting mode. Herdr `done` is turn-settled—not cleanup done.

## Everyday commands

```bash
dev                        # interactive dashboard (plain listing when piped)
dev note add "thought"     # append to repo containing cwd
dev note search "query"    # rebuilds FTS index if needed
dev edit                   # open the effective config; generate it first if absent
dev ls                     # what am I working on, everywhere
dev ls --json              # stable machine-readable form (also over ssh)
dev status                 # what is this directory: repo, branch, task, session
dev sweep                  # what has gone stale or drifted, and what to do
dev sweep --apply          # act on it, confirming each change
dev sweep --merged-worktrees  # from main, audit contained tracked/untracked worktrees
dev prepare --session claude:<uuid>  # arm exact post-writer artifact commit
dev artifact list          # finalization handoffs and receipts
dev done --ff              # integrate only; runtime/worktree stay alive
dev retire <task>          # external-only close/wait/remove/reap

dev git uncommit           # soft reset with a per-worktree message receipt
dev git recommit           # reuse that exact message with normal hooks
dev git pull-rebase        # exact stash OID + index-preserving restore
dev git amend-all          # add -A + no-edit amend; hooks remain enabled

dev start                  # context-aware wizard; confirms before creating
dev start -t "token refresh" --base main  # fast managed worktree task

dev wt create feat/auth --base main    # worktree at the configured path
dev wt list                            # every worktree of this repo
dev wt plan                            # what a new worktree would be set up with
dev wt plan --write                    # seed a committed .dev.toml from it
dev wt rm feat/auth                    # remove the checkout; the branch stays

dev repo list --sizes      # repos, recovery topology, owned logical bytes
dev repo list --no-remote  # local Git with no configured remote
dev repo list --local-only # branches lacking a remote-backed upstream
dev repo context [repo]    # agent-ready checkouts, Git, runtime and task state
dev repo clone owner/name  # clone into the right place, via gh or glab
dev repo clone https://dev.azure.com/acme/Platform/_git/api
dev repo sync --all        # fetch + prune, and report what moved
dev fleet list              # aggregate repo/task/runtime state over SSH
dev fleet sync api --push   # publish, then fast-forward safe matching checkouts
dev repo remote [query]     # search configured forge inventories
dev bootstrap ~/code       # recursively inventory an existing machine
dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects   # plan a non-destructive symlink catalog
dev gitignore              # .gitignore from GitHub templates + the common bits
dev adopt                  # import existing worktrees/sessions/branches as tasks

dev try redis-streams      # dated scratch directory for an experiment
dev tries mark redis-streams --add important  # durable personal metadata
dev tries archive redis-streams               # reversible; does not delete
dev graduate redis-streams --category Infra   # promote it into a real project

dev stats --heatmap        # where the time actually went
dev stats backfill --repo api  # seed one repo; TUI H then b does this in place
dev stats path             # durable XDG data, not cache
dev summary                # current machine-wide agent context
dev journal                # today's agent-ready development journal
dev journal --since 7d --metrics | opencode run "summarize this"
dev cache list             # regenerable forge/fleet/size/gitignore/note-index caches
dev help worktrees         # quick-reference pages
```

Complete generated reference: `references/commands.md`.

## Bootstrapping and adopting an existing machine

Read `references/bootstrap.md` before recursively scanning paths, creating a
symlink index, moving physical repositories, or generating layout config. Move
is destructive and must follow its report → review → apply procedure.

There is nothing to migrate for ordinary use. `dev` discovers repositories through
`paths.scan_roots` plus exact `paths.repo_paths` and never moves, renames or deletes anything.

```bash
dev config init     # detects this machine's roots; every value stays editable
dev adopt           # report existing worktrees, sessions and unmerged branches
dev adopt --apply   # record them as tasks (nothing on disk changes)
```

Do not assume the user's layout is `~/Documents/Program`. Run `dev config show`
or `dev repo list` to see what this machine is actually configured for.

## Dashboard and forge inventory

The TUI has TASKS, REPOS, FLEET, TRY and REMOTE views, switched with tab or vim-style
h/l. TRY `n` creates an experiment; `space` opens metadata/lifecycle actions;
`a` includes retained history. Archive is a reversible same-filesystem move,
not deletion or disk reclamation. `?` opens the full key map.

REMOTE queries authenticated `gh` and `glab` plus configured Azure DevOps
organization/project targets lazily and fully paginates every repository the
account can access. A private cache is shown immediately; stale rows stay
searchable while refresh runs. `/` filters provider, owner/name, visibility and
description, with `vis:private` for an exact visibility match. Enter opens a local clone; `c`
confirms before cloning an absent remote. Use `dev repo remote [query] --json`
for the non-interactive form; `--cached` avoids a network query and `--refresh`
forces a complete synchronization.

`dev journal` derives calendar-day reports from Git rather than storing a
second history database. The default current-user report adds existing
session/WakaTime observations, matching task intent and recent dirty-worktree
snapshots, clearly separated from committed history. `auto` expands at most 100
commit details while retaining complete aggregates; `--max-commits 0` is
unlimited. Use `--author <email>` or `--all-authors` for commit-only team views,
and `--json` for a stable structured report. dev generates the context only; it
does not launch the receiving agent.

`dev summary` is the complementary current-state view across this machine. It
combines durable repositories and present active/deprecated Tries with live Git,
worktree, task, runtime, recovery and catalog facts. The default `auto` Markdown
expands active work and leaves quiet projects in a compact index; `--attention`
selects both active work and recovery hazards, while `--json` always emits the
complete selected snapshot. Use journal for time ranges and `repo context` for
one repository.

Azure DevOps inventory is opt-in and cloud-only:

```toml
[[forge.azure_devops]]
organization = "https://dev.azure.com/acme"
project = "Platform"
```

Install Azure CLI's `azure-devops` extension separately. `dev` never installs
the extension, logs in, changes Azure defaults, or stores a PAT.

FLEET calls each configured host's own `dev` over SSH, preserving its XDG paths.
Enter prefers Herdr remote navigation and falls back to an SSH login shell.
`dev fleet sync` is explicit and strict: it only fast-forwards a clean checkout
of the same behind-only branch; dirty/ahead/diverged clones are never rewritten.

REPOS has LIVE, LATEST and asynchronous SIZE. SIZE is logical
checkout+private-Git bytes; shared Git is separate and marked `+S`. Detail also
shows no-remote/local-only/multi-upstream recovery topology. Press space to
expand linked worktrees; children
show their own Git/session/task state and mark harness-owned or untracked
checkouts `(ephemeral)` / `(external)`. Press `y` followed by `y/p/b/s/w` to
copy contextual Markdown, path, branch, runtime/agent sessions, or every
worktree path. `dev repo context [repo]` prints the full Markdown without a TUI.
`[tui.repos]` chooses columns and default sort; `O` cycles sort and `R` reverses
it.

`H` opens the selected repo's heatmap. On an empty panel, `b` backfills only
that repo and redraws; `r` rereads existing stats. Stats live in
`$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/stats.db` and are durable observations, not cache — use
`dev stats clear` with an explicit scope. `dev cache clear` only removes
regenerable forge/size/gitignore/note-FTS data under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev`.

`e` edits config and returning live-reloads data/tool bindings; `r` reloads
explicitly. Runtime
backend changes require restarting the TUI.

External tools are explicit `[[tui.tools]]` config. Run `dev tui tools` before
recommending a binding; it shows the exact command and whether it is available.
Commands run through `$SHELL` in the selected checkout. For an alias/function
that exists only in shell rc, set `interactive = true`; dev uses `$SHELL -lic`
and evaluates the command after rc loading. Prefer an executable on PATH when
the binding should be portable across machines.

## Repository quick notes

Read `references/notes.md` before adding/searching/editing/deleting notes or
when deciding whether content belongs in dev vs td/beads.

Quick notes are multiple timestamped Markdown files under configured
`paths.state_dir/notes/<catalog-id>/` (default `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/notes`); the
catalog ID attaches them to the canonical clone across worktrees, symlinks and
moves. `dev` does not synchronize notes or catalog state, so cross-host
attachment requires syncing both. SQLite FTS at `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db`
is disposable: clearing it removes no thoughts and the next search rebuilds it.

TUI context keys: `n` quick-adds on TASKS/REPOS; `N` browses with `/` search,
Enter expand, `a` add, `e` editor, and confirmed `d` delete. In TRY, `n` remains
“new Try.” REMOTE needs a local clone.

## Editing configuration

Use `dev edit` (or `dev config edit`) rather than guessing the XDG path. It
opens the file selected by `--config`, generating the machine-detected starter
when absent, and resolves `--editor` → `$VISUAL` → `$EDITOR` → nvim/vim/vi.

## Rules for agents

1. **Do not equate task with worktree.** Ad-hoc opening needs no task; `--direct`
   tracks current/main; `--branch-only` is lightweight isolation; default
   worktree is for interruption/experimentation/parallelism.

2. **Always pass `--base` for branch/worktree tasks.** Without it a new branch starts from the current
   HEAD, so starting a task while standing on `feature/A` silently builds on
   `feature/A`. This is the single most common way to produce a confusing
   history unattended.

3. **Never `--force` a worktree removal on your own.** `dev wt rm` refuses a
   checkout with uncommitted changes; that refusal is the feature. Ask the
   user before overriding it.

4. **Report drift, do not fix it silently.** `dev sweep` without `--apply`
   changes nothing. Show the user its output rather than running `--apply --yes`
   for them. For merged worktree cleanup, run `dev sweep --merged-worktrees`
   from the canonical main checkout, present every candidate and blocker as a
   QA question, and use `--apply --yes` only after the user explicitly approves
   that exact set. Branch deletion remains a separate `--delete-branches` opt-in.

5. **Prefer a checkpoint commit over `git stash`.** A stash is invisible in the
   log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never reach another
   machine. `dev park --wip` makes a `wip:` commit instead.

6. **One writer per branch at a time.** `dev resume` refuses a task owned by
   another host without `--force`. Before overriding, confirm that machine has
   pushed.

7. **Check `dev wt plan` before blaming a worktree.** A worktree that comes up
   broken is nearly always a provisioning gap, not a git problem. The plan
   shows the detected project types, which tools are missing, and exactly what
   would be copied or run. Dependencies arrive by a per-ecosystem strategy —
   `reinstall` (default), `copy`, `link` or `skip` — and dev refuses an unsound
   one rather than producing a broken checkout: a virtualenv cannot be copied,
   because it bakes its own absolute path into `pyvenv.cfg`.

8. **Do not create a worktree per agent.** Worktrees isolate *change streams*;
   panes isolate *agents*. A writer claim in one checkout needs explicit
   disjoint ownership; pure open/focus may navigate to the existing owner.

9. **Parallel launch is exact-pane and fail-closed.** Accept only a new
   first-class Herdr worktree/root pane from `dev start --json`. Never infer from
   focus/sidebar order, relocate SpecStory with mid-session `EnterWorktree`, or
   treat any recognized agent state as a free pane. Never add
   `--allow-shared-checkout` without coordinated ownership.

10. **Launcher profile and effective permissions are explicit.** Standard
    Claude/Codex put the complete native command inside SpecStory `-c`; verified
    `*-copilot-once` wrappers already wrap SpecStory but inherit effective
    provider permissions, which may be dangerous. Never append a conflicting
    safer mode to an elevated command. Read `parallel-agents.md`.

11. **Cleanup is external, never self-triggered by agent state.** Herdr `done`
    means a turn settled. Arm and finalize exact artifacts first; `dev done`
    integrates only, and `dev retire` must run outside the target workspace.
    Never run raw `git worktree remove --force` against the caller's checkout.

12. **Prefer `dev bootstrap --index` over `--move`.** If the problem is
   navigation, a symlink catalog solves it without changing the authoritative
   paths. For a physical move, never add `--apply --yes` on the user's behalf;
   blocked rows are preconditions to resolve, not checks to bypass.

13. **`dev adopt` without `--apply` changes nothing.** Show the user its report
   rather than applying it for them — which branches count as work in flight is
   their judgement, not yours.

14. **Treat Markdown notes as durable and notes.db as cache.** Never delete
   configured `paths.state_dir/notes` to fix search; use `dev cache clear notes`
   and reindex. Note deletion itself requires explicit confirmation, and `dev`
   does not synchronize note/catalog state between hosts.

15. **Do not call stats.db a cache.** Session/WakaTime observations may not be
   reconstructible. Use `dev stats clear --repo/--source/--all`; use
   `dev cache clear` only for regenerable remote/size/gitignore/note-FTS caches.

16. **Archive is not eviction.** `dev tries archive` is a reversible hidden move
   on the same filesystem; it does not free space. Phase 1 has no project-data
   delete command. Never substitute `rm -rf` merely because a remote exists —
   no-remote, local-only refs, ignored files and stash are independent risks.

17. **Read Git state as counts, not a dirty boolean.** `⇡`/`⇣` are upstream
   divergence; `=` conflicts, `+` staged, `!` unstaged, `?` untracked. Use
   `dev status` or JSON for the unique-path and type breakdown before cleanup.

18. **Commit messages stay English** and follow Conventional Commits, even when
   the conversation is in another language — see the companion `git-workflow`
   skill, which owns commit conventions, SemVer and branch naming. This skill
   does not duplicate them.

## When to use this skill

- "What am I working on?" / "我在做什麼" / too many terminal workspaces open.
- Starting, parking or resuming a piece of work.
- Spawning independent background agents without disturbing a live checkout.
- "Where should this worktree go?" / "should I use `claude --worktree` or herdr?"
- A new worktree is missing `node_modules`, `.venv` or `.env`.
- Cleaning up stale branches, worktrees and sessions.
- Cloning, creating or auditing repositories across a machine.
- Promoting an experiment into a real project.
- "Which repo do I spend my time in?"
- Setting up a `.gitignore`, or a harness worktree showing as untracked.
- Adopting a machine that already has repos, worktrees and sessions.
- Recursively scanning, indexing, or physically reorganising existing repos.
- Configuring a flat repo/worktree layout or generating config for one.

## When NOT to use it

- **Commit messages, SemVer, branch naming, PR-vs-main tiering** — that is the
  `git-workflow` skill. This one links to it rather than restating it.
- **Standalone Herdr pane/agent control** — that is the `herdr` skill. The
  `dev start --json` cross-tool launch workflow remains here.
- A single `git add` + `git commit` needs no tooling at all.

## Reference files

- `references/notes.md` — read before repository quick-note operations or
  choosing the boundary with td/beads.
- `references/bootstrap.md` — read before scanning or organising an existing
  machine; includes the non-destructive index default and move safety gates.
- `references/worktree-ownership.md` — who owns which worktree, and how a
  worktree gets a working environment. Read before creating one.
- `references/task-lifecycle.md` — HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE, when to park, and how
  work moves between machines.
- `references/agent-retirement.md` — prepare/finalize/integrate/retire, caller
  safety, exact transcript handling and orphaned-runtime recovery.
- `references/runtime-herdr.md` — how `dev` and herdr divide responsibility,
  including native worktree grouping, collisions and cleanup semantics.
- `references/parallel-agents.md` — read before launching parallel background
  work; exact JSON/pane validation, SpecStory profiles and permissions.
- `references/commands.md` — the full command reference, generated from the
  binary by `dev skill sync` so it cannot drift.

## Gotchas

- **`dev` may be a shell wrapper around the binary.** The trusted `shell-init`
  output defines a wrapper that gives navigation commands a private child-only
  file descriptor, reads one NUL-terminated path and calls `builtin cd` without
  evaluating command output. Without the wrapper, the binary's printable legacy
  directive cannot change the parent shell — that is not a bug.
- **A worktree is a clean checkout.** It has no `node_modules`, no `.venv` and
  none of the gitignored env files. `dev` provisions it; `--no-provision`
  skips that and leaves you to it.
- **Only explicitly included, gitignored stable regular files are copied.**
  Source swaps and symlinked destination parents are refused; existing targets
  are reported skipped, not copied. Do not universally include
  `.claude/settings.local.json`: only sticky/plain-Claude profiles opt in.
- **Removing a worktree never deletes the branch.** Those are separate
  decisions; conflating them is how work gets lost.
- **Bare `dev done` is interactive only on a TTY.** It reports branch relation
  and dirty-content equivalence, then offers commit/discard and FF/PR/cleanup.
  Non-interactive use remains report-only without `--ff`/`--pr`. Unique discard
  requires `DROP` or explicit `--dirty=discard --yes`.
- **The stats sampler must be scheduled.** `dev stats` is empty until
  `dev stats backfill` runs once and `dev stats sample` runs periodically.

1	# Agent-safe worktree retirement
2	
3	## The rule
4	
5	A feature agent may prepare and integrate work, but it must not destroy the
6	runtime or checkout containing its own process. Completion has three milestones:
7	
8	```text
9	READY     exact final transcript committed after the writer exits
10	MERGED    branch integrated; runtime/worktree may still exist
11	RETIRED   runtime absent, worktree removed, optional branch deleted, task reaped
12	```
13	
14	`hot/warm/cold/done` remain the persisted task states. `done` now means MERGED,
15	not "everything has already been deleted".
16	
17	## Normal local flow
18	
19	From the feature worktree:
20	
21	```bash
22	# Commit product changes first. Do not stage the moving transcript.
23	dev prepare --session claude:<uuid> --plan .claude/plans/task.md
24	# Exit the agent normally so SpecStory can write its final Markdown.
25	```
26	
27	The outer `specstory run` wrapper calls:
28	
29	```bash
30	dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped
31	```
32	
33	Then an external main/integration workspace runs:
34	
35	```bash
36	dev done <task> --ff
37	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
38	```
39	
40	`done` only integrates and records MERGED. `retire` re-resolves every runtime
41	pane, closes eligible sessions, waits for them to disappear, revalidates Git,
42	and removes the worktree without force.
43	
44	For periodic cleanup from the canonical main checkout:
45	
46	```bash
47	dev sweep --merged-worktrees
48	# Present the exact candidates/blockers to the user and ask for approval.
49	dev sweep --merged-worktrees --apply --yes
50	```
51	
52	This includes unmanaged linked worktrees whose named branches are already
53	contained in main. It never treats containment alone as permission: dirty Git,
54	pending artifacts and runtime blockers still stop cleanup. Branches remain by
55	default; add `--delete-branches` only when the user approved that separately.
56	
57	## Pull-request flow
58	
59	```bash
60	dev done <task> --pr
61	# after CI/review and a commit-preserving merge
62	git fetch origin
63	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main
64	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
65	```
66	
67	A squash merge is not ancestry-equivalent. It requires an explicit operator
68	attestation:
69	
70	```bash
71	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main --confirm-squash <merge-commit>
72	```
73	
74	This proves only that the named squash commit is in the base; the operator is
75	asserting that it represents the feature.
76	
77	## Safety policy
78	
79	Retirement always refuses when:
80	
81	- the caller cwd is the target or below it;
82	- the caller Herdr workspace/pane or tmux pane covers the target;
83	- a workspace contains panes outside the target;
84	- an agent is `working`, `blocked`, or `waiting`;
85	- runtime enumeration fails;
86	- the checkout is dirty, on the wrong branch, or not contained in its base;
87	- artifact finalization is armed/finalizing/failed.
88	
89	`unknown` or empty agent status requires `--close-unknown` from outside the
90	target. Runtime enumeration failure requires external `--assume-no-runtime`.
91	Neither flag bypasses caller containment or active-agent states.
92	
93	Raw `git worktree remove --force` can bypass dev. Never run it from an agent that
94	occupies the target. dev's guarantee is that no dev-mediated path does so.
95	
96	## What self-deletion looks like
97	
98	A real Codex session deleted its own registered worktree and branch from another
99	checkout. Herdr kept the workspace and terminal alive because Unix processes can
100	hold an open cwd inode after the path is unlinked. SpecStory then recreated the
101	same path with only `.specstory/` content.
102	
103	The resulting shell looked alive but was no longer a Git checkout:
104	
105	```text
106	failed to reload config: No such file or directory
107	fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
108	```
109	
110	Config/skill reloads and new subprocesses failed while Herdr still displayed an
111	idle agent. Treat `runtime alive + Git registration absent + artifact-only path`
112	as an orphan requiring transcript salvage and external reconciliation, never as
113	RETIRED.
114	
115	## Artifact rules
116	
117	- Match SpecStory Markdown by the exact UUID in its fixed preamble, not filename
118	  or newest mtime.
119	- Finalize only after SessionEnd was observed or the outer wrapper supplies
120	  `--writer-stopped`; byte stability remains a second, independent check.
121	- Stage only that transcript and explicitly named plans.
122	- Never stage another provider/session implicitly.
123	- `.specstory/statistics.json` is derived and ignored.
124	- New untracked transcripts above 2 MiB need `--allow-large`.
125	- Scanner/redactor failure commits nothing and leaves a retryable intent.
126	- Artifact commits are on the same feature branch, not necessarily the same
127	  product commit; they carry `Agent-Artifact-Session` and
128	  `Dev-Artifact-Intent` trailers.
129
```

1	# Task lifecycle
2	
3	Read this when work needs to be paused, picked up on another machine, or when
4	a machine has accumulated more open sessions than anyone can hold in mind.
5	
6	## The problem
7	
8	A terminal multiplexer's sidebar is a *runtime* view: it shows what is running
9	now. When it is also the only record of what you are working on, nothing can be
10	closed, because closing it loses the thread. The sidebar grows until it stops
11	being scannable, which defeats its purpose.
12	
13	The fix is not discipline. It is giving "what am I working on" a home that is
14	not the runtime.
15	
16	## Pick a checkout mode before a lifecycle
17	
18	A task records human intent; it does not imply a worktree:
19	
20	| Command | Checkout boundary | Use when |
21	|---|---|---|
22	| `dev repo open api` | none; no task | browsing or truly ad-hoc work |
23	| `dev start api -t typo --direct` | current branch, usually main | one short tracked change |
24	| `dev start api -t small --branch-only` | branch in canonical checkout | lightweight isolation, no concurrency |
25	| `dev start api -t auth --base main` | branch + linked worktree | interruption, experiment, parallel writer |
26	
27	In an interactive terminal, bare `dev start` opens the same managed flow as a
28	context-aware wizard. It prompts for repo, task, mode, branch, base and next,
29	then shows the computed checkout/runtime summary before creating anything.
30	`dev start -t <name>` remains the fast path; `--json` and non-TTY use never
31	prompt.
32	
33	Direct tasks go HOT ↔ WARM and finish with plain `dev done`; they cannot go
34	COLD because the canonical checkout cannot be removed. Branch-only tasks can go
35	cold after push by switching the canonical checkout back to base. The full
36	state machine below describes the default worktree mode.
37	
38	Do not create isolation before it has a job. Equally, a new parallel worktree
39	starts from committed HEAD — it does not carry dirty main changes — so
40	checkpoint first when the new task depends on them.
41	
42	## The four states
43	
44	| State | Git | Runtime | Meaning |
45	|---|---|---|---|
46	| 🔥 `hot` | worktree + branch | session open | working on it now |
47	| 🌤 `warm` | worktree + branch kept | normally closed | back within days |
48	| ❄️ `cold` | committed and pushed; worktree removed | nothing | paused, reconstructible anywhere |
49	| ✅ `done` | merged | may still be open | MERGED; external retirement pending |
50	
51	Only the transitions between them cost anything:
52	
53	```
54	        dev start
55	            │
56	            ▼
57	         🔥 hot ── prepare/exit/finalize ──► READY
58	          │  ▲                                  │
59	   dev park│  │dev resume                       │ dev done
60	          ▼  │                                  ▼
61	        🌤 warm                             ✅ done / MERGED
62	          │  ▲                                  │
63	dev park  │  │dev resume                        │ external dev retire
64	  --cold  ▼  │  (rebuilds the worktree)          ▼
65	        ❄️ cold                              RETIRED (entry removed)
66	```
67	
68	**A machine should hold roughly three to seven hot tasks.** That is a
69	cognitive limit, not a technical one. Everything else belongs in `dev ls`.
70	
71	## Parking
72	
73	```bash
74	dev park --next "reproduce the token refresh race, then add a regression test"
75	```
76	
77	This is the move the whole design exists to make safe. It records what to do
78	next and leaves the checkout boundary exactly where it is. An external caller
79	may close an eligible runtime; when park is invoked from inside its own runtime,
80	it records WARM but deliberately leaves that runtime alive so the agent can exit
81	normally. In direct mode the boundary is the current branch; in worktree mode it
82	is the branch and linked checkout.
83	
84	`--next` is the important part. Without it, resuming means re-deriving where
85	you were from a diff, which is most of the cost of a context switch. Always
86	supply one.
87	
88	Before finishing agent work, run `dev prepare` with the exact session UUID and
89	exit normally. The post-writer finalizer—not the still-running agent—stages and
90	commits the exact transcript/plan. A settled Herdr `done` state is not evidence
91	that history, review or commits are complete.
92	
93	Useful variations:
94	
95	```bash
96	dev park --wip                    # checkpoint uncommitted work first
97	dev park --cold --push            # close session, push, remove worktree
98	dev park --keep-session           # warm only: record state, keep session
99	```
100	
101	`--cold --keep-session` is rejected because a runtime must not remain pointed at
102	a checkout that cold parking removes. A verified runtime-close failure likewise
103	stops cold cleanup before deleting the checkout; warm park reports the close
104	failure and keeps the recorded handle for reconciliation.
105	
106	## Checkpoint commits, not stashes
107	
108	`--wip` makes a `wip: checkpoint — <next>` commit rather than a `git stash`.
109	
110	A stash is invisible in the log, easy to forget, and **cannot be pushed** — so
111	it can never reach another machine. That last point is decisive: the whole
112	value of parking is that the work is recoverable from anywhere.
113	
114	Messy WIP commits on a feature branch are fine. Branch history is *construction
115	history*; the base branch's history is *product history*. They do not have to
116	match — clean the branch up at the integration boundary with an interactive
117	rebase, or squash it, and decide then.
118	
119	## Cold, and why it is safe
120	
121	Going cold removes the checkout. That feels lossy, and is not, because:
122	
123	- the branch still holds every commit;
124	- `dev park --cold` refuses unless the branch is pushed, so the remote holds
125	  them too;
126	- `dev resume` rebuilds the worktree from `origin/<branch>`.
127	
128	Resume rebuilds/reopens checkout and runtime state only. Persisted runtime
129	handles carry their backend name and are validated against live checkout
130	coverage; stale/missing handles reopen instead of making a task falsely HOT.
131	Production `dev` does not currently attach a Claude/Codex conversation; an agent
132	handoff must supply explicit session/launcher arguments.
133	
134	The directory is a cache. The branch is the identity. Once that is true, a
135	local filesystem stops being a graveyard of half-finished checkouts.
136	
137	## Moving work between machines
138	
139	The remote is the handoff boundary. Do not sync worktrees, runtime state, or
140	the multiplexer's database between machines — sync branches.
141	
142	On the machine holding the work:
143	
144	```bash
145	dev park --cold --push
146	```
147	
148	On the machine picking it up:
149	
150	```bash
151	dev resume <task> --fetch
152	```
153	
154	**One writer per branch at a time.** `dev` records an `owner` host and refuses
155	to resume a task owned by another machine without `--force`. Two machines
156	committing to one branch is the only reliable way to make this workflow produce
157	a conflict; the ownership check is what prevents it.
158	
159	If two machines genuinely need to work the same feature at once, split the
160	branch — `feat/auth-ui` and `feat/auth-api` — and integrate afterwards. That is
161	the same rule as for parallel agents: parallel writers get parallel branches.
162	
163	The task registry itself (`$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/tasks/`) is one small TOML file
164	per task, specifically so it can live in a private git repo and merge cleanly
165	across machines. Point `paths.state_dir` at one if you want a shared view.
166	
167	## Sweeping
168	
169	```bash
170	dev sweep            # report only
171	dev sweep --apply    # act, confirming each change
172	dev sweep --merged-worktrees  # from main, include untracked contained worktrees
173	```
174	
175	`sweep` reports two kinds of problem:
176	
177	- **Drift** — a task marked hot with no live session, a warm task with one, a
178	  recorded worktree git no longer knows about, or a branch-backed task whose
179	  branch git no longer has. That last one is dead rather than drifted: `done`,
180	  `resume` and `retire` all resolve the branch first, so the record is offered
181	  for reaping instead of repair.
182	- **Staleness** — a warm task nobody has touched in two weeks, clean and
183	  pushed, that could go cold.
184	
185	It also lists **live sessions no task claims** — the other half of a crowded
186	sidebar, and usually the larger half.
187	
188	From the canonical default-branch checkout, `--merged-worktrees` switches to a
189	focused audit of tracked and unmanaged linked worktrees whose named branches are
190	already contained in main. It suppresses unrelated stale-task/session noise so
191	the result can be presented directly for cleanup approval. Dirty trees, active
192	Git operations, pending artifact
193	intents, active/mixed runtimes, detached heads and unmerged branches are
194	reported as blockers. Safe candidates still require `--apply` and individual
195	confirmation; `--delete-branches` is a separate opt-in.
196	
197	Agent workflow: show the report to the user as a concrete QA prompt, naming the
198	exact candidate paths and whether branches would be retained. Only after the
199	user approves that set may the agent add `--apply --yes`.
200	
201	`sweep` never deletes uncommitted work, and never acts without `--apply`. DONE
202	tasks with runtime/worktree resources are reported as cleanup pending and routed
203	through the same external-only retirement safety service; their records are not
204	reaped first.
205	
206	## Integration
207	
208	```bash
209	dev done --ff     # rebase onto the base, then fast-forward it
210	dev done --pr     # push and open a pull/merge request via the detected forge CLI
211	dev done          # TTY: inspect commits/dirty content and choose interactively
212	```
213	
214	Which one depends on a single question: **are this branch's commits worth
215	keeping in the base's history?**
216	
217	- Yes → `--ff`. Linear history, no merge commit, `git bisect` and `git blame`
218	  stay legible.
219	- No, it is WIP noise → squash at the integration point.
220	- Someone (or CI) should look first → `--pr`.
221	
222	On a TTY, `dev done` reports branch ahead/behind plus which staged, unstaged and
223	untracked paths are already equivalent to the base. It can commit all changes,
224	discard all changes, or cancel before choosing FF/PR. Unique content requires
225	typing `DROP`; scripts use `--dirty=commit --message ...` or the deliberately
226	destructive `--dirty=discard --yes`. Ignored files are never discarded. If an
227	active writer changes the checkout during confirmation or immediately after a
228	commit, integration stops and the command must be rerun after that writer exits.
229	
230	For branch/worktree tasks, non-interactive `dev done` without an integration
231	mode remains report-only. Direct tasks still finish without one. Conflicted
232	checkouts always require manual resolution.
233	
234	`--ff` integrates and records DONE/MERGED but always leaves runtime, worktree
235	and branch intact — cleanup belongs to `dev retire`. `--pr` only publishes and
236	opens review; after a commit-preserving external merge use
237	`dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>`. Squash requires explicit
238	`--confirm-squash <commit>` attestation. `--delete-branch` and `--keep-worktree`
239	are deprecated on `done`: the branch is deleted only by
240	`dev retire --delete-branch`, and only when git agrees it is fully contained in
241	the base. "Merged" is not always "finished", so branches survive by default.

git stash apply "$stash_sha"
stash_ref=''
while IFS=' ' read -r ref sha rest; do

test -n "$stash_ref"
git stash drop "$stash_ref"
